input: Are there any jobs available for an agricultural scientist?
actual_output:
Yes, based on the provided data, there are several job openings relevant to an agricultural scientist or individuals with an agricultural science background:

*   **Expert/Project Manager in Milk for Sustainable Animal Production:** Requires at least a university-level education as an agronomist, veterinarian, or farm manager. The role involves gathering and transferring knowledge regarding milk production, animal health, and new technology. (Posted 2024-10-17)
*   **Syngenta Group China Scientist:** Requires a PhD in agriculture, plant sciences, plant pathology, bioinformatics, soil science, or related fields. This role involves driving innovation in seeds, crop protection, and crop nutrition. (Posted 2024-10-29)
*   **Plant Cultivation Adviser (Hushållningssällskapet Kalmar Kronoberg Blekinge):** Seeking a qualified soil plant agronomist, farm manager, or equivalent to provide field advice, crop planning, and financial follow-up. (Posted 2024-10-28 and 2024-11-03)
*   **Land and Agricultural Estate Operations Director:** Requires an Agricultural Engineer or at least a BTSA in Agronomy, crop production, or animal production, with experience in managing agricultural operations. (Posted 2024-09-05 and 2024-10-04)
*   **PhD Positions:**
    *   **PhD Student in Plant Genetics and Breeding:** Requires a master's degree in plant genetics and breeding, plant biology, or a related field. (Posted 2025-02-09)
    *   **PhD Student Position in Land Sector Sustainability Transitions:** Requires a master's degree in a relevant field, preferably environmental science, agricultural science, or engineering science. (Posted 2025-03-18)
    *   **PhD Position within Sustainable Feed for Poultry and Pigs:** Requires a degree in Agricultural Science, Animal Science, Biology, or another relevant field at an advanced level. (Posted 2024-11-27)
*   **Postdoc Positions:**
    *   **Postdoc - Plant breeding towards nutritional quality in cereals:** Requires a PhD in agriculture, biology, plant breeding, or a related field. (Posted 2024-11-26)

Additionally, several roles for "Agricultural Engineer," "Operations Manager," or "Plant Engineering Consultant" list agricultural science degrees or comparable professional training as requirements or qualifications.

j.title: Försökstekniker
j.description: The Department of Plant Production Ecology We are looking for an experimental technician for Röbäcksdalen's field research station, Umeå. Do you want to contribute to the development of Swedish agriculture by participating and testing agricultural issues in field experiments? Do you enjoy solving problems and are you service oriented? Then this position at SLU in Umeå could be something for you. We are now looking for an employee who can contribute to continued development and management of the business. Together with colleagues, you will carry out research-oriented special trials, testing of new breeding material of forage crops, straw grain and potatoes as well as long-range cultivation system, fertility and tillage trials. All this is carried out under field conditions within both conventional and organic cultivation systems. About the job The main work task will consist of the establishment and maintenance and harvesting of field trials in the field of crop cultivation, but participation in departmental joint activities and assisting and supervising temporary field staff are examples of other tasks that may occur .During the crop growing season, the work mainly takes place in the field. The tasks then mainly include planning and implementation of practical steps linked to the experiments. Important work steps are then tillage, sowing, crop protection measures and harvesting, but the work also consists of weighing seed and fertilizer, simpler measurements in the field, grading and sampling of soil and plant material. Between the growing seasons, we work at the experimental station mainly with result processing, follow-up and documentation of trials, planning for the coming season, technical maintenance of machines, development of trial methodology and planning of future trials together with researchers and other trial orderers. The work is teamwork, where responsibility is distributed within the group, and where communication and cooperation are crucial for a successful result. Please note that due to the relatively short growing season, the work is intensive, occasionally physically demanding and irregular working hours and overtime work occur during the growing season. Your background We are looking for you who:• is interested in research and development• appreciates collaborating with researchers and companies• is technically interested and who easily adopts new technology• wants to work practically on a agriculturally oriented experimental station• enjoys working outdoors• can work independently• is meticulous It is required that you:• be educated in the field of agriculture (agricultural high school or agrotechnician, land surveyor or agronomist training or equivalent)• have good computer skills• command spoken and written Swedish and can communicate in English• holds a B driving license It is advantageous if you have practical agricultural experience in crop cultivation or hold authorization to use plant protection products (class 1L-2L).We will attach great importance to your personal qualities, such as cooperativeness, accuracy and independence.About usThe Department of Plant Production Ecology contributes to solutions through research, collaboration and education about sustainable plant production. We train and research plants for food, feed and energy. The research examines how different production methods, cultivation environments and systems affect yields and other ecosystem services, as well as product quality and the surrounding environment. The department has operations in both Uppsala and Umeå and is also responsible for the Lövsta and Röbäcksdalen field stations. Röbäcksdalen is a research center close to the city that is a unique environment for applied research in environmental, ecological and agricultural sciences. Through our focus on the interactions between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. j.description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? Do you want varied work in an agricultural environment? Before 2025, we have several new exciting attempts where we need the help of interested seasonal staff. We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. About the job The tasks are above all to help with tasks that occur in our plant cultivation experiments, such as weighing seed and fertilizer, measuring experimental areas, carrying out various agricultural measures, carrying out soil sampling and crop, i.a. frequent measurements of gas emissions. There is also some work with sample handling, packaging of samples and maintenance of equipment. During intensive periods in crop cultivation, some evening work may be relevant. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. Experience of driving tractors, agricultural implements, drones and various measuring equipment is advantageous. The work requires accuracy and the ability to understand both oral and written instructions in Swedish. B driving license is a requirement. In the selection, great importance was attached to the applicant's personal suitability. About usLanna research station outside Skara conducts field experiments for researchers within SLU and for other actors. The business has a strong focus on precision farming, plant nutrition and stable manure and has many long-term trials. Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials.  Within the trial operations at Lanna, two people work full-time and 1-2 seasonal employees with the field operations. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. The Lanna research station is part of the Department of Soil and Environment, which is a leading soil science center, both nationally and internationally. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. We form part of SLU's Land, Water and Environment Center (MVM center), with close contacts to environmental analysis and research on e.g. water, cycle and bioenergy. The business contributes to meeting national environmental and climate goals and the UN's global sustainability goals. The department is located at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and at Skara. j.title: Försökstekniker till Borgeby/Helgegården
j.description: We are looking for you with a great interest in the future of agriculture and who wants to work in an engaging team with a fast pace and lots of laughs. With us, you are offered an exciting opportunity to get a developing job in Swedish horticulture with an employer with long experience and a lot of knowledge. Welcome to us at Hushållningssällskapet Skåne!Hushållningssällskapet Skåne has for 200 years been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. We are the farmers' support and run a very reputable field trial operation with approx. 450 trials a year, where quality and development are guiding stars. About the service The Skåne Farming Society's focus is to carry out crop cultivation trials of high scientific quality with modern equipment in all imaginable crops for the benefit and profitability of Swedish Agriculture. As a test technician with us, you will thus get an exciting role where the starting point of your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. It is varied work where every day is unique and the challenges are many. We carry out field trials in areas such as variety testing, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrition, tillage and more. You will be part of a team of trial technicians who work closely together. We offer you stimulating and fun work with varying tasks throughout the year depending on the season. With us, you also get the opportunity to participate in developing the agriculture of the future! About you In order to succeed and thrive with us, you have an agricultural education or work experience in crop cultivation. B driving license is a requirement for the position, BE is desirable. We are looking for someone who has good knowledge of driving agricultural machinery and you should have a sprayer certificate. We are also looking for someone who has knowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivation. As a person, you have a great interest in crop cultivation/agriculture. You are meticulous, committed and quality conscious. You have the ability and enjoy working both independently and together with others. Of course you are driven and like challenges. Location: Borgeby or Helgegården. The position begins as a trial employment for 6 months Questions about the position? Feel free to call us and we will tell you more. Ulrika Dyrlund Martinsson, head of field trials 010-4762031, ulrika.dyrlundmartinsson@hushallningssallskapet.se Andreas Andersson, field trial leader, 010-4762054, andreas.andersson@hushallningssallskapet.se Johan Meyer, field trial leader, 010-4762038, johan.meyer@hushallningssallskapet.seDoes that sound interesting? Submit your application today as selection takes place continuously. Welcome with your application!RequirementsAgricultural education or work experience in crop cultivationB driver's license Meritorious BE driver's license Spraying certificateKnowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivationExperience in machine serviceGood knowledge of driving agricultural machineryAbout the employer - Husthalningsällskapet SkåneHushållningsällskapet is part of Sweden's history. The history stretches all the way back to 1791, when the country's first Household Society was established on Gotland. When we arrived over two hundred years ago, it was in a different Sweden, where agriculture formed the basis for the entire nation's prosperity. Back then, when famine was a reality in many Swedish households, new knowledge was needed for a more rational food production. Today, we continue to be an important actor that develops the green business life and to manage the earth's resources. Today, the Housekeeping Society consists of 15 independent societies that operate all over the country (the Housekeeping Society in Skåne is one of these). Just over 700 employees deal with advice, training, research and field trials and we have approx. 30,000 members. Our customers are in agriculture, forestry, public activities and other industries, mainly in rural areas. Together, we offer knowledge for the country's future. Please read more about us at https://hushallningssallskapet.se/

j.title: Stalltekniker
j.description: Lövsta agricultural research We are looking for someone who wants to work as a stable technician in the cow stable at SLU, Lövsta agricultural research outside Uppsala. We are close to thirty employees in the team at Lövsta where half work with the dairy cow herd of 300 cows with recruitment and about 6 employees work in the pig barn where the pig herd includes 110 sows with integrated production. The barns are highly mechanized with, among other things, milking robots (VMS) in the cow barn. The business annually carries out 20 research projects and receives a couple of thousand SLU students. About the job We are looking for you who want to work with the usual chores in a dairy cow herd such as supervision in stables and on pasture, cleaning, registrations, administration, weighing and feeding. The work is scheduled with weekend and standby work. Some work can occur in Lövsta's chicken and laying hen barn, whose operations are integrated with the cow barn. The daily work is interspersed with tasks that are connected to the research activities and as support in the teaching. Your background You must have practical experience of working with farm animals and milk production, theoretical knowledge is an advantage. We attach great importance to personal qualities such as cooperation, independence, and initiative and organizational skills. You must be interested in working with researchers and students. B driving license is a requirement. It is advantageous if you have attended a seminar course and/or course in pharmaceutical management and if you have experience driving a tractor. About us Lövsta Agricultural Research at the Swedish University of Agriculture is one of Europe's most modern facilities for research and teaching on farm animals. In the stables, there is extensive production with pigs, dairy cows and poultry. The stables are used daily by students and researchers at SLU. j.title: Traktorförare Säsong 2025
j.description: To Framtidsgården Bjertorp we are now looking for you with a great interest in future agriculture and who want to work in an engaging and happy team with high tempo during the season 2025.bjertorp's property is Lantmännen Lantbruks Framtidsgård in Västra Götaland, Sweden. We conduct a modern and rational agriculture of 890 hectares, mainly focused on seed cultivation. At Nötcenter Viken AB, Vikens property, we are responsible for plant cultivation with the help of Bjertorp's machinery and staff. We attach great importance to precision cultivation and development of the cultivation technology of the future. In addition, we carry out field trials for Lantmännen. The experimental operations comprise about 20 hectares and 6,000 trial savings cells that are distributed over the farm's area. The employment is a seasonal employment for the 2025 season, with access on April 1 and runs until October 31. There is the possibility of an extension, and access is made by arrangement. This will be done with other staff you will primarily manage the choirs to be carried out on a plant cultivation farm, such as tillage, grain transport during harvest and grazing harvest at Viken. You will also help with sowing and harvesting of experimental crops. Other farm work such as loading machine driving and machine maintenance is available. All work in fields is performed with precision cultivation as a basis. We use modern tractors and the latest mechanical engineering to ensure high efficiency, precision and sustainability. This you need to succeed and thrive: - an agricultural education (or multi -year experience in the profession) - experience in machine driving and a great interest in agriculture - B -driving license - Good knowledge of the Swedish language you are: - Responsible and accurate in your work - a team layer that can collaborate with others in your area, but who can also work independently - syringe certificates are meritherydu share our values ​​openness, holistic approach and action - And our promise to take responsibility from land to table. What we offer the Digen exciting seasonal employment for the 2025 season, where you get the opportunity to both develop and contribute to development. The employment will take up by an agreement, with the desirable start date from April 1 to October 31. There is the possibility of extension. Place of placement for the service is Kvänum, where you will report to the operator. If needed, there is the possibility of housing. You apply for the online service, preferably as soon as possible but no later than February 28 2025. Selection is ongoing. If you have any questions regarding the service or recruitment process, you are most welcome to contact our judge Linnea Knutsson 010-556 2823, linnea.knutsson@lantmannen.com and/or our operations manager Kjell Carlsson 010-556 2825, kjell.carlsson@lantmannen.com.lanten is an agricultural cooperative and northern Europe's leading player in agriculture, machine, bioenergy and food. We are owned by 18,000 Swedish farmers, have 12,000 employees, have operations in some 20 countries and have a turnover of approximately SEK 70 billion on an annual basis. With the base in cereals, we refine arable land resources for viable agriculture. Some of our most well -known brands in food are AXA, Kungsörnen, Scan, sausage bread bag, GoGreen, Finn Crisp and Bonjour. Our company is based on knowledge and values ​​that have existed for generations with our owners. Through research, development and activities throughout the value chain, we together take responsibility from land to table. Read more at www.lantmannen.se.

input: What competences are required for that occupation?
actual_output:
Based on the information provided from the database for the occupation of an Agricultural Scientist (linked to ID `c25b3700-6095-42b7-99fc-b87dc326c044`), the required skills and knowledge are categorized below:

### Skills and Competences
These are practical applications and professional capabilities:
*   **Research & Technical Skills:** Perform scientific research, use agronomic modelling, manage research data, manage findable/accessible/interoperable/reusable (FAIR) data, draft scientific/academic papers and technical documentation, and write scientific publications.
*   **Project & Resource Management:** Perform project management, manage fisheries projects, advise on irrigation projects, inspect project regulations, create soil and plant improvement programmes, and manage intellectual property rights.
*   **Advisory & Training:** Provide advice to farmers, provide advice to hatcheries, advise on soil and water protection, advise on efficiency improvements, teach in academic or vocational contexts, train employees, train staff on recycling programs, mentor individuals, and educate on recycling regulations.
*   **Leadership & Collaboration:** Lead a team, evaluate employees' work, identify process improvements, promote open innovation in research, promote the transfer of knowledge, increase the impact of science on policy and society, and develop professional networks with researchers and scientists.
*   **Compliance & Monitoring:** Ensure compliance with environmental legislation, comply with legal regulations, comply with farm regulations, report pollution incidents, report on environmental issues, and monitor the farm environmental management plan.
*   **Professional Development:** Manage personal professional development, interact professionally in research and professional environments, apply research ethics and scientific integrity principles, apply blended learning, and speak different languages.
*   **Other:** Apply precision farming, assess new farming technologies, cultivate crops for biomass, perform market research, disseminate results to the scientific community, operate open source software, evaluate research activities, communicate with a non-scientific audience, think abstractly, synthesise information, conduct research across disciplines, promote the participation of citizens in scientific research, and integrate gender dimensions in research.

### Knowledge
These represent the theoretical understanding required for the role:
*   **Agricultural Systems:** Conservation agriculture, climate smart agriculture, integrated food-energy systems, organic farming, agroecology, agroforestry, livestock farming systems, and e-agriculture.
*   **Policy & Management:** Environmental policy, environmental legislation in agriculture and forestry, bioeconomy, project management principles, and project management.
*   **Research & Communication:** Consultation methods, multidisciplinary research, scientific literature, and research design.

input: Are there any other occupations that require knowledge of environmental protection and sustainability regulations?
actual_output:
Although there is no information exactly related to the original question concerning "Agricultural Scientist" in the context of the initial query, the database provides a list of several other occupations that involve knowledge of environmental protection, sustainability, and related regulations. 

These occupations include:

*   **Environmental scientist:** Identifies problems and finds solutions to minimize environmental hazards, develops environmental policies, and ensures environmental regulations are followed.
*   **Environmental protection manager:** Provides advice on the development of environmental policies and manages campaigns aimed at waste collection, landfills, and green area preservation.
*   **Sustainability manager:** Assists in the design and implementation of plans to ensure manufacturing processes and products comply with environmental regulations and social responsibility standards.
*   **Environmental programme coordinator:** Develops programmes for environmental sustainability and efficiency and monitors an organisation's compliance with environmental legislation.
*   **Environmental health inspector:** Carries out investigations to ensure organisations and companies comply with environmental and public health legislation.
*   **Waste management officer:** Develops and implements rules for waste disposal, collection, and recycling and evaluates compliance with existing legislation.
*   **Industrial waste inspector:** Conducts controls in companies to ensure they comply with waste and environmental regulations.
*   **Hazardous waste inspector:** Inspects industrial sites to ensure they adhere to waste disposal legislation and function according to regulations.
*   **Hazardous materials inspector:** Inspects facilities handling hazardous materials to ensure compliance with health and safety regulations and handling legislation.
*   **Occupational health and safety inspector:** Performs workplace audits to ensure compliance with government and environment legislation.
*   **Environmental mining engineer:** Develops and implements environmental systems and strategies to minimise environmental impacts in mining operations.
*   **Airport environment officer:** Monitors emissions and contamination at airports and implements rules for sustainable development.
*   **Natural resources consultant:** Provides advice on the protection and management of natural resources to ensure the conservation of ecosystems.
*   **Recycling specialist:** Supervises waste management and recycling implementation to ensure compliance with regulations.
*   **Environmental policy officer:** Researches and implements policies to reduce the impact of industrial, commercial, and agricultural activities on the environment.
*   **Smart city consultant:** Advises on sustainability solutions for smart city initiatives, including executing environmental projects.
*   **Green ICT consultant:** Advises organisations on green ICT strategies to reach environmental objectives.
*   **Water treatment plant manager:** Ensures a water plant’s operations are compliant with regulations.
*   **Landfill supervisor:** Researches waste management legislation and ensures operations are compliant.
*   **Wastewater treatment operator:** Ensures treated water meets environmental standards.

o.label: environmental protection manager
o.description: Environmental protection managers provide advice on the development of environmental policies to governmental and official institutions. They analyse possible threats for the well being of the people and the environment in a region and manage campaigns aimed at tackling problems such as waste collection, landfills, and preservation of green areas.

o.label: sustainability manager
o.description: Sustainability managers are responsible for ensuring the sustainability of business processes. They provide assistance in the design and implementation of plans and measures to ensure that the manufacturing processes and products comply with given environmental regulations and social responsibility standards and they monitor and report on the implementation of sustainability strategies within the company supply chain and business process. They analyse issues linked to manufacturing processes, use of materials, waste reduction, energy efficiency and products traceability to improve environmental and social impacts and integrate sustainability aspects into the company culture.

o.label: environmental technician
o.description: Environmental technicians investigate sources of pollution and aid in the development of pollution prevention and environment protection plans. They take samples of soil, water or other materials and perform tests to analyse the pollution level and identify its source.

o.label: environmental programme coordinator
o.description: Environmental programme coordinators develop programmes for the improvement of environmental sustainability and efficiency within a organisation or institution. They inspect sites in order to monitor an organisation's or institution's compliance with environmental legislation. They also ensure education for the public on environmental concerns.

o.label: environmental policy officer
o.description: Environmental policy officers research, analyse, develop and implement policies related to the environment. They give expert advice to entities such as commercial organisations, government agencies and land developers. Environmental policy officers work on reducing the impact of industrial, commercial and agricultural activities on the environment.

o.label: environmental scientist
o.description: Environmental scientists identify problems and find solutions in order to minimize environmental hazards by performing analysis on samples such as air, water or soil. They advise on or develop environmental policies and aim to improve water supplies preservation and manage waste disposal sites. Environmental scientists perform environmental risk assessments and analyse the environmental impact of new solutions, construction sites or environmental changes ensuring the environmental regulations are followed.

o.label: natural resources consultant

They oversee the production of policy positions, as well as the organization's campaign and advocacy work in fields such as environmental, ethics, quality, transparency, and sustainability.

o.label: environmental health inspector
o.description: Environmental health inspectors carry out investigations to ensure that areas, organisations and companies comply with environmental and public health legislation. They evaluate environmental complaints, provide reports on their findings and work to prevent future hazards or noncompliance with current policies. Environmental health inspectors perform consultations to promote public health and safety.

o.label: industrial waste inspector
o.description: Industrial waste inspectors conduct controls in companies to ensure they comply with waste and environmental regulations. They check the documentation related to waste management, they collect samples for analysis and observe the industrial practices. They may advise or preventive or corrective actions to improve industrial waste management and disposal.

o.label: occupational health and safety inspector
o.description: Occupational health and safety inspectors perform workplace audits to ensure compliance with government and environment legislation. They also investigate work accidents. Occupational health and safety inspectors interview employees to ensure the work environment is compliant with health and safety rules, inspect the physical work site and analyse legal paperwork.

o.label: airport environment officer
o.description: Airport environment officers monitor environmental issues such as emissions, contamination, and wildlife activity in the premises of airports. They report environmental attractors for animals such as nearby rubbish dumps or wetland areas. They can engage in studying the environmental impact that airports have in the surrounding communities in reference to the diverse contamination that airports produce. They implement the rules to ensure the sustainable development of the airport.

o.label: nature conservation officer
o.description: Nature conservation officers manage and improve the local environment within all the sectors of a local community. They promote awareness of and understanding about the natural environment. This work can be very varied and involve projects related to species, habitats and communities. They educate people and raise overall awareness of environmental issues.

o.label: recycling specialist
o.description: Recycling specialists research recycling policies and legislation, and supervise implementation in an organisation to ensure that waste management occurs according to regulations. They perform inspections, provide recycling equipment, and supervise recycling workers. They also advise organisations on ways they can improve their waste management procedures.

input: What vacancies exist for professionals who research soil, plants, and animals to improve agricultural processes?
actual_output:
Based on the provided database records, there are several vacancies for professionals involved in research related to soil, plants, and the improvement of agricultural processes. Here are the relevant job opportunities:

*   **PhD Student in Plant Genetics and Breeding (Job ID: 1924199)**
    *   **Focus:** Research at the Department of Plant Breeding targeting food, feed, and industrial products, specifically focusing on red clover yield and quality improvements.
    *   **Responsibilities:** Hands-on activities in the laboratory, greenhouse, and field, including crossbreeding, phenotyping, comparative genomics, population genetics, and marker-trait association analysis.
    *   **Deadline:** 2025-03-15.

*   **Syngenta Group China Scientist (Job IDs: 184552, 1689159)**
    *   **Focus:** Roles within a global agricultural innovation and technology company. 
    *   **Responsibilities:** Conducting groundbreaking research in seeds, crop protection, crop nutrition, and sustainable agriculture to develop next-generation solutions.
    *   **Qualifications:** PhD in fields including agriculture, plant sciences, plant pathology, bioinformatics, soil science, plant nutrition, agricultural microbiology, or Integrated Pest Management (IPM).

*   **Försöksassistent / Research Assistant (Job ID: 1841619)**
    *   **Focus:** Working at the Lanna research station (part of the Department of Soil and Environment). 
    *   **Responsibilities:** Assisting in plant cultivation experiments, including weighing seed and fertilizer, soil sampling, crop sampling, and measuring gas emissions.
    *   **Requirements:** Interest in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation, education in agriculture preferred, and experience with field equipment.

These positions involve scientific research aimed at improving agricultural production, sustainability, and efficiency.

j.title: Försöksassistent
j.description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? Do you want varied work in an agricultural environment? Before 2025, we have several new exciting attempts where we need the help of interested seasonal staff. We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. About the job The tasks are above all to help with tasks that occur in our plant cultivation experiments, such as weighing seed and fertilizer, measuring experimental areas, carrying out various agricultural measures, carrying out soil sampling and crop, i.a. frequent measurements of gas emissions. There is also some work with sample handling, packaging of samples and maintenance of equipment. During intensive periods in crop cultivation, some evening work may be relevant. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. Experience of driving tractors, agricultural implements, drones and various measuring equipment is advantageous. The work requires accuracy and the ability to understand both oral and written instructions in Swedish. B driving license is a requirement. In the selection, great importance was attached to the applicant's personal suitability. About usLanna research station outside Skara conducts field experiments for researchers within SLU and for other actors. The business has a strong focus on precision farming, plant nutrition and stable manure and has many long-term trials. Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials.  Within the trial operations at Lanna, two people work full-time and 1-2 seasonal employees with the field operations. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. The Lanna research station is part of the Department of Soil and Environment, which is a leading soil science center, both nationally and internationally. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. We form part of SLU's Land, Water and Environment Center (MVM center), with close contacts to environmental analysis and research on e.g. water, cycle and bioenergy. The business contributes to meeting national environmental and climate goals and the UN's global sustainability goals. The department is located at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and at Skara. Read more about the department here (https://www.slu.se/mark). Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa -slu/Location: Lanna, trial cultivation outside Lidköping Form of employment: Temporary employment approx. 6 months Scope: 60% - 100% Access: 2025-04-01 or according to agreement. Application: Welcome with your application via the application button below no later than 2025-01-31. Union contact persons: https://internt.slu.se/min-anstallning/facket/kontaktpersons/Sveriges lantbruksuniversitet (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has roughly 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

j.title: Plant cultivation adviser to the Housekeeping Society Kalmar Kronoberg Blekinge
j.description: About the position We are looking for a horticulture advisor for our office in Kalmar. We have an existing customer group on Öland where the majority have animal production with forage farming, therefore it is important that you have good competence in crop rotation and maize. You will have your own customer responsibility for these customers but also work closely with your plant cultivation advisor colleagues at the company. Within Hushållningsällskapet Kalmar Kronoberg Blekinge, there are also advisers with expertise in construction, agricultural economics, accounting, environment, water and forestry. You will help customers with plant cultivation planning, field advice, EU support and financial follow-up of crops. It also includes writing advisor letters. You are expected to get involved in our customer development and come up with creative ideas on how our services can be developed to meet our customers' needs. It is advantageous if you have knowledge of irrigation of agricultural crops or are knowledgeable in machine costs. About you You need have a strong personal interest in crop cultivation, including cereals, fodder, maize and oilseeds. In order to thrive in this role, you must also have an understanding of the need for cost-effective food production. Important personal qualities are drive, pedagogy and communication. You need to be communicative both with our customers and with your colleagues. It is a strength if you are unprestigious and generous in sharing your experiences and skills. It is also a strength if you are open to testing new ways of working and new innovations in crop cultivation. We place great emphasis on personal qualities. Qualifications We are looking for you who are a qualified soil plant agronomist or farm manager, or equivalent. Alternatively, you who have worked with crop cultivation for a long professional life and have solid experience in this. B driving license is a requirement, as well as very good knowledge of Swedish, both spoken and written. We offer With us you get the opportunity to develop the green industries together with other knowledgeable and committed employees. We specialize in plant cultivation consultancy for agricultural companies. We have an independent role that is appreciated by our clients. We have flexible working hours and the possibility to work remotely to a certain extent. We also have a wellness allowance and one wellness hour a week. You get a great opportunity to influence how your working week looks like. At the Housekeeping Society you get the opportunity to develop, your work is characterized by freedom under responsibility while you are involved and contribute to the development of the green sector and a living countryside. Access dates by agreement. The position is a permanent position. Probationary employment of 6 months may be applied. Placement sorter Kalmar. Last application date 2025-01-08. We will process the applications on an ongoing basis. The position may be filled before the application deadline. If you have questions about the position, please contact: Team Manager, Pernilla Mattsson: pernilla.mattsson@hushallningssallskapet.se, 072-351 50 68 Welcome with your application! Hushållningssällskapet Kalmar Kronoberg Blekinge Knowledge for the country's future is our promise. We are one of 15 independent Household Associations with the goal of promoting rural development. The household association is an independent, non-profit organization that works for knowledge, research and development of rural green industries and an increased level of supply in Swedish food. We are a member-led organisation, which means that it is the needs of our members that form the backbone of our business. The Kalmar Kronoberg Blekinge household management company consists of approx. 230 employees who are spread across six different offices and schools. This allows us to search for skills across a large part of the country and offer work opportunities in three different counties. We specialize in plant breeding consultancy for agricultural companies. We have an independent role that is appreciated by our clients. We have flexible working hours and the possibility to work remotely to a certain extent. We also have a wellness allowance and one wellness hour a week. You get a great opportunity to influence how your working week looks like. At the Housekeeping Association, you get the opportunity to develop, your work is characterized by freedom under responsibility while you participate and contribute to the development of the green sector and a vibrant countryside. Access dates by agreement. The position is a permanent position. Probationary employment of 6 months may be applied. Location sorter Kalmar. Last application date 2025-01-08. We will process the applications on an ongoing basis. The position may be filled before the application deadline. If you have questions about the position, please contact: Team manager, Pernilla Mattsson: pernilla. mattsson@hushallningssallskapet. se, 072-351 50 68Welcome with your application! j.title: PhD Student in Plant Genetics and Breeding
j.description: Department of Plant BreedingThe Department of Plant Breeding focuses on research, education, and innovation that are strategically critical to society's long-term supply of food, industrial raw materials, and energy. We contribute to the efficient and sustainable production of food, feed, and industrial products through our state-of-the-art research targeting plants. our goal is to meet the increasing demands for these resources while making plant production increasingly environmentally friendly and energy efficient. Through our concerted efforts, we expand knowledge that contributes to sustainable societal development. In collaboration with growers and industries involved in crop cultivation, we are actively shaping what will be served on consumer plates in the future. Our department has grown numerically in recent years, with international employees and PhD students accounting for a highly significant proportion. Research activities at the department include population genetics of various crop species, development of omics-based breeding tools, marker-aided selection, genomic prediction, and crossbreeding for crop improvement.More information about the department can be found here:https://www.slu.se/en/departments/plant-breeding/Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Name of research project/thesis: Population genetics, comparative genomics, marker-trait association analysis and development of speed breeding methods to improve yield and quality in red clover.Research subject: Agricultural Science Description:Currently, the Department is conducting several research projects on crops that have a significant impact on Swedish agriculture. A number of these projects are funded by SLU GroGrund - the Swedish Centre for Breeding of Food Crops: https://www.slu.se/en/Collaborative-Centres-and-Projects/grogrund/One of these projects is "Building Efficient Breeding Programs in Forages: BreedForage". Red clover, the most important forage legume crop in Sweden, is one of the target crops of this project. Currently, the Department is seeking a PhD student to join the research team in this project, which focuses on red clover forage yields and forage quality.The PhD student who will hold this position will be actively engaged in various project activities including•  Crossbreeding•  Phenotyping•  Comparative genomics and allele mining,•  Population genetics and marker-trait association analyses•  Genomic prediction•  Protocol development for speed breeding.•  The PhD student will conduct various hands-on activities in the laboratory, greenhouse, and field.Qualifications:We seek a highly motivated candidate with a master's degree in plant genetics and breeding, plant biology, or a related field. The candidate should have•  Adequate knowledge of conventional and genomics-driven plant breeding methods, genomics, and molecular markers.•  A well-developed understanding and skills in various statistical software applications, including R •  Experience working with plants under field and greenhouse conditions is required•  Experience in bioinformatics and quantitative genetics analysis is an advantage.•  research experience with red clover or other legume species is favourable.The PhD students will work with researchers from different departments at SLU as well as industrial partners, which makes the ability to collaborate essential. Hence, it is of great importance that the candidate has effective communication and collaboration skills.The ability to write and communicate effectively in English is a prerequisite while communicating in Scandinavian languages is an advantage.Applicants should demonstrate a high level of scientific curiosity and possess favorable personal characters.Place of work: AlnarpForms for funding or employment:Employment (4 years)Starting date:July 1st, 2025 or according to agreementApplication:Click the "Apply" button to submit your application. The deadline is 2025-03-15.To qualify for third-cycle (Doctoral) courses and study programmes, you must have a second-cycle (Master's) qualification. Alternatively, you must have conducted a minimum of four years of full-time study, of which a minimum of one year at second-cycle level.Applicants will be selected based on their written application and CV, degree project, copies of their degree certificate and transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution, two personal references, and knowledge of English. More information about the English language requirements can be found here: https://www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/application-admission-doctoral-studies/Please note that applicants invited to interview must submit attested copies of their degree certificate, or equivalent, a transcript of records from previous first and second-cycle studies at a university or higher education institution. Applicants who are not Swedish citizens need to submit an attested copy of their passport's information page containing their photograph and personal details.Read about the PhD education at SLU at www.slu.se/en/education/programmes-courses/doctoral-studies/Academic union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden.SLU has around 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 3 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

j.title: Försökstekniker till Borgeby/Helgegården
j.description: We are looking for you with a great interest in the future of agriculture and who wants to work in an engaging team with a fast pace and lots of laughs. With us, you are offered an exciting opportunity to get a developing job in Swedish horticulture with an employer with long experience and a lot of knowledge. Welcome to us at Hushållningssällskapet Skåne!Hushållningssällskapet Skåne has for 200 years been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. We are the farmers' support and run a very reputable field trial operation with approx. 450 trials a year, where quality and development are guiding stars. About the service The Skåne Farming Society's focus is to carry out crop cultivation trials of high scientific quality with modern equipment in all imaginable crops for the benefit and profitability of Swedish Agriculture. As a test technician with us, you will thus get an exciting role where the starting point of your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. It is varied work where every day is unique and the challenges are many. We carry out field trials in areas such as variety testing, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrition, tillage and more. You will be part of a team of trial technicians who work closely together. We offer you stimulating and fun work with varying tasks throughout the year depending on the season. With us, you also get the opportunity to participate in developing the agriculture of the future! About you In order to succeed and thrive with us, you have an agricultural education or work experience in crop cultivation. B driving license is a requirement for the position, BE is desirable. We are looking for someone who has good knowledge of driving agricultural machinery and you should have a sprayer certificate. We are also looking for someone who has knowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivation. As a person, you have a great interest in crop cultivation/agriculture. You are meticulous, committed and quality conscious. You have the ability and enjoy working both independently and together with others. Of course you are driven and like challenges. Location: Borgeby or Helgegården. The position begins as a trial employment for 6 months Questions about the position? Feel free to call us and we will tell you more. Ulrika Dyrlund Martinsson, head of field trials 010-4762031, ulrika.dyrlundmartinsson@hushallningssallskapet.se Andreas Andersson, field trial leader, 010-4762054, andreas.andersson@hushallningssallskapet.se Johan Meyer, field trial leader, 010-4762038, johan.meyer@hushallningssallskapet.seDoes that sound interesting? Submit your application today as selection takes place continuously. Welcome with your application!RequirementsAgricultural education or work experience in crop cultivationB driver's license Meritorious BE driver's license Spraying certificateKnowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivationExperience in machine serviceGood knowledge of driving agricultural machineryAbout the employer - Husthalningsällskapet SkåneHushållningsällskapet is part of Sweden's history. The history stretches all the way back to 1791, when the country's first Household Society was established on Gotland. When we arrived over two hundred years ago, it was in a different Sweden, where agriculture formed the basis for the entire nation's prosperity. Back then, when famine was a reality in many Swedish households, new knowledge was needed for a more rational food production. Today, we continue to be an important actor that develops the green business life and to manage the earth's resources. Today, the Housekeeping Society consists of 15 independent societies that operate all over the country (the Housekeeping Society in Skåne is one of these). Just over 700 employees deal with advice, training, research and field trials and we have approx. 30,000 members. Our customers are in agriculture, forestry, public activities and other industries, mainly in rural areas. Together, we offer knowledge for the country's future. Please read more about us at https://hushallningssallskapet.se/

Syngenta seeds improve the quality and yields of crops. High-quality seeds ensure better and more productive crops, which is why farmers invest in them. Advanced seeds help mitigate risks such as disease and drought and allow farmers to grow food using less land, less water, and fewer inputs. Syngenta Seeds brings farmers more vigorous, stronger, resistant plants, including innovative hybrid varieties and biotech crops that can thrive even in challenging growing conditions. j.title: Jobb för maskinförare - sök nu!
j.description: Are you a passionate machine operator with a strong interest in agriculture? Do you want to work with state-of-the-art equipment and have a key role in potato production at one of Sweden's leading agricultural companies? With a workplace in Vinslöv, we offer you an exciting opportunity to contribute to success in a dynamic and forward-looking environment. This is the role for you who want to make a difference! input: What does it take to qualify for such a role?
actual_output:
Based on the data retrieved, the skills required for professionals in these research-focused agricultural roles include a mix of scientific expertise, technical competencies, and management capabilities.

The required skills include:

**Scientific and Research Expertise**
*   **Soil Science:** The study of soil as a natural resource, its characteristics, formation, and classification, as well as its physical, biological, and chemical potential.
*   **Botany:** Knowledge of plant life taxonomy, phylogeny, anatomy, morphology, and physiology.
*   **Genomics:** Researching genomes and genetic sequences to analyze biological functions using bioinformatics and recombinant DNA.
*   **Entomology:** The study of insects.
*   **Life Sciences:** Studying processes related to cells, molecules, and living organisms.
*   **Biological Chemistry:** A medical and scientific specialty related to chemical processes in living organisms.
*   **Integrated Pest Management (IPM):** An approach to suppressing harmful organisms that minimizes risks to human health and the environment.
*   **Research Improvement of Crop Yields:** Studying production methods to optimize planting, gathering, and cultivation.

**Technical and Agricultural Principles**
*   **Crop Production Principles:** Understanding natural cycles, growth conditions, and organic/sustainable production requirements for seeds and plants.
*   **Conservation Agriculture:** Applying techniques like permanent soil cover, minimum soil disturbance, and plant diversification.
*   **Apply Precision Farming:** Utilizing modern technologies, geo-mapping, and automated steering for agricultural activities.
*   **Agricultural Equipment:** Knowledge of machinery, their functionalities, and regulatory requirements.
*   **E-agriculture:** Applying innovative ICT solutions to agriculture and livestock management.
*   **Bioeconomy:** Converting renewable biological resources into value-added products like food, feed, and bioenergy.

**Management and Analytical Skills**
*   **Ecosystem Management:** Considering the impact of management decisions on the broader ecosystem and optimizing strategies for complex landscapes.
*   **Operational Research:** Applying scientific methods to solve administrative and management issues in organized systems.
*   **Analyse Environmental Data:** Interpreting correlations between human activities and their environmental effects.
*   **Develop Statistical Software:** Participating in the development of computer programs for statistical and econometric analysis.
*   **Energy Efficiency:** Calculating energy consumption and promoting energy-saving or renewable energy strategies.

**Professional Competencies**
*   **Demonstrate Curiosity:** Showing an active interest in exploring and discovering new areas.
*   **Develop Creative Ideas:** Formulating new concepts and innovative approaches.
*   **Communication:** Proficiency in **English**, as well as the ability to provide information on study programs.
*   **General Workplace Duties:** The ability to assign duties to workers, prepare raw materials, label samples, maintain electromechanical equipment, and ensure gender equality in the workplace.

input: Are there any other occupations that require expertise in agricultural production?
actual_output:
Although there is no information exactly related to your specific research query, I have the following information from the database regarding occupations that require expertise in agricultural production:

*   **Horticulture production team leader:** Leads teams and organises daily work schedules for the production of horticulture crops.
*   **Fruit production team leader:** Leads teams and organises daily work schedules for the production of fruit crops.
*   **Soil scientist:** Researches scientific disciplines concerning soil and advises on how to improve soil quality to support food production and land restoration.
*   **Horticulture production manager:** Plans production, manages the enterprise, and participates in horticultural production.
*   **Drone pilot:** Operates unmanned aerial vehicles equipped with sensors or cameras to calculate data related to agricultural sites.
*   **Agriculture, forestry and fishery vocational teacher:** Instructs students in practical skills and techniques required for these professions.
*   **Livestock worker:** Maintains the health and welfare of animals and oversees day-to-day care such as feeding.
*   **Agronomic crop production team leader:** Leads a team of crop production workers and organises daily production schedules.
*   **Crop production manager:** Plans production, manages the enterprise, and participates in the production process of crop facilities.
*   **Farm manager:** Plans and organises the daily operations, resourcing, and business management of animal and crop-producing farms.
*   **Mixed farmer:** Manages all aspects of livestock and crop production, either for a small enterprise or for self-sufficiency.
*   **Agricultural inspector:** Monitors agricultural operations to ensure health, safety, and production processes comply with legislation and standards.

input: Can you show me relevant job opportunities for those occupations as well?
actual_output:
Based on the records in our database, here are relevant job opportunities corresponding to roles involving agricultural production expertise:

### **Farm and Operations Management**
*   **Betriebsleiter (m/w/d) im Obstbau:** A management role focusing on sustainable fruit production, irrigation technology, and crop protection management.
*   **Station Manager (Rijk Zwaan Hellas):** An agronomist role managing a 4.2 ha experimental station, providing technical support to horticultural crops, and managing production.
*   **Gårdsansvarig (Farm Manager):** Overall responsibility for daily operations, maintenance of buildings/machines, and oversight of crops and garden management at Roslätt farm.
*   **Head of culture (Cultivation Manager):** Supervises a team of 4, organizes agricultural work (tillage to harvest), and manages machinery for a 630-hectare farm producing cereals, beets, and potatoes.
*   **Operations manager (SLU Lanna):** Leads day-to-day work, strategic planning, and budget responsibility for a research property, working closely with researchers and students.

### **Production and Team Leadership**
*   **Produktionsledare/Driftledare (Svartsjö):** A central production role focused on cattle (Hereford) and crop cultivation. Includes guiding and supervising inmates as part of their daily occupation.
*   **Teamledare Frukt och Grönt (City Gross):** A leadership role in supermarket fruit and vegetable departments, focusing on purchases, store economics, and department replenishment.
*   **MANAGER OF PRODUCTION (Miliora Farm SA):** Manages a modern sheep breeding unit with 2700 milking animals, requiring expertise in animal production.

### **Technical and Specialized Roles**
*   **Agricultural Technician (M/F):** Missions include preparing land for sowing, treating crops, maintaining agricultural machinery, and assisting the farm manager.
*   **Tractor and Machine Operator (Widegrens Gård):** Full-time roles focusing on organic cultivation (potatoes, onions, carrots, cereals). Responsibilities include plowing, sowing, mechanical weed control, and irrigation.
*   **Växtodlingsrådgivare (Crop Cultivation Advisor):** Provides expert advice to agricultural companies on crop cultivation, nutrition, and economics; prepares SAM applications and organizes customer meetings.
*   **Försöksassistent (Experimental Assistant):** Supports plant cultivation experiments at Lanna research station, including soil sampling, measurement of gas emissions, and sample handling.
*   **Agronomic R&D Specialist (Agrology):** Focuses on the development of innovative products, experimentation, and technical support for crop nutrition and plant protection.
*   **Syngenta Group China Scientist:** A high-level research role driving innovation in seeds, crop protection, and crop nutrition.

### **Animal Care and Specialized Livestock**
*   **Pig keeper (Mellomgården):** Manages animal health, box hygiene, and documentation in a modern facility with 4,000 slaughter pig places.
*   **Poultry worker (M/F):** Tasks include animal care, egg collection, monitoring embryonic development, and maintaining facility cleanliness.
*   **Animal care employee/assistant:** Focused on the well-being of farm animals, facility hygiene, and general farm/garden maintenance.
*   **Djurskyddshandläggare (Animal Welfare Officer):** Performs inspections and controls on farms to ensure compliance with animal welfare, feed, and food legislation.

### **Education and Agricultural Services**
*   **Naturbrukskolan Uddetorp (Agricultural Personnel):** Combines farm operations (dairy cows, young animals, crops) with instructing students in the craft of farming.
*   **Administrators and advisors (County Board):** Focuses on farm animal husbandry, planning competence-enhancing activities (courses/meetings), and coordinating skills development for farmers.
*   **Versatile agricultural worker (M/F):** Supports farm managers in mixed crop and livestock settings, performing field work, harvesting, and machinery maintenance.

title: Försöksassistent
description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? Do you want varied work in an agricultural environment? Before 2025, we have several new exciting attempts where we need the help of interested seasonal staff. We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. About the job The tasks are above all to help with tasks that occur in our plant cultivation experiments, such as weighing seed and fertilizer, measuring experimental areas, carrying out various agricultural measures, carrying out soil sampling and crop, i.a. frequent measurements of gas emissions. There is also some work with sample handling, packaging of samples and maintenance of equipment. During intensive periods in crop cultivation, some evening work may be relevant. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. Experience of driving tractors, agricultural implements, drones and various measuring equipment is advantageous. The work requires accuracy and the ability to understand both oral and written instructions in Swedish. B driving license is a requirement. In the selection, great importance was attached to the applicant's personal suitability. About usLanna research station outside Skara conducts field experiments for researchers within SLU and for other actors. The business has a strong focus on precision farming, plant nutrition and stable manure and has many long-term trials. Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials.  Within the trial operations at Lanna, two people work full-time and 1-2 seasonal employees with the field operations. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. The Lanna research station is part of the Department of Soil and Environment, which is a leading soil science center, both nationally and internationally. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. We form part of SLU's Land, Water and Environment Center (MVM center), with close contacts to environmental analysis and research on e.g. water, cycle and bioenergy. The business contributes to meeting national environmental and climate goals and the UN's global sustainability goals. The department is located at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and at Skara. Read more about the department here (https://www.slu.se/mark). Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa -slu/Location: Lanna, trial cultivation outside Lidköping Form of employment: Temporary employment approx. 6 months Scope: 60% - 100% Access: 2025-04-01 or according to agreement. Application: Welcome with your application via the application button below no later than 2025-01-31. Union contact persons: https://internt.slu.se/min-anstallning/facket/kontaktpersons/Sveriges lantbruksuniversitet (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has roughly 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

title: Operations manager SLU Lanna Property
description: Do you want to become a key player for the future of crop cultivation in Sweden? As an operations manager at Lanna property, you have a unique opportunity to develop our operations in close proximity to research, experiments and students. We are looking for you who have a great interest in plant cultivation and want to contribute to SLU's promise of science and education for sustainable living. About the job You are offered varied work with great personal responsibility and many exciting development opportunities both within SLU and in the industry. As operations manager, you are responsible for the property's operations, which start from the Lanna research station west of Skara. You lead the day-to-day work and are active in the field yourself. You are also driving the strategic work on the property and have budget responsibility. As operations manager, you have many contacts within the university, with landowners, various authorities and the public. Together with the operations managers on the other properties and the agricultural manager, you also develop SLU's agricultural operations. Your background We are looking for you who want to drive and develop agricultural enterprises. You have higher education in the field of agriculture, or have acquired equivalent knowledge through experience. You are experienced and knowledgeable when it comes to crop cultivation, operational economics, machinery and maintenance. You are interested in agricultural data and technology development, and are used to working with planning and follow-up tools for plant cultivation. Knowledge of forestry is an advantage and we would like you to have chainsaw driver's license A & B. You enjoy the role of planning and leading the work and developing the work team. You are a good communicator and have the ability to create trust, collaborate and develop relationships with others, both in Swedish and English. We would like to see that you have an interest in sustainability issues in agriculture. You have a B driving license and authorization for plant protection 1L-2L. About us The Lanna property comprises approximately 310 ha of conventional crop cultivation distributed over Lanna, Brogården and Götala in Lidköping and Skara municipalities. Crop cultivation produces cereals, sorghum and oilseeds sales and roughage to the Götala research center. The business is based in Lanna, but also has staff quarters and a workshop in Götala, where SLU also uses approx. 170 ha of forest under the auspices of the property. In addition to this, the property is responsible for certain maintenance of green areas for SLU Skara. In addition to the operations manager, two machine operators also work on the Lanna property. The Lanna property belongs to SLU's agricultural operation, which has a total of 11 employees on SLU's four properties Ultuna, Alnarp, Lanna (Skara) and Hallfreda (Gotland). The agricultural operation's mission is to cultivate and manage some of SLU's main research and teaching resources: the earth, the forest and its data. All employees are offered a security package including wellness compensation. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has roughly 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and PhD students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

id: 1788922
title: Produktionsledare/Driftledare med inriktning dikor och växtodling Svartsjö
description: The correctional service is growing - we are building new, rebuilding and building more and are now looking for more employees. Our most important goal is to reduce recidivism - to break the vicious cycle. If we succeed in that, society will be safer and more secure for everyone. We are the authority responsible for prisons, probation, custody and client transport. Do you want to know more? Hear what our employees think about working within the Correctional Service: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/We are now looking for a new colleague for Svartsjö agriculture, which belongs to the Stockholm West business area, located in Ekerö municipality. It is possible to get to work via both the south and west side of Stockholm. About 170 employees and ten managers manage, lead and develop the business, which receives approx. 270 inmates. Agriculture is part of the clients' daily occupation during its execution. The farm covers 400 hectares, of which 310 hectares are arable land and 90 hectares are pasture. Farming includes 250 hectares of grain and 60 hectares of paddy, as well as fodder crops such as wheat, oats, peas, broad beans and canola.  The farm has a breeding herd of the Hereford breed. We get around 75 calves per season and have around 160 animals in total. The machinery park is modern with GPS technology and a workshop for service. The business also includes firewood production, vegetable growing, green area maintenance and carpentry. There are well-equipped staff areas with gyms and charging stations. JOB DUTIES As a production manager/operations manager, you get a central and inspiring role where you are primarily responsible for the animals together with three colleagues. During the crop growing season, you broaden your role and collaborate with the team on the crop growing side, which includes more other colleagues. The daily work is carried out by the institution's inmates, and you become an important role model who, with your commitment, motivates and guides them in their working life. You will have a workforce of approx. 10-15 clients depending on the season. Here you have the chance to influence and make a difference to contribute to the Correctional Service's vision Better out. The role is both diverse and eventful, and it requires good basic physics because the tasks are often physically demanding. Here you get the opportunity to work hands-on and develop together with committed colleagues all while making a real difference. Working as a production manager means that you contribute to a better society. In order to enjoy and succeed in your assignment, it is important that you share the Prison Service's basic values ​​of a humane view of people, respect for the individual and the belief that people can be developed. has practical experience and a strong interest in work management in animal husbandry and crop cultivation. As a production manager, you have clear and pedagogical insight into how best to introduce and supervise inmates from the institution, while actively participating in the tasks yourself. You are also welcome to apply for the position if you are only interested in working with the animals. We have the opportunity to send staff on training courses that are relevant to being able to cope with the tasks, in addition to this, we have a solid individual introduction. We attach great importance to personal suitability. We are looking for you who have: • High school education or other education, preferably in nature management, agriculture and animal care in combination with work experience • Good knowledge of the Swedish language both spoken and written • B driving license It is advantageous if you have :• Work experience from a managerial role, preferably operations manager, barn foreman or farm manager• Experience as an animal keeper with experience from a cattle and/or dairy herd or other animal husbandry in agriculture and equine farming• Knowledge in semining• Experience with cattle, including practical calving experience• Experience in crop cultivation• Forklift license or other driver's license such as wheel loader, clearing saw, chainsaw OTHERWe place high demands on our employees' security and privacy awareness. To work with us, you need to undergo a security assessment in accordance with the Security Protection Act. For this position, a security screening interview will be conducted before a decision on employment is made. During the security check, you as a person, your background and your relationships are investigated from a security perspective. In connection with your employment interview, you will receive more information about security clearance. Read more about the security check at: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/rekryteringsprocessen/sakerhetsprovning-vid-rekrytering/Kriminalvården strives for an even gender distribution and increased diversity. Probationary employment may be applied. To submit your application, click on the application link in the advertisement. Ask questions about how to apply and submit your CV directly to Visma Recruit. Questions about specific jobs are answered by the contact person specified in the advertisement. We kindly but firmly refrain from direct contact with staffing and recruitment companies and sellers of recruitment advertisements. The Correctional Service has procured contracts.
