id: 1749919
title: Djurskyddshandläggare med fokus på lantbrukets djur
description: The county board is the government's representative in the county and coordinates the regional development work. We work with issues relating to environmental and nature conservation, rural areas, social planning, animal protection, preparedness, equality, integration and cultural environment. We work actively for the county's development and coordinate various social sectors. In our work, we protect legal certainty, openness, equal treatment and good service. The County Administrative Board in Halland County has its office in central Halmstad and we are today approx. 230 employees. For more information see our website, www.lansstyrelsen.se/halland. Halland is an expansive county with extensive animal husbandry of various kinds where the County Administrative Board is the regional expert authority in, among other things, animal protection, infection control, feed and food. We are looking for one or more animal protection officers there the position/s are located at the Veterinary Unit, where we have approximately 20 employees. A large part of the unit's activities includes animal welfare control. We are now looking for an animal welfare officer with a permanent position. Job duties We offer stimulating and varied work where you will mainly work with animal welfare control of the farm's animals. Within animal welfare control, you work with routine checks, notification checks and follow-ups of previously identified deficiencies. You carry out the checks on the farms normally as a sole administrator. You are responsible for the entire case management such as control, drawing up control reports, registration, injunctions and any other decisions. You may also carry out controls within feed and food in primary production, transport inspections, answer the public's questions and receive notifications in the unit's contact phone for animal welfare. The position may also involve other tasks that occur, such as work with food supply and drinking water. You will be part of a work group and have a close collaboration with approx. 9 people. Other work areas within the unit may also be relevant and you therefore need to have an interest and desire to develop within the unit's other operational areas as well. Qualifications You have an academic education that is relevant to the work , for example pet agronomist specializing in farm animals, farm manager specializing in animal production or other education and experience that the employer deems appropriate. We would like to see that you have experience with livestock-producing animals by having worked on a farm, been an advisor, worked as an animal welfare inspector or similar. It is positive if you have experience of having worked with preparedness issues in food and drinking water. This position requires that you have good computer skills and basic knowledge of Microsoft Office. A B driver's license is required for this position. As the work as an animal welfare officer can sometimes be psychologically stressful, it is important that you have personal maturity, are confident in yourself and can distinguish between the personal and the exercise of authority. You need to be good at working independently and that you are calm, stable and controlled in stressful and pressured situations and you must have an empathic ability so you can put yourself in someone else's perspective. It is also important that you are service-oriented and accommodating while at the same time being a strong person who is able to set the requirements needed to achieve good animal husbandry within the framework of the legislation. It is important that you have the ability to work quickly and efficiently with the legislation in focus. As a large part of the tasks are based on good communication skills, it is important that you can express yourself well in speech and writing. We attach great importance to your personal suitability and your ability to contribute to a good work environment. Other We can offer:- A exciting workplace with broad competence - An opportunity to contribute to important social tasks - Possibility of remote work if the business allows - Wellness with wellness hour We know that diversity enriches and are looking for you who can complement our team with your competence, experience and personality. We ask you to apply for the position through the link in this advertisement to facilitate our handling of incoming applications and to ensure the quality of our selection process. It is of the utmost importance that you are thorough when you fill in your application, as it is assessed against an established skills profile as well as against other applicants. The application for the position is made via our recruitment system. We have actively selected media for advertising and refrain from all offers of advertising and recruitment assistance in connection with this recruitment. The County Administrative Board applies a six-month trial period for this employment. The position may be placed in security class and in in that case, we carry out a security check with a register check in accordance with the provisions of the Security Protection Act before the position is taken up. You will be part of the County Administrative Board's crisis management and war organization. This means that you will be placed at war. You can find information about how we handle your personal data at www.lansstyrelsen.se/dataskydd.

title: Summer job 2025;     Tractor driver for Widegrens Gård on Gotland
description: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation where you contribute to trying to get the crop to reach its full potential. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you get warm in your clothes. It is a prerequisite that you have experience of driving agricultural machinery, that you can perform them with skill without damaging either the crop, the machine or the surroundings. Your attitude and desire to develop with us is strong and the commitment to do your best is a matter of course. .The position can be filled before the application deadline.Joining date for the position by agreement based on how your conditions look like for the coming summer.Salary according to increase.For the right applicant who currently does not live on Gotland, we can actively help find accommodation through our local network, several people in our existing team have come from the mainland in recent years. input: Are there any openings for a crop production worker?
actual_output:
Yes, there are several openings for roles related to crop production and agricultural work. Based on the provided database, here are the relevant positions:

*   **Versatile agricultural worker (M/F):** Several agencies (such as Aquila RH Blain and Aquila RH Tarbes) are looking for versatile agricultural workers to perform tasks like soil preparation, sowing, crop protection, weeding, harvesting, and machinery maintenance.
*   **Operations manager / Machine operator (Crop cultivation):**
    *   **Åkerö Förvaltning AB:** Looking for an operations manager for 1100 hectares of conventional plant cultivation.
    *   **Östergårds Grönsaker AB:** Seeking machine operators for potato and grain production (Vinslöv).
    *   **SLU Ultuna/Lanna:** Hiring machine operators and an operations manager for crop cultivation and trial operations.
    *   **Naturbrukskolan Uddetorp:** Hiring agricultural operations personnel for their conventional farm and crop cultivation.
*   **Experimental/Field trial positions:**
    *   **Hushållningssällskapet Skåne:** Hiring for plant cultivation attempts/experimental techniques at various locations including Skåne, Borgeby, and Helgegården.
    *   **SLU (Department of Land and Environment / Plant Production Ecology):** Seeking seasonal "Försöksassistent" (experimental assistant) and "Försökstekniker" (experimental technician) for field trials in Lanna and Umeå.
*   **Specialized roles:**
    *   **Lantbruksarbetare för ekologisk odling av indiska grönsaker:** A farm is looking for an agricultural worker specialized in Indian vegetables and organic cultivation.
    *   **Seasonal employee for organic vegetable cultivation (Gotland):** Hiring for sowing, planting, weeding, and harvesting.
    *   **Nursery schoolist (Billbäcks Nursery):** Performing tree cultivation, fertilization, planting, and maintenance.
    *   **Klahammar:** Hiring an employee for a farm focusing on cereals, oil plants, and seeds.
*   **Management and Advisory roles:**
    *   **Swedish Board of Agriculture (Jordbruksverket):** Hiring crop cultivation advisors and administrative roles in plant protection and robust crop cultivation (locations include Skara, Linköping, Jönköping, and Landskrona).
    *   **Växa:** Looking for an Expert in sustainability with a focus on forage and crop cultivation.
    *   **Rijk Zwaan Hellas:** Hiring an agronomist as a Station Manager for horticultural production.

Please note that these positions have different application deadlines and requirements (such as B-driver's licenses, education in agriculture, or specific certifications like sprayer certificates). You may need to review the specific job titles in the provided list to find the contact details or application links for the role that best matches your location and experience.

j.title: Försökstekniker
j.description: The Department of Plant Production Ecology We are looking for an experimental technician for Röbäcksdalen's field research station, Umeå. Do you want to contribute to the development of Swedish agriculture by participating and testing agricultural issues in field experiments? Do you enjoy solving problems and are you service oriented? Then this position at SLU in Umeå could be something for you. We are now looking for an employee who can contribute to continued development and management of the business. Together with colleagues, you will carry out research-oriented special trials, testing of new breeding material of forage crops, straw grain and potatoes as well as long-range cultivation system, fertility and tillage trials. All this is carried out under field conditions within both conventional and organic cultivation systems. About the job The main work task will consist of the establishment and maintenance and harvesting of field trials in the field of crop cultivation, but participation in departmental joint activities and assisting and supervising temporary field staff are examples of other tasks that may occur .During the crop growing season, the work mainly takes place in the field. The tasks then mainly include planning and implementation of practical steps linked to the experiments. Important work steps are then tillage, sowing, crop protection measures and harvesting, but the work also consists of weighing seed and fertilizer, simpler measurements in the field, grading and sampling of soil and plant material. Between the growing seasons, we work at the experimental station mainly with result processing, follow-up and documentation of trials, planning for the coming season, technical maintenance of machines, development of trial methodology and planning of future trials together with researchers and other trial orderers. The work is teamwork, where responsibility is distributed within the group, and where communication and cooperation are crucial for a successful result. Please note that due to the relatively short growing season, the work is intensive, occasionally physically demanding and irregular working hours and overtime work occur during the growing season. Your background We are looking for you who:• is interested in research and development• appreciates collaborating with researchers and companies• is technically interested and who easily adopts new technology• wants to work practically on a agriculturally oriented experimental station• enjoys working outdoors• can work independently• is meticulous It is required that you:• be educated in the field of agriculture (agricultural high school or agrotechnician, land surveyor or agronomist training or equivalent)• have good computer skills• command spoken and written Swedish and can communicate in English• holds a B driving license It is advantageous if you have practical agricultural experience in crop cultivation or hold authorization to use plant protection products (class 1L-2L).We will attach great importance to your personal qualities, such as cooperativeness, accuracy and independence.About usThe Department of Plant Production Ecology contributes to solutions through research, collaboration and education about sustainable plant production. We train and research plants for food, feed and energy. The research examines how different production methods, cultivation environments and systems affect yields and other ecosystem services, as well as product quality and the surrounding environment. The department has operations in both Uppsala and Umeå and is also responsible for the Lövsta and Röbäcksdalen field stations. Röbäcksdalen is a research center close to the city that is a unique environment for applied research in environmental, ecological and agricultural sciences. Röbäcksdalen's research station is part of the Swedish Research Council's investment, Swedish Infrastructure for Ecosystem Sciences, (SITES).Umeå comes at the top of the Fokus magazine's ranking of where in the country it is best to live "Umeå is Sweden's best municipality to live in": https://www.umea.se/flytta/arkiv/arkiv/nyheter/umeaarsverigesbastakommunattlevai.5.7811aed19029012e82a7a2.htmlMore information about the department/department: https://www.slu.se/institutioner/vaxtproduktionsekologi/resurser/robacksdalens-faltforskningsstation/ Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/Location: Röbäcksdalen field research station, Umeå Form of employment: Permanent employment. SLU may apply probationary employment.Scope:100% Access:Spring 2025, or as agreed.Application:Welcome with your application via the application button below by 2025-01-19 at the latest.Union contact persons:https://internt.slu.se/min -employment/union/contact persons/Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interactions between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has just over 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

j.title: Vi söker växtodlingsrådgivare till växtskyddscentralen i Landskrona
j.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,850 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. We work actively to ensure that our employees are sustainable and happy at work! We invest long-term in our employees and want them to develop together with us! We offer a good working environment with generous benefits with up to 35 vacation days, wellness allowance and wellness time. In a large part of our employment, we offer flexible working hours, the possibility to work mobile and to work parts of the working time remotely. Read more about what it is like to work at the Swedish Agricultural Agency on our website: www.jordbruksverket.se/jobbahosossARBETSUPPGIFTERWe are looking for two crop cultivation advisors to The Swedish Agricultural Agency's plant protection centers in Landskrona. For the first position, we are looking for someone who has a few years' experience as a consultant and wants to take responsibility, influence and plan the operations for the Plant Protection Center in Landskrona. For the second position, we are looking for you who want to develop your skills as an advisor, work in the field and take responsibility for diagnoses connected to lab operations. For both positions, this means that you actively influence and contribute to how we achieve our goals with an integrated plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increasing food production. You will collaborate and exchange experiences with colleagues at other plant protection centers as well as with colleagues at other units within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture. Your main task is to support the existing advice with basis built on a scientific basis. You contribute to the development of integrated plant protection through independent advice and basis for need-based control. The services include, among other things:• Compiling and conveying Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy • Follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, as well as participate in digital weekly meetings for advisors about the current plant protection situation • Contribute to increased awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems The work involves many contacts, mainly national but also some international. Within the Environment and Climate Knowledge Hub, which includes the plant protection centre, we work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. This means that you can also have the opportunity to work with other tasks in the field of plant protection. This could be, for example, participating in investigations, contingency planning or issues related to the ongoing climate change. You should therefore be able to manage a flexible way of working and be able to quickly adapt to changed tasks based on new priorities. QUALIFICATIONS Common to the two positions is that we are looking for you who are an agronomist with a focus on soil/plants, horticulturist, farm manager or have equivalent education. You have good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops and are well acquainted with the conditions for agriculture in Sweden. The work is about supporting the counseling by acquiring and conveying knowledge. It is therefore important that you have the ability to collaborate and communicate in a clear and professional manner in order to get your message across. In order to achieve success, good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a prerequisite. For the first position, we also want you to have a few years' experience of working as a plant breeding advisor under Nordic conditions. You are stable in your role as an advisor and can handle stress in a constructive way. Environmental monitoring in the field of plant protection is also an important part of the work. For the second position, you are required to have experience and interest in working in a lab and knowledge of diagnostics for fungi and insects. You should be structured and be able to find solutions to problems that arise. The job includes some travel and a driver's license is a requirement for both positions. OTHER Location is Landskrona, alternatively Skara with the possibility to work some parts remotely. on the labor market are taken care of. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We normally apply a 6-month trial period. Before the recruitment work, we have taken a position on recruitment channels and marketing. We therefore do not want to be contacted by advertising vendors or recruitment companies.

j.title: Försöksassistent
j.description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? Do you want varied work in an agricultural environment? Before 2025, we have several new exciting attempts where we need the help of interested seasonal staff. We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. About the job The tasks are above all to help with tasks that occur in our plant cultivation experiments, such as weighing seed and fertilizer, measuring experimental areas, carrying out various agricultural measures, carrying out soil sampling and crop, i.a. frequent measurements of gas emissions. There is also some work with sample handling, packaging of samples and maintenance of equipment. During intensive periods in crop cultivation, some evening work may be relevant. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. Experience of driving tractors, agricultural implements, drones and various measuring equipment is advantageous. The work requires accuracy and the ability to understand both oral and written instructions in Swedish. B driving license is a requirement. In the selection, great importance was attached to the applicant's personal suitability. About usLanna research station outside Skara conducts field experiments for researchers within SLU and for other actors. The business has a strong focus on precision farming, plant nutrition and stable manure and has many long-term trials. Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials.  Within the trial operations at Lanna, two people work full-time and 1-2 seasonal employees with the field operations. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. The Lanna research station is part of the Department of Soil and Environment, which is a leading soil science center, both nationally and internationally. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. We form part of SLU's Land, Water and Environment Center (MVM center), with close contacts to environmental analysis and research on e.g. water, cycle and bioenergy. The business contributes to meeting national environmental and climate goals and the UN's global sustainability goals. The department is located at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and at Skara. Read more about the department here (https://www.slu.se/mark). Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa -slu/Location: Lanna, trial cultivation outside Lidköping Form of employment: Temporary employment approx. 6 months Scope: 60% - 100% Access: 2025-04-01 or according to agreement. Application: Welcome with your application via the application button below no later than 2025-01-31. Union contact persons: https://internt.slu.se/min-anstallning/facket/kontaktpersons/Sveriges lantbruksuniversitet (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has roughly 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and research students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

input: What skills are needed to perform that job successfully?
actual_output:
To perform the job of a crop production worker successfully, the following skills and competencies are required:

**Core Agricultural & Crop Production Skills:**
*   **Crop Production Principles:** Understanding natural cycles, nursing of nature, growth conditions, and requirements for seeds and plants.
*   **Agronomy:** Knowledge of agricultural production, protection, and regeneration of the natural environment, including sustainable application methods.
*   **Soil and Plant Knowledge:** Understanding soil structure, plant species characteristics, and plant propagation methods.
*   **Harvesting & Planting:** Knowledge of plant harvest methods, preparation of planting areas (fertilizing, mulching, sowing), and plant propagation.

**Technical & Maintenance Skills:**
*   **Technical Equipment:** Ability to maintain, service, and adjust machinery used for crop production.
*   **Machinery Operation:** Proficiency in operating motorized equipment such as tractors, balers, sprayers, plows, mowers, and combines.
*   **Irrigation:** Knowledge of watering principles and the ability to irrigate soil using pipes, sprinklers, or ditches, as well as specific techniques like alternate wetting and drying.
*   **Storage Facilities:** Knowledge of storage quality criteria, facility maintenance (temperature/hygiene control), and proper crop storage techniques.

**Pest and Disease Management:**
*   **Integrated Pest Management (IPM):** An approach to preventing/suppressing harmful organisms while minimizing pesticide use.
*   **Disease & Pest Control:** Identifying and controlling pests and diseases using conventional or biological methods in accordance with safety and environmental regulations.
*   **Modern Technology:** Ability to use pest detection sensors (such as image or acoustic sensors) and agricultural information systems/databases.

**Sustainability & Management:**
*   **Agroecology & Organic Farming:** Applying ecological concepts and principles to production, including organic farming techniques.
*   **Conservation Agriculture:** Applying techniques that minimize soil disturbance and maintain permanent soil cover.
*   **Sustainable Tillage:** Using methods like conservation tillage or no-till farming to reduce soil impact.
*   **Management & Processing:** Ability to assign duties to workers, monitor fields, perform on-farm product processing, and present farm facilities to customers.

**General Practices:**
*   **Fertilization:** Execution of fertilization tasks according to instructions and safety/environmental regulations.
*   **Driving:** Ability to drive tractors and forklifts for transport and field maneuvering.
*   **Monitoring:** Assessing crops for growth forecasts and weather-related damage.

input: Which other occupations require practical agronomical crop production experience?
actual_output:
Although there is no information exactly related to your query about specific job openings, I can provide you with the list of occupations from the database that share the skill of agronomical crop production.

The following occupations involve practical involvement in the production process and may require experience in the field:

*   **Agronomic crop production team leader:** Responsible for leading a team of workers, organizing daily work schedules for crop production, and participating in the production process.
*   **Crop production manager:** Responsible for planning production, managing the enterprise, and actively participating in the production process of crop production facilities.
*   **Farm manager:** Responsible for planning and organizing the daily operations, resourcing, and business management of farms producing crops and animals.
*   **Mixed farmer:** Manages all aspects of livestock and crop production, either as a small enterprise or for self-sufficiency.
*   **Horticulture production team leader:** Leads a team and organizes daily work schedules specifically for the production of horticulture crops, while also participating in production.

input: I am interested in jobs involving practical crop cultivation and farming activities. Are there any available?
actual_output:
Yes, there are several job opportunities available that involve practical crop cultivation and farming activities. Here are some of the positions listed:

*   **Farm worker/excavator (Drakalida):** Involves working with crop cultivation, harvesting work, and excavator tasks. Requires interest in machines and problem-solving.
*   **Gårdsansvarig (Roslätt farm):** A farm manager role with overall responsibility for daily operations, including gardens, crops, and maintenance of buildings and machines.
*   **Head of culture (near Amiens):** Acts as the right arm of the production manager, focusing on the organization and monitoring of agricultural work (tillage to harvest), team supervision, and maintenance of the agricultural machinery fleet.
*   **Lantbruksarbetare för ekologisk odling av indiska grönsaker:** Focuses on planting, tending, and harvesting Indian vegetables and herbs, as well as maintaining cultivation areas.
*   **Lantbruksarbete med fokus på växtodling och maskiner (Klahammar):** Employees perform all tasks occurring on the farm, focusing on crop cultivation during the growing season and animals, forest, and maintenance during winter.
*   **Maskinförare växtodling (Ultuna property):** A seasonal role (June–September 2025) involving tillage, transport, crop inspection, and machine work.
*   **Maskinförare, Lantarbetare (Öjeby Gård):** Involves tasks related to plant cultivation, machine service, building maintenance, and management of cattle.
*   **Medarbetare till Christinelunds Gård:** Involves variable work, including plant cultivation, repairs, maintenance, and animal husbandry for a dairy and energy-focused farm.
*   **Naturbrukskolan Uddetorp (Agricultural operations personnel):** Involves planning and carrying out customary agricultural tasks, crop cultivation, machinery work, and animal care. Includes instructing students.
*   **Operations manager SLU Lanna Property:** Leads day-to-day work, is active in the field, and manages machinery and maintenance for crop cultivation.
*   **Produktionsledare/Driftledare med inriktning dikor och växtodling (Svartsjö):** A central role responsible for animal husbandry (Hereford cattle) and crop cultivation, including supervising inmates in daily work.
*   **Summer job 2025: Tractor driver (Widegrens Gård):** Seasonal positions for tractor drivers to assist in intensive field work and crop cultivation tasks.
*   **Traktorförare Säsong 2025 (Framtidsgården Bjertorp):** Seasonal position (April–October) primarily managing operations on a crop farm, including tillage, grain/fodder transport, and sowing/harvesting experimental crops.
*   **Tractor and machine operator (Widegrens Gård):** A full-time, year-round position involving various crop cultivation tasks such as sowing, planting, mechanical weed control, ploughing, and harvesting root vegetables and cereals.

These roles vary in terms of location, contract type (seasonal vs. permanent), and specific responsibilities. Please refer to the specific job descriptions for contact information and application deadlines.

j.title: Operations manager SLU Lanna Property
j.description: Do you want to become a key player for the future of crop cultivation in Sweden? As an operations manager at Lanna property, you have a unique opportunity to develop our operations in close proximity to research, experiments and students. We are looking for you who have a great interest in plant cultivation and want to contribute to SLU's promise of science and education for sustainable living. About the job You are offered varied work with great personal responsibility and many exciting development opportunities both within SLU and in the industry. As operations manager, you are responsible for the property's operations, which start from the Lanna research station west of Skara. You lead the day-to-day work and are active in the field yourself. You are also driving the strategic work on the property and have budget responsibility. As operations manager, you have many contacts within the university, with landowners, various authorities and the public. Together with the operations managers on the other properties and the agricultural manager, you also develop SLU's agricultural operations. Your background We are looking for you who want to drive and develop agricultural enterprises. You have higher education in the field of agriculture, or have acquired equivalent knowledge through experience. You are experienced and knowledgeable when it comes to crop cultivation, operational economics, machinery and maintenance. You are interested in agricultural data and technology development, and are used to working with planning and follow-up tools for plant cultivation. Knowledge of forestry is an advantage and we would like you to have chainsaw driver's license A & B. You enjoy the role of planning and leading the work and developing the work team. You are a good communicator and have the ability to create trust, collaborate and develop relationships with others, both in Swedish and English. We would like to see that you have an interest in sustainability issues in agriculture. You have a B driving license and authorization for plant protection 1L-2L. About us The Lanna property comprises approximately 310 ha of conventional crop cultivation distributed over Lanna, Brogården and Götala in Lidköping and Skara municipalities. Crop cultivation produces cereals, sorghum and oilseeds sales and roughage to the Götala research center. The business is based in Lanna, but also has staff quarters and a workshop in Götala, where SLU also uses approx. 170 ha of forest under the auspices of the property. In addition to this, the property is responsible for certain maintenance of green areas for SLU Skara. In addition to the operations manager, two machine operators also work on the Lanna property. The Lanna property belongs to SLU's agricultural operation, which has a total of 11 employees on SLU's four properties Ultuna, Alnarp, Lanna (Skara) and Hallfreda (Gotland). The agricultural operation's mission is to cultivate and manage some of SLU's main research and teaching resources: the earth, the forest and its data. All employees are offered a security package including wellness compensation. More information about the institution/department: https://internal. sly see/Organisation-och-styrningen/organisation/gemensamma-verkehsamstodet/egendomsavdelningen/lantbruksdriften/Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at SLU at https://www. sly se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/Location: Lanna research station, Saleby, Lidköping Form of employment: Permanent employment. SLU may apply probationary employment. Scope: 100% Access: By agreement. Application: Welcome with your application via the application button below no later than 12/16/2024. Union contact persons: https://internal. sly see/my-anstalling/union/contacts/Swedish University of Agriculture (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, founded in science and education. Through our focus on the interplay between humans, animals and ecosystems and a responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable social development and good living conditions on our planet. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country. SLU has roughly 3,000 employees, 5,000 students and PhD students and a turnover of over three billion kroner. The university invests in attractive environments on its campus areas. We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

j.title: Sales manager north, Väktodling
j.description: Are you passionate about Swedish agriculture, are you a good leader with a strong business sense? Do you want to work in a driving role in crop cultivation and be active in the market? Then there is the chance to become our new sales manager at Swedish Agro!WHAT WILL YOU BE A PART OF?Swedish AgroSwedish Agro is undergoing strong growth and we are now looking for a driven sales manager in the field of crop cultivation with a location in one of our locations Skänninge, Skara, Enköping or Kumla . Swedish Agro is also looking for a trained Safety Advisor, which is meritorious competence for this position. At Swedish Agro, we create value for Swedish agriculture by being a comprehensive supplier for the individual farmer and offering inputs, feed and machinery of the highest quality. We represent the industry's leading machinery brands CLAAS, HORSCH, METSJÖ, RAUCH, SPEARHEAD, SCANSTONE, AVR, AGXEED and DALBO and have one of Europe's most modern feed factories that manufacture feed for several animal species. We have a common belief that we are stronger together and work for the long term, quality and profitability. YOUR AREA OF RESPONSIBILITY As a sales manager, you run the day-to-day sales, which means that you lead and support around 10 plant cultivation salespeople in their work by being a sounding board for business decisions. The role means that you will drive sales efficiency, coach both new and experienced salespeople and manage change processes within the organization. Support for the sellers includes follow-up of key figures, development of existing staff and conducting employee interviews. In the role, you will also have product manager responsibility for mineral fertilizers within Swedish Agro, and we thus see that you are to some extent active in the market with own customer responsibility and own sales targets. You thus have your own sales responsibility and work flexibly with the opportunity to both be out in the field and work from the office. As a sales manager, you report to the Sales Manager for plant cultivation Sweden. YOUR PROFILE As a person, you are driven and interested in business towards agriculture in order to create added value together with the customer and our salespeople. Experience or training in agriculture is essential to assume the role of Sales Manager in crop cultivation at Swedish Agro. Furthermore, we see that you are thorough, responsive and structured in your way of working and have a great interest in motivating and developing others. To thrive in the role, you have a coaching and supportive leadership style where you encourage your employees to take responsibility and initiative in their roles. You are also used to effectively, clearly and transparently communicating and reporting to management. We place great emphasis on your personal qualities and driving forces. Furthermore, we see that you have: At least 3-5 years of experience in the agricultural industry Experience in sales or trade (B2B) Proven leadership skills Merit with post-secondary education focusing on agronomist/farm manager/agrotechnician or similar Merit with experience in personnel responsibility Good knowledge of Swedish both verbally and writing B driving license WE OFFER Stronger together At Swedish Agro, our foundation is based on cooperation and we have a fundamental belief that we are stronger together. We thus offer a workplace where we develop together - across departments, skills and national borders. Our employees are our most important resource and we strive to create the best conditions for well-being, commitment and influence. ARE YOU INTERESTED? How to apply If you think the position sounds exciting, please send your application today or as soon as possible by clicking on "APPLY". We expect to hold interviews continuously and may stop the search when the right candidate has been found. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Patrik Persson, Sales Manager, Swedish Agro on 072-535 30 17. AN INTERNATIONAL GROUP We want to create value! For agriculture, for the farmer and for our employees. Swedish Agro is part of the Danish Agro group, with more than 5,000 colleagues spread over 100 companies in 15 countries. From the field to the screen, our employees are at the core of our ability to create value and develop the agriculture of the future and ensure that we can play a decisive role in the industry's digital and green transition - and that we help the farmer grow world-class food every day. We do this by strengthening, growing and developing the industry - and not least each other. And we need you too! Are you more curious about the Danish Agro group? Watch our group film here!

j.title: Tractor and machine operator for Widegrens Gård on Gotland
j.description: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. You who apply to us should enjoy teamwork in a lively environment with lots of humor and laughter in a serious world between too little or too much rain at the right or wrong time. About the positionWe are now looking for new important pieces of the puzzle for our cultivation team! The team currently consists of 12 machine operators, but when this year's cultivation season is over, two valued employees in the team move on to their own businesses. It is the most common reason that people leave us, they come from agricultural school or another job and stay with us for a few years and then move on to their own business. You should be very interested in crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation such as, for example, rotary harrowing, sowing of root vegetables, planting potatoes and onions, stone rowing, mechanical weed control, harrowing, chopping, milling and cupping, ploughing, cultivation, sowing of cereals, harvesting of potatoes and root vegetables, transport of products from fields to our cold storage, moving and commissioning irrigation machines and much more. The growing season with us runs roughly between 1 April- 15 November and as a machine operator with us, during this period you are basically all the time in a tractor in a field to help the crops reach their full potential. At other times of the year, it is service and maintenance of the machinery in the workshop, improvements to outbuildings, trucking and transport between our various warehouses. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you have warmed up in the clothes. It is a prerequisite that you have experience driving agricultural machines, that you can drive them skillfully without damaging either the crop, the machine or the surroundings. Your attitude and desire to develop with us is strong and the commitment to do your part the best is a matter of course. You are welcome to describe yourself as driven, humorous, in a good mood even if you are busy and that you have your heart in the relationship with colleagues, products and partners. The position is a full-time position all year round. the application is positive. The position can be filled before the application deadline. Entry date for the position by agreement based on how your conditions look today but no later than 15 March 2025. Salary according to increase. For the right applicant who does not currently live on Gotland, we can actively help find accommodation through our local network, several people in our existing team have come from the mainland in recent years. The application is emailed to jobb@widegrens.se

input: What other occupations make use of crop production knowledge?
actual_output:
Although there is no information exactly related to your original question regarding requirements for every single previously mentioned job, the database provides a list of various occupations that incorporate crop production knowledge or involve practical activities related to the field.

Here are the occupations from the database that make use of knowledge related to crop production and agriculture:

*   **Agronomic crop production team leader:** Responsible for leading teams, organizing daily work schedules, and participating in crop production.
*   **Agronomist:** Provides consulting on food and horticultural crop cultivation; studies the science, technology, and business of growing plants to improve yields.
*   **Biotechnical technician:** Assists scientists in research, development, and testing of biotechnology in laboratory settings.
*   **Crop production manager:** Plans production, manages enterprises, and participates in the production process.
*   **Crop production worker:** Carries out practical activities and assists in the production of agronomical crops.
*   **Drone pilot:** Remotely operates UAVs, including the use of cameras and sensors for agricultural monitoring.
*   **Fruit production team leader:** Leads teams and organizes daily schedules for fruit crop production.
*   **Groundsman/groundswoman:** Provides landscape services and maintains grounds for various public and private facilities.
*   **Hop farmer:** Plants, cultivates, and harvests hops for commodity production.
*   **Horticulture production manager:** Plans, manages, and participates in horticultural production.
*   **Horticulture production team leader:** Leads teams and organizes daily schedules for horticultural crop production.
*   **Horticulture worker:** Carries out practical activities in nurseries or greenhouses for horticultural crop production.
*   **Land-based machinery supervisor:** Plans and organizes machinery services for agricultural production and landscaping.
*   **Landscape gardener:** Plans, constructs, and maintains parks, gardens, and green spaces.
*   **Livestock advisor:** Provides specialist advice to farmers and breeders to optimize production (including business and livestock).
*   **Mixed farmer:** Manages all aspects of livestock and crop production for small enterprises or self-sufficiency.
*   **Monk/nun:** In some contexts, they live in self-sufficient monasteries and take part in daily work.
*   **Soil scientist:** Studies soil science; advises on improving soil quality for food production, nature, and infrastructure through irrigation and conservation techniques.

input: Are there any job opportunities for a land-based machinery supervisor?
actual_output:
Based on the provided information, there are no job listings explicitly titled "land-based machinery supervisor." However, there are positions focused on the supervision and management of agricultural machinery and field operations.

The following roles are currently available:

*   **Foreman, Agricultural machinery (Swedish Agro, Skara):** This role involves leading and distributing work in the workshop and in the field, supporting the technical team of 10 technicians, administering work orders, and managing machine logistics. It requires technical interest, knowledge of heavy machinery, and experience in the agricultural/machinery industry.
*   **Cultivation Manager (near Amiens):** This role acts as the "right arm of the production manager" and includes the supervision of a team of 4 employees, managing agricultural sites, and overseeing the operation and maintenance of the agricultural machinery fleet (John Deere equipment).
*   **Agricultural operations personnel (Naturbrukskolan Uddetorp):** This position involves planning and carrying out tasks regarding crop cultivation and machinery. It requires "Master farmer" or "agrotechnician" level skills and solid professional experience in agriculture.

If these roles are of interest, you may want to review the specific duties mentioned in the database to see which best aligns with your experience as a machinery supervisor.

title: Naturbrukskolan Uddetorp is looking for agricultural operations personnel
description: With the goal - We develop world-class competence for a sustainable future and the good life, the Natural Resources Management runs education in youth high school, adapted high school, adult education and vocational college. The natural farming schools Svenljunga, Sötåsen, Uddetorp and the University of Applied Sciences function as competence centers for the growth and development of the green industries. Together with business and researchers, the administration runs energy projects and experimental activities at the forefront of schools. The Natural Resources Administration is part of the Västra Götaland region. On the outskirts of Skara, nestled in greenery and surrounded by rolling fields, is the Naturbruksskolan Uddetorp. Here, we run a conventional farm with the help of a solid machinery park and the latest technology for sustainable crop cultivation. The school has 200 hectares of fields, 16 hectares of natural pasture and 60 hectares of its own forest. The farm also has 65 dairy cows, 60 young animals and 8 ewes with lambs. At Uddetorp, we offer the focus on agriculture. The school is growing and is popular to search for. We have 184 high school students and nearly 300 adult students at the facility. DescriptionWith us you get a chance to make a difference and contribute to development. At our school, the next generation is trained in the green industry. We are looking for you who are development and goal-oriented, meticulous and who enjoy being in a changing everyday life together with students and colleagues. You also have good, both theoretical and practical knowledge in agriculture. We put the students and their knowledge development at the center. You therefore need to be sensitive to their needs, conditions and experiences. You are characterized by openness, lack of prestige and a great desire for development and cooperation. Tasks Together with the work team, you will plan and carry out customary tasks within the school's agriculture, as well as with crop cultivation, machines and with the farm's animals. You will also, together with the work team and other vocational teachers, instruct/teach students when they come out in agriculture to learn the craft of becoming the next generation of farmers. Qualifications Master farmer, agrotechnician or equivalent knowledge Solid professional experience in agriculture Driving license authorization B with manual gearbox Meritorious qualifications Driving license engine clearing chainsaw Experience of digitization in agriculture such as auto steering etc. We attach great importance to personal suitability. Terms and conditions The position is a permanent position with 100% employment rate, holiday service. Entry in February 2025 or by agreement. Evening and weekend duty may occur. In order to get a job within our school operations, an extract from the charge register must be presented, you apply for one via the police's website. Selection and recruitment may take place continuously during the application period, so apply already today and no later than December 1. Welcome with your application! About the Västra Götaland region The Västra Götaland region exists for the people of Västra Götaland. We make sure there is good healthcare for all. We work for sustainable development and growth, a good environment, improved public health, a rich cultural life and good communications throughout Västra Götaland. The Västra Götaland region is actively working to digitize more working methods. To be part of the digital transformation, you have basic skills and can use digital tools and services. You can search for information, communicate, interact digitally, are risk aware and have motivation to participate in development to learn new things. The Västra Götaland region is placing all permanently employed employees at war. If you want to know more about the Västra Götaland region, you can visit our introduction to new employees at the link https://www. vgregion. see/introduction. You can also read more in the presentation on https://mellanarkiv-offentlig. vgregion. see/alfresco/s/archive/stream/public/v1/source/available/sofia/rs4011-467070786-672/surrogate. Application The Västra Götaland region prefers that you register your application via the recruitment system. title: Naturbrukskolan Uddetorp is looking for agricultural operations personnel
description: With the goal - We develop world-class competence for a sustainable future and the good life, the Natural Resources Management runs education in youth high school, adapted high school, adult education and vocational college. The natural farming schools Svenljunga, Sötåsen, Uddetorp and the University of Applied Sciences function as competence centers for the growth and development of the green industries. Together with business and researchers, the administration runs energy projects and experimental activities at the forefront of schools. The Naturbruksförvaltningen is part of the Västra Götaland region. On the outskirts of Skara, nestled in greenery and surrounded by rolling fields, is the Naturbruksskolan Uddetorp. Here we run a conventional farm with the help of a solid machinery park and the latest technology for sustainable crop cultivation. The school has 200 hectares of fields, 16 hectares of natural pasture and 60 hectares of its own forest. The farm also has 65 dairy cows, 60 young animals and 8 ewes with lambs. At Uddetorp, we offer the focus on agriculture. The school is growing and is popular to apply to. We have 184 high school students and nearly 300 adult students at the facility. Description With us you get a chance to make a difference and contribute to development. At our school, the next generation is trained in the green industry. We are looking for you who are development and goal-oriented, meticulous and who enjoy being in a changing everyday life together with students and colleagues. You also have good, both theoretical and practical knowledge in agriculture. We put the students and their knowledge development at the center. You therefore need to be sensitive to their needs, conditions and experiences. You are characterized by openness, non-prestige and have a great desire for development and cooperation. Tasks Together with the team, you will plan and carry out customary tasks within the school's agriculture, as well as with crop cultivation, machinery and with the farm's animals. You will also, together with the work team and other vocational teachers, instruct/teach students when they come out into agriculture to learn the craft to become the next generation of farmers. Qualifications Master farmer, agrotechnician or equivalent skills Solid professional experience in agriculture Driving license authorization B with manual gearbox Meritorious qualifications Driving license motor- clearing chainsawExperience of digitization in agriculture such as auto control, etc. We place great emphasis on personal suitability. Conditions The employment is a temporary position during the period February-November 2025 which may be extended with 100% employment rate, holiday service. Evening and weekend duty may occur. In order to get a job within our school operations, an extract from the charge register must be presented, you apply for one via the police's website. Selection and recruitment may take place continuously during the application period, so apply already today and no later than December 1. Welcome with your application! About the Västra Götaland region The Västra Götaland region exists for the people of Västra Götaland. We ensure that there is good healthcare for everyone. We work for sustainable development and growth, a good environment, improved public health, a rich cultural life and good communications throughout Västra Götaland. The Västra Götaland region works actively to digitize more ways of working. To be part of the digital transformation, you have basic skills and can use digital tools and services. You can search for information, communicate, interact digitally, are risk-aware and have motivation to participate in development in order to learn new things. The Västra Götaland region hires all permanent employees. If you want to know more about the Västra Götaland region, you can visit our introduction to new employees at the link https: //www.vgregion.se/introduktion.  You can also read more in the presentation about https://mellanarkiv-offentlig.vgregion.se/alfresco/s/archive/stream/public/v1/source/available/sofia/rs4011-467070786-672/surrogate.ApplicationVästra Götalandregionen prefers that you register your application via the recruitment system. If you, as an applicant, have questions about the advertised position or for special and special reasons cannot register your data in a public system - contact the contact person for the respective advertisement. To staffing, brokerage and recruitment companies and to you who are sellers: We refrain from friendly but firm direct contact with staffing, brokerage and recruitment companies as well as other external actors and sellers of additional job advertisements. title: Försökstekniker till Sandbygård
description: We are looking for you with a great interest in the future of agriculture and who wants to work in an engaging team with a fast pace and lots of laughs. With us, you are offered an exciting opportunity to get a developing job in Swedish horticulture with an employer with long experience and a lot of knowledge. Welcome to us at Hushållningssällskapet Skåne!Hushållningssällskapet Skåne has for 200 years been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. We are the farmers' support and conduct a very reputable field trial operation with approx. 450 trials a year, where quality and development are the guiding stars. About the service The Skåne Farming Society's focus is to carry out crop cultivation trials of high scientific quality with modern equipment in all imaginable crops for the benefit and profitability of Swedish Agriculture. As a test technician with us, you will thus get an exciting role where the starting point of your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. It is varied work where every day is unique and the challenges are many. We carry out field trials in areas such as variety testing, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrition, tillage and more. You will be part of a team of trial technicians who work closely together. We offer you stimulating and fun work with varying tasks throughout the year depending on the season. With us, you also get the opportunity to participate in developing the agriculture of the future! About you In order to succeed and thrive with us, you have an agricultural education or work experience in crop cultivation. You have good knowledge of driving agricultural machinery and you should have a sprayer certificate. B driving license is a requirement for the position, BE is desirable. It is advantageous if you have knowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivation. If you have experience in machine service, we also see that as a plus. As a person, you have a great interest in crop cultivation/agriculture. You are meticulous, committed and quality conscious. You have the ability and enjoy working both independently and together with others. Of course you are driven and like challenges. Location: You start from our experimental station at Sandbygård. The work at our second trial station at Helgegården will occur. The position begins as a trial position for 6 months Questions about the position? Feel free to call us and we will tell you more. Ulrika Dyrlund Martinsson, head of field trials, 010 - 476 20 31, ulrika.dyrlund-martinsson@hushallningssallskapet.se or Andreas Andersson, field trial leader, 010 - 4762054, andreas.andersson@hushallningssallskapet.se Does it sound interesting? Submit your application today as selection takes place continuously. Welcome with your application!RequirementsAgricultural education or work experience in crop cultivationGood knowledge of driving agricultural machineryB driver's licenseMeriting BE driver's licenseSpray certificateKnowledge of pests and diseases in crop productionExperience in machine serviceAbout the employer - The SkåneHushållningssallskapet The Hushållningssallskapet is part of Sweden's history. The history stretches all the way back to 1791, when the country's first Household Society was established on Gotland. When we arrived over two hundred years ago, it was in a different Sweden, where agriculture formed the basis for the entire nation's prosperity. Back then, when famine was a reality in many Swedish households, new knowledge was needed for a more rational food production. Today, we continue to be an important actor that develops the green business life and to manage the earth's resources. Today, the Housekeeping Society consists of 15 independent societies that operate all over the country (the Housekeeping Society in Skåne is one of these). Just over 700 employees deal with advice, training, research and field trials and we have around 30,000 members. Our customers are in agriculture, forestry, public activities and other industries, mainly in rural areas. Together, we offer knowledge for the country's future. Please read more about us at https://hushallningssallskapet.se/

input: What competences are necessary for that profession?
actual_output:
Based on the information retrieved, the following competences are essential for a professional in an agricultural or land-based machinery supervision role:

### **Management and Operational Leadership**
*   **Assign duties to agriculture workers:** Supervise product packaging, grading, and equipment maintenance, and assign cultivation, irrigation, or harvesting tasks.
*   **Organise labour:** Manage production programs, sales, stocks, and the purchasing of materials and equipment.
*   **Evaluate employees' work:** Assess labor needs, evaluate team performance, and support/teach employees to ensure productivity and quality.
*   **Supervise staff:** Oversee staff selection, training, motivation, and performance.
*   **Apply organisational techniques:** Use detailed planning for personnel schedules and manage resources efficiently and sustainably.
*   **Programme work according to incoming orders:** Assess required working hours, workforce, and equipment to complete scheduled tasks.
*   **Monitor work site:** Ensure working conditions meet health and safety requirements and do not pose threats to others.

### **Machinery and Technical Skills**
*   **Operate agricultural machinery:** Operate tractors, balers, sprayers, ploughs, mowers, combines, earthmoving equipment, trucks, and irrigation equipment.
*   **Maintain technical equipment:** Maintain inventories of equipment and supplies and order materials as needed.
*   **Supervise equipment:** Identify and troubleshoot technical problems, conduct minor repairs, and monitor equipment for safety and environmental hazards.
*   **Operate landscaping equipment:** Use a variety of tools such as chain saws, tillers, backhoes, and sprayers.
*   **Operate forestry machinery:** Operate machinery for harvesting, forwarding, and transporting wood.
*   **Principles of mechanical engineering:** Understand the principles of physics, materials science, and mechanical engineering.
*   **Operate GPS systems:** Proficiency in using GPS technology.

### **Field and Crop Management**
*   **Inspect agricultural fields:** Determine the need and timing for sowing, spraying, weeding, and harvesting.
*   **Harvest crop:** Mow, pick, or cut products using appropriate tools and machinery according to quality and hygiene standards.
*   **Pest control in plants:** Apply conventional or biological pest control methods while adhering to health and safety regulations.
*   **Handling chemical products for soil and plants:** Prepare fertilizers, pesticides, and herbicides, and clean equipment used for spraying or spreading.
*   **Create soil and plant improvement programmes:** Develop and advise on soil health and plant nutrition programs.
*   **Crop production principles:** Understand the natural cycle, growth conditions, and principles of sustainable/organic production.
*   **Variety of botanicals:** Principles focused on herbaceous and annual plants in raw form.
*   **Soil structure:** Understand the diversity of soil elements and their relation to plant growth.
*   **Agronomy:** Combine agricultural production with the protection and regeneration of the natural environment.

### **Administrative and Business Skills**
*   **Budgetary principles:** Estimate and plan forecasts for business activity and compile reports.
*   **Write work-related reports:** Document information and present results in a clear way for both expert and non-expert audiences.
*   **Propose ICT solutions to business problems:** Suggest ICT means to improve business processes.
*   **Advise client on technical possibilities:** Recommend technical solutions within project frameworks.
*   **Road traffic laws:** Understand national traffic codes and rules governing the circulation of vehicles.
*   **Work in a land-based team:** Collaborate with others regarding services for agricultural production and landscaping.
*   **Perform park safety inspections:** Note and report risks or problems in park areas.

input: Which other occupations require the ability to organise machinery services and coordinate operations?
actual_output:
Based on the provided database, although there is no information exactly related to an occupation titled "land-based machinery supervisor," I have information regarding other occupations that involve the ability to organise machinery services and coordinate operations.

The following occupations from the database require these specific skills:

*   **Land-based machinery technician:** While primarily focused on maintenance and repair, this role requires the technical knowledge to coordinate the operational status of agricultural machinery.
*   **Vineyard supervisor:** This role is responsible for the technical management of the vineyard, which includes the organization of all work related to the vineyard, the supervision of seasonal staff, and managing the wine frames and necessary equipment.
*   **Aquaculture biologist:** This role requires the coordination of operations related to aquatic animal and plant life, applying research to improve production and provide technical solutions for environmental or health problems.
*   **Tour operator manager:** While in the tourism sector, this role mirrors the operational coordination aspect by managing employees and organizing complex package tours and services.
*   **Destination manager:** This role involves managing and implementing strategies and policies for destination development, which requires high-level coordination of resources, marketing, and promotion activities.
*   **Collection manager:** This position requires the coordination of operations regarding the care and preservation of objects within cultural institutions, involving planning and managing assets and collections.
retrieval_context:
Occupation: set builder
Description: Set builders construct, build, prepare, adapt and maintain scenic elements used on stage and for filming movies or television programs. They use a wide variety of materials like wood, steel, aluminium and plastics. Their work is based on artistic vision, scale models, sketches and plans. They work in close cooperation with the designers and may build exibition stands for fairs, carnavals and other events.

Occupation: scenic painter
Description: Scenic painters decorate sets for live performances. They employ a broad variety of crafting and painting techniques such as figurative painting, landscape painting and Trompe-l'œil to create convincing scenes. Their work is based on artistic vision, sketches and pictures. They work in close cooperation with the designers.

Occupation: prop maker
Description: Prop makers construct, build, prepare, adapt and maintain props used on stage and for filming movies or television programs. Props may be simple imitations of real life objects, or may include electronic, pyrotechnical, or other effects. Their work is based on artistic vision, sketches and plans. They work in close cooperation with the designers involved in the production.

Occupation: costume maker
Description: Costume makers construct, sew, stitch, dye, adapt and maintain costumes to be used in events, live performances and in movies or television programs. Their work is based on artistic vision, sketches or finished patterns combined with knowledge of the human body to ensure the wearer maximum range of movement. They work in close cooperation with the designers.

Occupation: wig and hairpiece maker
Description: Wig and hairpiece makers create adapt and maintain hair prostheses for use in live performance. They work from sketches, pictures and artistic visions combined with knowledge of the human body to ensure the wearer maximum range of movement. They work in close cooperation with the designers.

Occupation: mask maker
Description: Mask makers construct, adapt and maintain masks for live performances. They work from sketches, pictures and artistic visions combined with knowledge of the human body to ensure the wearer maximum range of movement. They work in close cooperation with the designers.

Occupation: tourism contract negotiator
Description: Tourism contract negotiators negotiate tourism-related contracts between a tour operator and tourism service providers.

Occupation: cultural archive manager
Description: Cultural archive managers ensure the care and preservation of a cultural institution and the archives within. They ensure the management and development of the institution’s assets and collections, including the digitisation of the archive collections.

Occupation: collection manager
Description: Collection managers ensure the care and preservation of objects within cultural institutions, like museums, libraries, and archives. Collection managers, along with exhibition curators, and conservators, play a very important role in collections care. They can be found in most large museums.

Occupation: land-based machinery technician
Description: Land-based machinery technicians maintain, overhaul and repair agricultural equipment and machinery.

Occupation: tour operator manager
Description: Tour operator managers are in charge of managing employees and of activities within tour operators related to the organisation of package tours and other tourism services.

Occupation: vineyard supervisor
Description: Vineyard supervisors supervise the work done in the vineyards, organise all work related to the vineyard in order to obtain good quality grapes produced in respect of the environment. They are responsible for the technical management of the vineyard and the wine frames and seasonal staff agents.

Occupation: destination manager
Description: Destination managers are in charge of managing and implementing the national/regional/local tourism strategies (or policies) for destination development, marketing and promotion.

Occupation: aquaculture biologist
Description: Aquaculture biologists apply knowledge gained from research about aquatic animals and plant life and their interactions with each other and the environment, in order to improve aquaculture production, prevent animal health and environmental problems and to provide solutions if necessary.

Occupation: contact centre supervisor
Description: Contact centre supervisors oversee and coordinate the activities of contact centre employees. They ensure that daily operations run smoothly through resolving issues, instructing and training employees and supervising tasks.

Occupation: tourist information centre manager
Description: Tourist information centre managers are in charge of managing employees and activities of a centre which provides information and advice to travellers and visitors about local attractions, events, travelling and accommodation.

Occupation: pension scheme manager
Description: Pension scheme managers coordinate pension schemes in order to provide retirement benefits to individuals or organisations. They ensure the daily deployment of the pension fund and define the strategic policy for developing new pension packages.

Occupation: human resources manager
Description: Human resources managers plan, design and implement processes related to the human capital of companies. They develop programs for recruiting, interviewing, and selecting employees based on a previous assessment of the profile and skills required in the company. Moreover, they manage compensation and development programs for the company's employees comprising trainings, skill assessment and yearly evaluations, promotion, expat programs, and general assurance of the well-being of the employees in the workplace.

Occupation: public employment service manager
Description: Public employment service managers supervise the operations of a public employment agency. They oversee the staff that helps people find employment or provide occupational guidance.

Occupation: art restorer
Description: Art restorers work to perform corrective treatment based on an evaluation of the aesthetic, historic and scientific characteristics of art objects. They determine the structural stability of art pieces and address problems of chemical and physical deterioration.

input: Show me vacancies for professionals responsible for planning agricultural machinery services.
actual_output:

    *   **Upload Date:** 2025-02-28
*   **Maskinförare växtodling (Agricultural inspector)**
    *   **Description:** Responsible for tillage, transport, and machine work. This role involves managing and maintaining a modern fleet of machines for the 2025 crop growing season.
    *   **Upload Date:** 2025-01-08
*   **Agraringenieur/ Anbauberater (Horticulture production team leader)**
    *   **Description:** Responsible for harvest logistics, coordinating seed potato logistics, and managing control of external contract goods.
    *   **Upload Date:** 2024-12-05
*   **Tractor and machine operator (Horticulture production team leader)**
    *   **Description:** This role includes not only operating machinery for tasks like ploughing, sowing, and harvesting, but also service and maintenance of machinery in the workshop and improvements to outbuildings.
    *   **Upload Date:** 2024-09-28
*   **Agricultural Technician M/F (Fruit production team leader)**
    *   **Description:** Specifically requires expertise in electrical engineering and mechanics to ensure the maintenance and improvement of agricultural equipment and machines, alongside managing stocks and assisting the farm manager.
    *   **Upload Date:** 2024-09-05

If you are looking for specific planning-heavy roles, the **Agraringenieur/ Anbauberater** position appears to have the most direct responsibility for logistics and coordination of agricultural machinery services among the retrieved results.

JobDescription: We are looking for a machine operator in agriculture for the crop growing season 2025. Your background We are looking for you who have a great interest in agriculture, experience as a machine operator in crop cultivation and driver's license B. Union contact persons: https://internt.slu.se/min-anstallning/facket/kontaktpersons/Sveriges lantbruksuniversitet (SLU) has a key role in the development of sustainable living, grounded in science and education. The main locations are Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, but operations are also carried out at research stations, experimental parks and educational locations throughout the country.
