We work for an equal and inclusive work environment where open conversations between people with different experiences lay the foundation for science, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply for the current position.

Occupation: horticulture production manager
JobTitle: Summer job 2025;     Tractor driver for Widegrens Gård on Gotland
JobDescription: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. About the position Until the summer of 2025, we are looking for tractor drivers for summer jobs to cover vacation times for our regular staff and to catch up when the field work is most intensive. You should be very interested of crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation where you contribute to trying to get the crop to reach its full potential. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you get warm in your clothes. It is a prerequisite that you have experience of driving agricultural machinery, that you can perform them with skill without damaging either the crop, the machine or the surroundings. Your attitude and desire to develop with us is strong and the commitment to do your best is a matter of course. .The position can be filled before the application deadline.Joining date for the position by agreement based on how your conditions look like for the coming summer.Salary according to increase.For the right applicant who currently does not live on Gotland, we can actively help find accommodation through our local network, several people in our existing team have come from the mainland in recent years. The application is emailed to jobb@widegrens.se

JobDescription: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. You who apply to us should enjoy teamwork in a lively environment with lots of humor and laughter in a serious world between too little or too much rain at the right or wrong time. About the positionWe are now looking for new important pieces of the puzzle for our cultivation team! The team currently consists of 12 machine operators, but when this year's cultivation season is over, two valued employees in the team move on to their own businesses. It is the most common reason that people leave us, they come from agricultural school or another job and stay with us for a few years and then move on to their own business. You should be very interested in crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation such as, for example, rotary harrowing, sowing of root vegetables, planting potatoes and onions, stone rowing, mechanical weed control, harrowing, chopping, milling and cupping, ploughing, cultivation, sowing of cereals, harvesting of potatoes and root vegetables, transport of products from fields to our cold storage, moving and commissioning irrigation machines and much more. The growing season with us runs roughly between 1 April- 15 November and as a machine operator with us, during this period you are basically all the time in a tractor in a field to help the crops reach their full potential. At other times of the year, it is service and maintenance of the machinery in the workshop, improvements to outbuildings, trucking and transport between our various warehouses. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you have warmed up in the clothes. It is a prerequisite that you have experience driving agricultural machines, that you can drive them skillfully without damaging either the crop, the machine or the surroundings. Your attitude and desire to develop with us is strong and the commitment to do your part the best is a matter of course. You are welcome to describe yourself as driven, humorous, in a good mood even if you are busy and that you have your heart in the relationship with colleagues, products and partners. JobTitle: Tractor and Machine Operator for Widegrens Gård on Gotland
JobDescription: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. You who apply to us should enjoy teamwork in a lively environment with lots of humor and laughter in a serious world between too little or too much rain at the right or wrong time. About the positionWe are now looking for new important pieces of the puzzle for our cultivation team! The team currently consists of 12 machine operators, but when this year's cultivation season is over, two valued employees in the team move on to their own businesses. It is the most common reason that people leave us, they come from agricultural school or another job and stay with us for a few years and then move on to their own business. You should be very interested in crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation such as, for example, rotary harrowing, sowing of root vegetables, planting potatoes and onions, stone rowing, mechanical weed control, harrowing, chopping, milling and cupping, ploughing, cultivation, sowing of cereals, harvesting of potatoes and root vegetables, transport of products from fields to our cold storage, moving and commissioning irrigation machines and much more. The growing season with us runs roughly between 1 April- 15 November and as a machine operator with us, during this period you are basically all the time in a tractor in a field to help the crops reach their full potential. At other times of the year, it is service and maintenance of the machinery in the workshop, improvements to outbuildings, trucking and transport between our various warehouses. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you have warmed up in the clothes. It is a prerequisite that you have experience driving agricultural machines, that you can drive them skillfully without damaging either the crop, the machine or the surroundings. Your attitude and desire to develop with us is strong and the commitment to do your part the best is a matter of course. You are welcome to describe yourself as driven, humorous, in a good mood even if you are busy and that you have your heart in the relationship with colleagues, products and partners. The position is a full-time position all year round. the application is positive. The position can be filled before the application deadline. Entry date for the position by agreement based on how your conditions look today but no later than 15 March 2025. Salary according to increase. For the right applicant who does not currently live on Gotland, we can actively help find accommodation through our local network, several people in our existing team have come from the mainland in recent years. The application is emailed to jobb@widegrens.se

input: What skills would I need to obtain one of these positions?
actual_output:
To obtain a position as a **Plant engineering consultant**, **Maskinförare växtodling**, **Agraringenieur/ Anbauberater**, **Tractor and machine operator**, or **Agricultural Technician M/F**, you would need the following skills, as identified in the database:

### Technical & Mechanical Skills
*   **Maintain agricultural machinery:** Ability to maintain agricultural facilities and equipment to ensure they are clean and in safe, working order, including performing routine maintenance and repairs.
*   **Maintain mechanical equipment:** Competence in observing and listening to machinery to detect malfunctions, and servicing/repairing vehicles used for farming.
*   **Agricultural equipment:** Knowledge of agricultural machinery and equipment products, their functionalities, properties, and relevant legal and regulatory requirements.

### Crop & Field Management Skills
*   **Inspect agricultural fields:** Skill in inspecting crops, fields, and plant stock to determine the need and timing for tasks like sowing, spraying, weeding, and harvesting.
*   **Manage crop rotation:** Planning and performing crop rotation and management techniques to optimize soil nutrients, improve fertility, and combat weed/pest pressure.
*   **Crop production principles:** Understanding natural cycles, nursing of nature, growth conditions, and principles of organic and sustainable production.
*   **Preserve crop:** Assessing crop quality while considering storage conditions and preservation criteria.

### Operations & Management Skills
*   **Operations management:** Applying backend business functions to achieve high efficiency and profitability.
*   **Manage farm products:** Making contracts with customers and business partners to ensure optimal production based on farm plans.
*   **Manage consumables stock:** Monitoring consumables to ensure production demands and deadlines are met.
*   **Mathematical economics:** Using mathematical principles to construct models for economic theory.
*   **Operational research:** Applying scientific methods to provide solutions to administrative and management issues.
*   **Ecosystem management:** Managing decision-making effects on ecosystem elements and optimizing strategies for fragmented landscapes.

### General & Professional Skills
*   **Perform office routine activities:** Handling daily office tasks such as mailing, receiving supplies, and updating staff to keep operations running smoothly.
*   **Promote social security programmes:** Promoting government aid programs for individuals.
*   **Perform lectures:** Presenting lectures to various groups.
*   **Teach geoscience:** Instructing students in the theory and practice of earth sciences (e.g., geology, meteorology).
*   **Promote animal welfare:** Working with compassion to sustain high standards of animal welfare.
*   **Develop creative ideas:** Developing new concepts.
*   **Organise cultural events:** Arranging events to promote local culture and heritage.
*   **Recreation activities:** Understanding the characteristics of recreational activities for customers.

input: Are there any related occupations that also require client coordination and operational planning?
actual_output:
Although there is no information exactly related to the specific agricultural machinery planning roles previously discussed, I have information from the database regarding occupations that involve high levels of operational planning, coordination, and management—tasks often critical to overseeing production and infrastructure.

The following occupations retrieved from the database involve significant responsibilities in **operational planning, scheduling, staff coordination, and meeting production/client goals**:

*   **Production supervisor:** Responsible for coordinating, planning, and directing manufacturing and production processes, including reviewing production schedules and managing staff.
*   **Industrial maintenance supervisor:** Organises and supervises maintenance operations for systems and equipment to ensure productivity and quality requirements are met.
*   **Power distribution engineer:** Designs and operates power distribution facilities, researches methods for the optimisation of distribution, and ensures consumer needs are met.
*   **Strategic planning manager:** Creates and provides coordination for the implementation of strategic plans across departments to ensure consistency in business execution.
*   **Chief operating officer:** Ensures the daily operations of a company run smoothly, including the development of company policies, rules, and long-term goals.
*   **Vessel assembly supervisor / Aircraft assembly supervisor / Motor vehicle assembly supervisor:** These roles coordinate employees, schedule activities, prepare production reports, oversee supplies, and communicate with other departments to avoid interruptions in the production process.
*   **Sport facility manager:** Leads and manages the operations, programming, and staffing of a facility to ensure it provides excellent service while achieving financial and operational targets.

These roles share the common themes of managing workflows, overseeing resource allocation, and ensuring that operational processes meet the required standards for efficiency and client service.

description: The county board is the government's representative in the county and coordinates the regional development work. We work with issues relating to environmental and nature conservation, rural areas, social planning, animal protection, preparedness, equality, integration and cultural environment. We work actively for the county's development and coordinate various social sectors. In our work, we protect legal certainty, openness, equal treatment and good service. Halland is an expansive county with extensive animal husbandry of various kinds where the County Administrative Board is the regional expert authority in, among other things, animal protection, infection control, feed and food. We are looking for one or more animal protection officers there the position/s are located at the Veterinary Unit, where we have approximately 20 employees. A large part of the unit's activities includes animal welfare control. We are now looking for an animal welfare officer with a permanent position. Job duties We offer stimulating and varied work where you will mainly work with animal welfare control of the farm's animals. Within animal welfare control, you work with routine checks, notification checks and follow-ups of previously identified deficiencies. You carry out the checks on the farms normally as a sole administrator. You are responsible for the entire case management such as control, drawing up control reports, registration, injunctions and any other decisions. You may also carry out controls within feed and food in primary production, transport inspections, answer the public's questions and receive notifications in the unit's contact phone for animal welfare. The position may also involve other tasks that occur, such as work with food supply and drinking water. You will be part of a work group and have a close collaboration with approx. 9 people. Other work areas within the unit may also be relevant and you therefore need to have an interest and desire to develop within the unit's other operational areas as well. Qualifications You have an academic education that is relevant to the work , for example pet agronomist specializing in farm animals, farm manager specializing in animal production or other education and experience that the employer deems appropriate. We would like to see that you have experience with livestock-producing animals by having worked on a farm, been an advisor, worked as an animal welfare inspector or similar. It is positive if you have experience of having worked with preparedness issues in food and drinking water. This position requires that you have good computer skills and basic knowledge of Microsoft Office. A B driver's license is required for this position. As the work as an animal welfare officer can sometimes be psychologically stressful, it is important that you have personal maturity, are confident in yourself and can distinguish between the personal and the exercise of authority. You need to be good at working independently and that you are calm, stable and controlled in stressful and pressured situations and you must have an empathic ability so you can put yourself in someone else's perspective. The county. This includes, among other things, counseling and skills-enhancing activities aimed at the county's farmers. input: What does it take to work in that occupation?
actual_output:
Based on the database, working in this occupation requires a comprehensive set of skills, competencies, and knowledge areas. These are categorized into practical skills and theoretical knowledge:

### **Animal Care and Management Competencies**
*   **Livestock Health & Welfare:** Managing the health and welfare of livestock, including assessing health status, creating welfare plans, controlling diseases and parasites (using vaccination/medication), and isolating sick animals.
*   **Breeding:** Breeding and raising various livestock (cattle, poultry, goats, rabbits, ducks, ostriches, snails, and honeybees), assisting with animal births, and caring for newborns.
*   **Feeding:** Providing animal nutrition, using computerized feeding systems, and maintaining pastures (rotation and conservation).
*   **Specific Husbandry Tasks:** Milking animals, performing milk control, slaughtering animals, skinning animals, managing livestock manure, and specialized procedures for pigs (branding, tagging, castration, tail-docking, and tooth cutting).
*   **Handling Specific Species:** Training horses and conducting the shearing of wool.

### **Production and Farm Operations**
*   **Crop and Resource Management:** Managing crop production (planning, tilling, planting, fertilizing, harvesting), monitoring crops for disease, installing irrigation systems, and managing grain storage.
*   **Facility Maintenance:** Operating and maintaining farm equipment, managing farm supplies (purchasing and storing), and cleaning/sanitizing farm facilities and equipment (including milking hygiene).
*   **Product Processing:** Processing dairy products, harvesting/processing honey, and handling feathers.
*   **Agritourism:** Presenting farm facilities to visitors and organizing agritourism activities.

### **Required Knowledge Areas**
*   **Animal Nutrition:** Understanding different species' dietary needs, water requirements, and quality criteria for feed.
*   **Biology:** Knowledge of tissues, cells, and the interactions of organisms with the environment.
*   **Agronomical Principles:** Understanding conventional agronomical production techniques.
*   **Equine Care:** Specifically regarding equine dental diseases (prevention, diagnosis, and treatment).
*   **Technical Systems:** Knowledge of computerized feeding systems.
*   **Agritourism:** Understanding the principles of agricultural activities for visitors.

### **General and Administrative Skills**
*   **Operations:** Ordering supplies, storing raw food materials, and maintaining linen operations.
*   **Service:** Serving food in a table service setting and arranging tables for events.
*   **Cleaning:** General room cleaning, including window washing, furniture polishing, and vacuuming.
*   **Supervision:** Directing food preparation and overseeing the daily operations of farm facilities.

input: Which other occupations require expertise in animal health and welfare?
actual_output:
Although there is no information exactly related to the original question about specific "openings," the database contains the following occupations that require expertise in animal health and welfare:

*   **Agricultural inspector**: Monitors agricultural operations, including health and safety measures, and ensures that activities comply with legislation and standards.
*   **Aquaculture biologist**: Uses research to improve aquaculture production and prevent animal health and environmental problems.
*   **Aquatic animal health professional**: Diagnoses, prevents, and treats diseases, injuries, and dysfunctions of aquatic animals; supervises the use of medicines and vaccines; and advises farm staff on best practices for animal health and welfare.
*   **Zoology technician**: Provides technical assistance in researching and testing animal species and aids in research concerning animals and their ecosystems.

actual_output:
Yes, there are several job opportunities available that involve breeding, feeding, and caring for animals based on the current database:

    *   **Locations:** Multiple positions available with the Bavarian state goods (BaySG) at the Ahllenschwang location.

*   **Training as a cattle carer / animal farmer / cattle farming specialist (m/f/d)**
    *   **Focus:** These training positions at the LfULG Department 78 involve calf and young cattle rearing, cattle farming (including hoof care, milk production, and preventive health protection), reproduction (obstetric care and care of calves), and the production of milk, breeding, and slaughter animals.
    *   **Note:** These are training positions based in Köllitsch, Saxony.

*   **Expert/project manager in milk for sustainable animal production**
    *   **Responsibilities:** Working with the acquisition, compilation, and transfer of knowledge regarding milk production, animal health and welfare, breeding, feed, milk quality, new technology, and entrepreneurship.
    *   **Requirements:** Education at university level (agronomist, veterinarian, farm manager or equivalent) and experience with the entire milk production process.

*   **Farm workers farmer (plant cultivation, soil, forest, animals)**
    *   **Responsibilities:** Daily care of cows, small calves, and sheep, including feeding, milking, and animal management. Focuses on preserving endangered land breeds.
    *   **Requirements:** Experience with small-scale agriculture, experience with cows, and knowledge of traditional animal care.

*   **Växa Sverige - Kokontrollexpert**
    *   **Responsibilities:** Work with "Kokontrollen" (cow control), pedigree control, and customer support regarding cow control, KAP, and lineage control.
    *   **Requirements:** Knowledge and experience from the agricultural sector (e.g., worked on a farm, as an advisor, or service technician).

*   **PhD Student in Plant Genetics and Breeding**
    *   **Note:** While primarily focused on plant breeding (specifically red clover), this role includes hands-on activities in the laboratory, greenhouse, and field, and contributes to food and feed production research.

j.description: Do you have knowledge of and experience in milk production? Do you want to work with the sustainable milk production of the future together with companies and the consultancy in the agricultural and animal sector? Then this could be a service for you! About us The government wishes to strengthen competitiveness in animal production for food by ensuring that the newest knowledge nationally and internationally is useful for Swedish producers. Knowledge hub animal production is a new unit within RISE that we are building together with experts in the field and who have competence in knowledge transfer, advice and communication. Together with the actors, we will identify the needs of animal production and develop models and advisory methods, which will put the knowledge to use by the farmer. The knowledge hub should not conduct research or advice itself, but be a link between the research and the advice and should collect knowledge from different areas and make it useful for advisory companies and the farmers. As an expert in our team, you get the opportunity to work with acquisition, compilation and transfer of knowledge regarding milk production, animal health and welfare, breeding, feed, milk quality, new technology and entrepreneurship. This is for a future sustainable Swedish animal production, which contributes to good animal welfare and working environment, together with good profitability. You will be an important team player in a committed department with high competence and who values ​​working in close collaboration with both colleagues within RISE and with our partners. You will have an important key role where you gather and coordinate different competences in milk production with our experts, industry partners and other RISE competencies, to contribute to knowledge transfer based on the animal producer's current and future needs. The position is located in Uppsala or Lund and involves some travel, therefore a B driving license is a requirement. Who are you? You have an education at at least university level as an agronomist, veterinarian, farm manager or equivalent. You have experience and knowledge of the entire milk production process, i.e. knowledge within i.a. animal health, breeding, feed, production economics and management. We would like you to have experience of working interdisciplinary, as well as working with information delivery and identifying farmers' knowledge needs, in national/international projects. It is advantageous if you have several years of work experience in the field of milk production, information efforts/further training and counseling for agricultural entrepreneurs. As a person, you are focused, committed, driven and good at building relationships with e.g. You work goal-oriented and structured and have a strong ability to quickly absorb information and events. Your way of thinking is strategic and you have a good overall view. You are proactive and systematic in your way of working and like to think new things. Very good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a requirement. What do we offer you? With us at RISE, you will get to work with an incredibly broad and exciting business. You will be part of a network of experts where you will be given the opportunity to exchange experience and develop skills as well as a valuable sounding board. You will collaborate with our researchers and experts in agricultural production. The culture is characterized by a positive spirit where everything is possible and where we work focused towards our common goals. You will work in a dynamic environment that gives you development opportunities both professionally and personally. At RISE, we want you to succeed and feel good, because when you succeed, you contribute to a sustainable future. Do you want to know more? j.id: 1924199
j.title: PhD Student in Plant Genetics and Breeding
j.description: Department of Plant BreedingThe Department of Plant Breeding focuses on research, education, and innovation that are strategically critical to society's long-term supply of food, industrial raw materials, and energy. We contribute to the efficient and sustainable production of food, feed, and industrial products through our state-of-the-art research targeting plants. our goal is to meet the increasing demands for these resources while making plant production increasingly environmentally friendly and energy efficient. Through our concerted efforts, we expand knowledge that contributes to sustainable societal development. In collaboration with growers and industries involved in crop cultivation, we are actively shaping what will be served on consumer plates in the future. Our department has grown numerically in recent years, with international employees and PhD students accounting for a highly significant proportion. Research activities at the department include population genetics of various crop species, development of omics-based breeding tools, marker-aided selection, genomic prediction, and crossbreeding for crop improvement.More information about the department can be found here:https://www.slu.se/en/departments/plant-breeding/Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Name of research project/thesis: Population genetics, comparative genomics, marker-trait association analysis and development of speed breeding methods to improve yield and quality in red clover.Research subject: Agricultural Science Description:Currently, the Department is conducting several research projects on crops that have a significant impact on Swedish agriculture. A number of these projects are funded by SLU GroGrund - the Swedish Centre for Breeding of Food Crops: https://www.slu.se/en/Collaborative-Centres-and-Projects/grogrund/One of these projects is "Building Efficient Breeding Programs in Forages: BreedForage". Red clover, the most important forage legume crop in Sweden, is one of the target crops of this project. input: Are there any other occupations that require animal production and welfare skills?
actual_output:
Based on the information provided by the database, there are several other occupations involved in the breeding, production, care, and welfare of animals. These roles focus on the day-to-day management, health, and specialized care of various species:

*   **Pig, Poultry, Cattle, Bee, Fur animals, Horse, and Sheep Breeders:** These occupations are responsible for overseeing the production and day-to-day care of their respective species, with a primary focus on maintaining the health and welfare of the animals.
*   **Farm Manager:** These professionals plan and organize the daily operations, resourcing, and business management of farms that produce animals and crops.
*   **Animal Care Attendant:** They provide routine care for non-production animals, which includes feeding, watering, cleaning, exercise, enrichment, grooming, training, and monitoring health and welfare.
*   **Animal Welfare Inspector:** These inspectors investigate reports of animal cruelty or neglect, rescue animals at risk, educate owners on proper care, and seek to alleviate animal suffering.
*   **Animal Behaviourist:** They study, observe, and assess animal behavior to address problematic behaviors through the development of suitable environments and management regimes.
*   **Specialised Veterinarian:** These professionals are authorized to carry out all aspects of veterinary medicine in the interest of animal health and welfare, often with specialized qualifications for specific species.
*   **Animal Artificial Insemination Technician:** They are responsible for the impregnation of animals using collected semen, adhering to national legislation.
*   **Live Animal Transporter:** They manage the transport and transfer of live animals, which includes monitoring animal health and welfare during the journey, as well as loading and unloading processes.
*   **Guide Dog Instructor:** They plan training sessions and ensure the overall routine care and mobility training of guide dogs.
*   **Farm Milk Controller:** They are responsible for measuring and analyzing the quality and production of milk and providing advice based on these findings.
*   **Agricultural Inspector:** They monitor agricultural operations to ensure that production processes, health, and safety measures comply with legislation and standards.

For both positions, this means that you actively influence and contribute to how we achieve our goals with an integrated plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increasing food production. You will collaborate and exchange experiences with colleagues at other plant protection centers as well as with colleagues at other units within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture. Your main task is to support the existing advice with basis built on a scientific basis. You contribute to the development of integrated plant protection through independent advice and basis for need-based control. The services include, among other things:• Compiling and conveying Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy • Follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, as well as participate in digital weekly meetings for advisors about the current plant protection situation • Contribute to increased awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems The work involves many contacts, mainly national but also some international. Within the Environment and Climate Knowledge Hub, which includes the plant protection centre, we work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. This means that you can also have the opportunity to work with other tasks in the field of plant protection. This could be, for example, participating in investigations, contingency planning or issues related to the ongoing climate change. You should therefore be able to manage a flexible way of working and be able to quickly adapt to changed tasks based on new priorities. QUALIFICATIONS Common to the two positions is that we are looking for you who are an agronomist with a focus on soil/plants, horticulturist, farm manager or have equivalent education. You have good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops and are well acquainted with the conditions for agriculture in Sweden. The work is about supporting the counseling by acquiring and conveying knowledge. It is therefore important that you have the ability to collaborate and communicate in a clear and professional manner in order to get your message across. In order to achieve success, good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a prerequisite. j.title: Expert/project manager in milk for sustainable animal production
j.description: Do you have knowledge of and experience in milk production? Do you want to work with the sustainable milk production of the future together with companies and the consultancy in the agricultural and animal sector? Then this could be a service for you! About us The government wishes to strengthen competitiveness in animal production for food by ensuring that the newest knowledge nationally and internationally is useful for Swedish producers. Knowledge hub animal production is a new unit within RISE that we are building together with experts in the field and who have competence in knowledge transfer, advice and communication. Together with the actors, we will identify the needs of animal production and develop models and advisory methods, which will put the knowledge to use by the farmer. The knowledge hub should not conduct research or advice itself, but be a link between the research and the advice and should collect knowledge from different areas and make it useful for advisory companies and the farmers. About the role We are now expanding our team with another expert in the field of milk production. As an expert in our team, you get the opportunity to work with acquisition, compilation and transfer of knowledge regarding milk production, animal health and welfare, breeding, feed, milk quality, new technology and entrepreneurship. This is for a future sustainable Swedish animal production, which contributes to good animal welfare and working environment, together with good profitability. You will be an important team player in a committed department with high competence and who values ​​working in close collaboration with both colleagues within RISE and with our partners. You will have an important key role where you gather and coordinate different competences in milk production with our experts, industry partners and other RISE competencies, to contribute to knowledge transfer based on the animal producer's current and future needs. The position is located in Uppsala or Lund and involves some travel, therefore a B driving license is a requirement. Who are you? You have an education at at least university level as an agronomist, veterinarian, farm manager or equivalent. You have experience and knowledge of the entire milk production process, i.e. knowledge within i.a. animal health, breeding, feed, production economics and management. We would like you to have experience of working interdisciplinary, as well as working with information delivery and identifying farmers' knowledge needs, in national/international projects. It is advantageous if you have several years of work experience in the field of milk production, information efforts/further training and counseling for agricultural entrepreneurs. As a person, you are focused, committed, driven and good at building relationships with e.g. You work goal-oriented and structured and have a strong ability to quickly absorb information and events. Your way of thinking is strategic and you have a good overall view. You are proactive and systematic in your way of working and like to think new things. Very good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a requirement. What do we offer you? With us at RISE, you will get to work with an incredibly broad and exciting business. You will be part of a network of experts where you will be given the opportunity to exchange experience and develop skills as well as a valuable sounding board. You will collaborate with our researchers and experts in agricultural production. The culture is characterized by a positive spirit where everything is possible and where we work focused towards our common goals. You will work in a dynamic environment that gives you development opportunities both professionally and personally. At RISE, we want you to succeed and feel good, because when you succeed, you contribute to a sustainable future. Do you want to know more? Welcome to contact Jørgen Korning, Head of Unit, 070-313 6996. The deadline for applications is 10 November 2024. Interviews will take place continuously during and after the application period. Our union representatives are: Ingemar Petermann, SACO 010-2284122 and Linda Ikatti, 010-516 51 61. Calls from external recruitment companies and sellers are kindly avoided as we are subject to the Public Procurement Act.

j.description: The correctional service is growing - we are building new, rebuilding and building more and are now looking for more employees. Our most important goal is to reduce recidivism - to break the vicious cycle. If we succeed in that, society will be safer and more secure for everyone. We are the authority responsible for prisons, probation, custody and client transport. Do you want to know more? Hear what our employees think about working within the Correctional Service: https://www.kriminalvarden.se/jobba-hos-oss/We are now looking for a new colleague for Svartsjö agriculture, which belongs to the Stockholm West business area, located in Ekerö municipality. It is possible to get to work via both the south and west side of Stockholm. About 170 employees and ten managers manage, lead and develop the business, which receives approx. 270 inmates. Agriculture is part of the clients' daily occupation during its execution. The farm covers 400 hectares, of which 310 hectares are arable land and 90 hectares are pasture. Farming includes 250 hectares of grain and 60 hectares of paddy, as well as fodder crops such as wheat, oats, peas, broad beans and canola.  The farm has a breeding herd of the Hereford breed. We get around 75 calves per season and have around 160 animals in total. The machinery park is modern with GPS technology and a workshop for service. The business also includes firewood production, vegetable growing, green area maintenance and carpentry. There are well-equipped staff areas with gyms and charging stations. JOB DUTIES As a production manager/operations manager, you get a central and inspiring role where you are primarily responsible for the animals together with three colleagues. During the crop growing season, you broaden your role and collaborate with the team on the crop growing side, which includes more other colleagues. The daily work is carried out by the institution's inmates, and you become an important role model who, with your commitment, motivates and guides them in their working life. You will have a workforce of approx. 10-15 clients depending on the season. Here you have the chance to influence and make a difference to contribute to the Correctional Service's vision Better out. The role is both diverse and eventful, and it requires good basic physics because the tasks are often physically demanding. Here you get the opportunity to work hands-on and develop together with committed colleagues all while making a real difference. Working as a production manager means that you contribute to a better society. In order to enjoy and succeed in your assignment, it is important that you share the Prison Service's basic values ​​of a humane view of people, respect for the individual and the belief that people can be developed. has practical experience and a strong interest in work management in animal husbandry and crop cultivation. As a production manager, you have clear and pedagogical insight into how best to introduce and supervise inmates from the institution, while actively participating in the tasks yourself. You are also welcome to apply for the position if you are only interested in working with the animals. We have the opportunity to send staff on training courses that are relevant to being able to cope with the tasks, in addition to this, we have a solid individual introduction. We attach great importance to personal suitability. We are looking for you who have: • High school education or other education, preferably in nature management, agriculture and animal care in combination with work experience • Good knowledge of the Swedish language both spoken and written • B driving license It is advantageous if you have :• Work experience from a managerial role, preferably operations manager, barn foreman or farm manager• Experience as an animal keeper with experience from a cattle and/or dairy herd or other animal husbandry in agriculture and equine farming• Knowledge in semining• Experience with cattle, including practical calving experience• Experience in crop cultivation• Forklift license or other driver's license such as wheel loader, clearing saw, chainsaw OTHERWe place high demands on our employees' security and privacy awareness. To work with us, you need to undergo a security assessment in accordance with the Security Protection Act. During the security check, you as a person, your background and your relationships are investigated from a security perspective. j.title: Work with plant protection - three services in our socially important business
j.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,750 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. Read more about what it's like to work at Jordbruksverket on our website: www. the agricultural agency. se/jobbahososs As an advisor in plant protection, you will be part of the plant protection center in Skara, which is part of the environment and climate knowledge hub and works to actively influence and contribute to sustainable plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increased food production. We work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. The colleagues in the environment and climate knowledge hub are mainly located regionally at the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's three advisory units. This position is located at the plant protection advisory unit, which includes the plant protection centre. At the plant control unit, where the administrative positions are located, we are responsible for managing, among other things the rules for seed and against plant pests. This means everything from EU and international work, to national regulations and decisions, together with a lot of guidance, information and preparedness work. At the unit, we are 18 employees divided into two teams. We work both directly with industry players, industry organizations and in collaboration with the government office and other member states. JOB TASKS Do you have a good knowledge of the challenges of plant cultivation and want to work for robust and sustainable plant protection? Do you want to contribute to us being able to continue growing crops for feed and food in Sweden even in the event of social disturbances and in a changed climate? Then you can become one of our new colleagues! The Swedish Agency for Agriculture has an important task in both working with preventive plant protection and combating plant pests that are already present here, partly through regulations and partly through advice and skills development. We are now advertising three positions with the following tasks: 1. Advisor crop protection, agriculture - Skara• compile and convey Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy, • support the consultancy with increased competence through newsletters, control recommendations, courses, field trips and conferences, • follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, • increase awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems, • be an important part of various projects within preparedness to ensure that we can maintain Swedish food production2. Plant pest manager - Jönköping/Landskrona• guide and inform about our rules against quarantine pests, • strengthen our preparedness for and manage possible outbreaks, • contribute to planning and developing our inventory of quarantine pests. Together with the colleagues at the plant regulation unit, you protect Sweden against the introduction of new plant pests. The work involves a mixture of situations that requires quick responses and planned work with processes based on scouting and reflection. 3. Manager robust crop cultivation - Jönköping• what abilities are needed to run the business, • what vulnerabilities exist and • what we need to do to increase our ability. Together with colleagues, you contribute to making our socially important business more robust with rules and guidance both on seed and combating plant pests. This is to reduce our vulnerability and strengthen our preparedness to face new as well as ongoing challenges. QUALIFICATIONSWe are looking for you who have an academic education as an agronomist, hortologist, farm manager, horticultural engineer or equivalent and a good knowledge of crop cultivation in Sweden. You need a good ability to express yourself verbally and in writing, in both Swedish and English to be successful in the role of administrator or advisor. The roles have different qualifying requirements, where the personal abilities we are looking for may differ, depending on the nature of the role and task. The following paragraphs clarify which requirements are specifically aimed at a particular service. 1. For advisers in crop protection, in addition to the requirements above, you need to have experience of working as a plant cultivation adviser under Nordic conditions and good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops. You are structured and used to planning your work, are confident in your professional role and find solutions to get ahead even in uncertain contexts. You stay up-to-date by monitoring the world around you and find it easy to put forward your case and win respect. 2. For plant pest manager, you need to be structured, analytical and communicative. It is advantageous to have knowledge of plant pests, gardening, plant cultivation or forests in Nordic conditions, and if you have experience of government work. 3. For manager of robust crop cultivation, we are looking for you who is structured, stable and has an easy time collaborating and communicating with others, both customers and other actors. You have previous experience of government work and we would like you to have experience of work in civil defence. OTHER Location of the services is presented below:1. Plant protection advisers are primarily located in Skara, but Linköping can also be an option. 2. Pest control officers are based in Jönköping or Landskrona. 3. Handler robust crop cultivation is located in Jönköping. For all three positions, the opportunity to work part of the working time remotely is offered. Do you have questions about any of the services? 1. For plant protection advisers, contact Anna Larsson or Anders Arvidsson. 2. For plant pest managers, contact Carin Bunnvik. 3. For managers robust plant cultivation, contact Carin Bunnvik or Klara Ekengard. For us, it is important that all skills in the labor market are utilized. input: Are there any job offers for a writer?
actual_output:
Based on the information provided in the database, there are no job offers specifically for a "writer." 

However, the database does contain information regarding various other agricultural roles. Below is the available information for the jobs retrieved:

*   **Administrators and advisors with a focus on farm animals**: This role involves planning and leading skills development, writing applications for project funds, and coordinating activities for farmers. It requires the ability to communicate clearly in speech and writing.
*   **Animal welfare officer**: This role involves handling animal welfare cases, routine inspections, and complaint processing. It requires the ability to express oneself well in Swedish in speech and writing.
*   **Application expert (Arevo)**: This role involves supporting customers, performing situation analyses, and recommending measures for plant cultivation. It requires fluency in Swedish and English.
*   **Djurskyddshandläggare med fokus på lantbrukets djur**: This role involves animal welfare control and requires strong communication skills in speech and writing.
*   **Gardener to Crafttech**: This role involves maintenance of gardens and green areas and requires good knowledge of Swedish.
*   **Säsongsarbetare till Vattenenheten (Seasonal worker at the Water Unit)**: This role involves fieldwork in water and fishery conservation and requires mastery of the Swedish language.
*   **Stadsbonde för kunskapshöjande odling inom staden (Urban farmer)**: This role involves urban farming projects, workshops, and communication of work through various channels. It requires comfort in expressing oneself in English.
*   **Support Manager with knowledge of agriculture (Näsgård)**: This role involves supporting plant growers with digital solutions, including updating and developing support materials like manuals and website content. It requires fluent Swedish and English.
*   **Trädgårdsmedarbetare kort säsong (Garden employee)**: This role involves garden maintenance and requires mastery of the Swedish language.

job_title: Application expert
job_description: Arevo is a development-driven company with roots in pioneering research into plant nutrient uptake. We want to change the way the earth's resources are used by enabling more sustainable and efficient plant cultivation. Our market is growing and we therefore want to strengthen the company with an application expert for our head office in Umeå. Arevo offersAt Arevo, you get to help develop business in an international context and at the same time contribute to real sustainable growth. We are a growing company with an inclusive atmosphere, where your thoughts and ideas can have a big impact. Arevo offers varied and challenging tasks as well as great personal responsibility and you have great opportunity to develop within the company. Your new work as an application expert As an application expert, you will be responsible for establishing and supporting both new and existing customers together with the responsible salesperson (Key account). Today, a large focus is on Nurseries in the forestry sector, but our plan is to grow in other sectors. You will, together with our salespeople, be on site at our customers and carry out a current situation analysis and then recommend measures to improve the customer's cultivation results. This is followed by implementation and follow-up during the season to ensure the best possible results. The work also includes being part of our product development in the form of the link between the customer and our developers. The service is based in Umeå. Arevo is located, with both production and lab operations, in modern and bright premises just outside Umeå city centre. The position involves some travel primarily to the Nordic countries, but may later also include Europe. If necessary, opportunities are given to work remotely. Are you who we are looking for? We believe that you have education in forestry, agronomy or a related field as well as a few years of experience in plant production or other relevant experience from commercial cultivation on a large scale. You should also have knowledge of plant nutrition, especially in connection with forest plant production. The role requires fluency Swedish and English in both speech and writing. You have a practical and solution-oriented approach and enjoy working in an advisory and supportive manner according to the customer's needs. You should also be both interested in and have the ability to carry out current situation analysis as well as analyze and interpret cultivation data, among other things. We assume that you have a structured way of working and good knowledge of the Microsoft Office package. Your application Arevo collaborates with Vedea and Åsa Holmström, 072-050 52 80. It is also possible to contact Arevo CEO, Niklas Åström, 070-669 34 44. You are warmly welcome with your application - marked Arevo - no later than November 27 via www. see. se/CVArevo - our business Arevo offers completely unique biostimulants and plant nutrition products that simplify cultivation and favor sustainable growth of plants. Arevo has its starting point in Professor Torgny Näsholm's pioneering and award-winning research on how plants can use the amino acid arginine as a natural nitrogen source. Our environmentally friendly products i The arGrow range stimulates root formation and growth of viable plants, provides low nitrogen leakage and enables good soil health. In total, over 95 million forest seedlings have been planted and over 600 million pine and spruce seedlings have been grown with Arevo's products. Development is underway for more species in forestry, gardening and agriculture. Simple, effective and climate-smart. Arevo was founded in 2015 as a spin-off from SweTree Technologies and is today owned by a. of Fort Knox, Navigare Venture, Industrifonden and Kempestiftelserna. Our strongly growing market consists of forest owners and growers worldwide. Please read more at www. arevo. see

job_description: The Bergian garden is beautifully located on a cape in Brunnsviken within the Royal National City Park. The garden is run by Stockholm University and we are a group of 19 permanent employees (of which twelve are gardeners). During the summer, there are about 8 seasonal garden employees. The purpose of the business is to disseminate knowledge about biodiversity, botany and horticulture and provide materials and other resources for research and teaching. In the garden there are about 6,000 plant species from different continents in outdoor plants and greenhouses. We are visited annually by about 150,000 people and 600 school classes. For further information, see https://www.bergianska.se/.vi are looking for three garden employees for a shorter season May to August, two for work on the open and one for work both outdoors and greenhouses. In your personal letter which of these you are looking for as well as during which time you can work. Work tasks - maintenance of the Bergian garden's very rich plant material in the outdoors, in greenhouses and in our historic park facility. This primarily includes watering, weeds, mowing, ground work and care of fixed installations. The work is physically stressful. Qualifications - you have ongoing or completed garden training from a vocational college or other garden education/experience that the employer considers equivalent. - You master Swedish in speech and writing and have computer experience.Meritating is: - Work experience of work in gardening and cultivation in the outdoors and/or greenhouses - experience of work in botanical garden - experience from the use of relevant garden machines - good plant knowledge - driver's license: Lowest AM - Lift training. We attach great importance to personal fitness. You have a good touch in garden crafts and have the ability to adapt to new conditions and unforeseen situations. You have a "look" for what needs to be done and are comfortable with work both in groups and independently. You are prestigious and have good collaboration and communication skills. If the employment employment refers to full-time and is a shorter seasonal employment during the period May to August or by agreement. Stockholm University applies individual salary setting. We offer us you get the dynamics of the interaction between higher education and research that makes Stockholm University an exciting and creative environment. You work in an international environment and get favorable conditions. job_title: Animal welfare officer
job_description: When you work at the county board, you get to use your knowledge at the country's broadest authority. The county board is the state's representative in the county and ensures that national goals are achieved. Taking regional conditions into account, we make trade-offs between different societal interests. This is through collaboration between experts in a range of different fields and in collaboration with authorities, municipalities and organisations. At the county board, we create social benefit and influence social development, every day. It is an important assignment, a great responsibility and an inspiring opportunity. Let your knowledge become a force for Östergötland. We are looking for Östergötland is a vibrant agricultural county with extensive animal husbandry. We are now looking for an animal welfare officer to strengthen our unit. The position is a permanent, full-time position that begins with a 6-month trial period. Access as soon as possible and according to agreement. You will belong to the Animal Protection Unit, which has an expert function for the county board's assignments to operate throughout the food chain for healthy food, good animal welfare and protection of property and people in accordance with the Act on the Supervision of Dogs and Cats. A large part of the unit's activities includes animal welfare control. The unit for animal protection is included together with the unit for food, veterinary and game, the unit for agricultural support and the unit for rural areas in the department for animals, rural areas and food. Your duties As an animal welfare officer, you work with animal welfare cases of various nature. You will work with both routine inspections of the farm's animals and complaint cases about lack of animal protection, permits for professional activities with horses or companion animals, as well as subsequent processing of any decisions. You may also be needed for other tasks at the unit, such as enforcement of custody orders. Depending on your skills and education, other tasks may also become relevant within the department for animals, rural areas and food such as animal control, area control, primary production control or the like. Required requirements for the position - You have at least a bachelor's degree in agronomy, ethology and animal welfare, biology, farm manager or other education that we deem relevant. - You have experience and good knowledge of several different animal species. - You have a good ability to express yourself in Swedish in speech and writing. - You have good knowledge of the agricultural industry. - You have previous experience of official work in animal welfare. - You have good knowledge of the Office package. - You have good knowledge of Platina. - You have good knowledge of the animal welfare control register. - You have a B driving licence. Meritorious for the position - Documented experience of working with farm animals. - Good knowledge of English. - Good knowledge of administration and confidentiality. As a person - Do you have high cooperation skills by working well with other people. You relate to them in a responsive and flexible way. You listen, communicate and resolve conflicts in a constructive way. - Are you service oriented in that you are calm, attentive and accommodating in your treatment. You have an interest, desire and ability to help others and make an effort to deliver solutions. - Are you structured in that you plan, organize and prioritize your work effectively. You set and keep time frames. - Are you stable in that you are calm and controlled in stressful situations or pressured situations. You maintain a realistic perspective on situations and focus on the right things. - You have a high ability for oral communication, this is because you will have a lot of contact with animal keepers and sometimes also with the media. This means that you speak clearly, articulately and engaged in individual meetings and in small and large groups. You listen and are receptive to the other party and adapt to the situation. About us as an authority, our benefits and other conditions Östergötland County Administrative Board is a state authority and our office is located in central Linköping. As employed by us, you have, among other things, wellness hours, wellness allowance, extended parental allowance and flexible working hours. We offer the option of remote work up to two days a week on average if the business allows. For us, it is important that our workplace is characterized by consideration, respect and communication and according to the state's core values. Read more about us, our benefits, our core values ​​and what it's like to work with us. https://www. the county board. see/ostergotland/about-us/work-with-us. htmlThe County Administrative Board has an important coordinating role in the event of social disturbances, and thus all employees are included in the crisis and war organization. Some of our services are security classified, which means that a security check will then be carried out before employment. If you want to know more, contact Head of Unit, Helen Loor, tel. 010-223 52 59. Union representative for SACO is Magnus Roback, tel. 010-223 54 89 and for ST is Nina Stenmark, tel. 010-223 53 04. Welcome with your application, which you send via www. which one. com. Your application must have been received no later than 2024-11-14, enter ref no: 17395.

job_description: Every day throughout the year, development management plays a central role in Gothenburg's growth and development in new residential areas, road and light rail sections, bridges, tunnels, while at the same time we create the conditions for future living and business life as landowners. The administration also works to acquire and manage housing for households that find it difficult to arrange their own accommodation, at the same time that we are actively working to end homelessness in Gothenburg by 2028. The exploitation administration is part of the urban development administrations that exist in Gothenburg City. Together, we work to create the conditions for a functioning infrastructure, quality housing and premises, an inviting public environment and work to ensure that the city becomes sustainable from all perspectives. Feel free to visit https://goteborg.se/wps/myportal/start/jobba -in-goteborgs-city/be-operations/jobba-pa-eploateringsforvaltningen or follow us on Linkedin https://www.linkedin.com/company/exploateringsforvaltningen-goteborgs-stad/ARBETSUPPFIGTERThe mission of urban farming is to create more opportunities for the citizens of Gothenburg to grow, produce more food on the city's land and promote a sustainable food culture. With more focus on the city's farmland, we want to lower the thresholds for new vegetable producers. The needs, demand and knowledge about cultivation and its positive effects on sustainable urban development have increased, and we want to meet this by adding more people to our team within urban cultivation. Cultivation is a good tool to tackle many issues around sustainable urban development and we see the need of a resource that is actively out among the citizens of Gothenburg. Here we can then contribute to goal fulfillment within the City of Gothenburg's environmental and climate program 2021-2030, where we contribute on an overall level to the cross-cutting strategies and for an equal city 2018-2026 as well as national climate goals and the global sustainability goals.  In the City's budget for 2025, we have also been given several explicit tasks related to Urban Cultivation. Tasks in the role can be the following: • Develop the Model Cultivation at Angereds Gård, together with Naturbruk Angereds Gård into an example cultivation for market gardening at the forefront. Develop channels and collaboration with preschool/school for delivery of vegetables and educational opportunities on the farm. • Use Lilla Änggården as a starting point for the citizens of Gothenburg and other organizations linked to urban farming and deepen the cooperation with Kulturförvaltningen, Stadsmiljö and AB Framtiden • Plan and establish new joint cultivations on public land to reach the whole city through an itinerant working method and actively work for citizens who want to farm. • Collaborate with schools and preschools regarding cultivation as a pedagogy, a farm-to-table perspective• Hold workshops and open cultivation opportunities at our cultivation at Lilla Änggården as well as at new cultivations in different parts of the city vis-à-vis a variety of actors• urban farming.• Inventory the city's cultivation initiatives and actors QUALIFICATIONS We see that you, who apply, have an education in cultivation/agronomy or, alternatively, extensive practical experience in the market garden as well as:• Experience in the planning and operation of plantations as well as practical experience in commercial market gardening (in line with, for example, Jean Martin Fortier's methods for small-scale vegetable production)• Comfortable with expressing yourself in English in speech and writing.• Accustomed to using social media and other communication channels to spread knowledge about cultivation and sustainability issues• Ability to communicate in an inspiring and inclusive way in meetings, workshops and trainings• Ability to collect, analyze and compile statistical basis for monitoring and evaluating cultivation initiatives urban development processes• Experience of working with diversity and inclusion in projects with different target groups, e.g. children, young people, the elderly, those in need of protection or local associations • Strong project management skills and experience in coordinating complex projects • Experience in building and strengthening collaboration networks with other actors, such as municipal administrations, schools, companies and associations We are looking for you who is creative and used to solve problems and identify and overcome obstacles in projects and collaborations. job_title: Administrators and advisors with a focus on farm animals
job_description: The county board's approximately 300 employees work as the government's representative at regional level. Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. We work to be an authority free from discrimination and want to take advantage of the qualities that diversity brings to the business. The rural unit is one of the county board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic paid services. Within the unit there is also the Interreg Sweden Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for the agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sector collaboration at the County Board. We work with experts in these fields who are happy to share their knowledge. We work with respect, professionalism and openness for the county's residents - together for a sustainable future! The county. This includes, among other things, counseling and skills-enhancing activities aimed at the county's farmers. Our current pet consultant is now retiring and we are therefore looking for her successor who wants to work with skills development for the county's farmers with a focus on the farm's animal husbandry. Job duties You will be part of a group that works with planning, implementing and leading skills development within the common agricultural policy in the form of advice, courses and information to farmers. The work entails partly independently carrying out competence-enhancing initiatives such as courses, counseling and farm meetings with exchange of experience and partly coordinating other actors that the county administrative board has procured for various activities. You write applications for project funds and, together with colleagues, carry out the procurement of competence development efforts. The work includes financial accounting and reporting of measures taken. You collaborate with industry actors and organizations and have close cooperation with other county administrative boards as well as with various functions at our county administrative board. You may be part of cross-sectoral groups where you need to be able to combine your expertise with a holistic perspective. You participate in the work of responding to referrals and contributing with the perspective of agriculture on various issues. Depending on experience and competence, other tasks at the unit may also be part of the position. Your work is independent and requires you to be self-motivated, results-oriented and good at collaborating and creating relationships. You are sensitive to the needs of different clients. In your dialogue with farmers, you need to be service-oriented and have a good understanding of the companies' conditions in the county and have the ability to see the whole. You have a few years of work experience, experience from consultancy and government work is advantageous. You have work experience with a focus on agriculture and farm animals. If you also have experience in project management and work with skills development, as well as experience in working with small business owners, this is advantageous. You have the ability to communicate clearly in both speech and writing and have an established network within the agricultural industry. You are structured and solution-oriented with good computer skills. The position involves travel, mainly in the county, but longer trips with overnight stays also occur. A driver's license for a passenger car is required. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference to our county and society. The County Board is a broad authority, which means that you constantly have the opportunity to develop and learn new things. This applies in several policy areas. As an employer, we have a strong focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health-promoting wellness activities. We are keen on cooperation with our union partners and can offer remote work. In case of permanent employment at the County Board, you will be placed at war with the authority. If you share our passion to promote and preserve the biodiversity in our aquatic environments, we look forward to your application. The work is largely done in ongoing restoration projects, such as the EU projects Rivers of Life and Ecostreams for Life but also in other assignments linked to water conservation and fishing. The services may vary in time from about 3-6 months. Most of the work takes place in the field between June and October. A significant portion of the tasks are performed in a place other than the place of employment Östersund, which means that overnight stays elsewhere may be required, sometimes during a whole work week.
