job_description: The county board is the government's representative in the county and coordinates the regional development work. We work with issues relating to environmental and nature conservation, rural areas, social planning, animal protection, preparedness, equality, integration and cultural environment. We work actively for the county's development and coordinate various social sectors. In our work, we protect legal certainty, openness, equal treatment and good service. The County Administrative Board in Halland County has its office in central Halmstad and we are today approx. 230 employees. For more information see our website, www.lansstyrelsen.se/halland. Halland is an expansive county with extensive animal husbandry of various kinds where the County Administrative Board is the regional expert authority in, among other things, animal protection, infection control, feed and food. We are looking for one or more animal protection officers there the position/s are located at the Veterinary Unit, where we have approximately 20 employees. A large part of the unit's activities includes animal welfare control. We are now looking for an animal welfare officer with a permanent position. Job duties We offer stimulating and varied work where you will mainly work with animal welfare control of the farm's animals. Within animal welfare control, you work with routine checks, notification checks and follow-ups of previously identified deficiencies. You carry out the checks on the farms normally as a sole administrator. You are responsible for the entire case management such as control, drawing up control reports, registration, injunctions and any other decisions. You may also carry out controls within feed and food in primary production, transport inspections, answer the public's questions and receive notifications in the unit's contact phone for animal welfare. The position may also involve other tasks that occur, such as work with food supply and drinking water. You will be part of a work group and have a close collaboration with approx. 9 people. Other work areas within the unit may also be relevant and you therefore need to have an interest and desire to develop within the unit's other operational areas as well. Qualifications You have an academic education that is relevant to the work , for example pet agronomist specializing in farm animals, farm manager specializing in animal production or other education and experience that the employer deems appropriate. We would like to see that you have experience with livestock-producing animals by having worked on a farm, been an advisor, worked as an animal welfare inspector or similar. It is positive if you have experience of having worked with preparedness issues in food and drinking water. This position requires that you have good computer skills and basic knowledge of Microsoft Office. A B driver's license is required for this position. As the work as an animal welfare officer can sometimes be psychologically stressful, it is important that you have personal maturity, are confident in yourself and can distinguish between the personal and the exercise of authority. You need to be good at working independently and that you are calm, stable and controlled in stressful and pressured situations and you must have an empathic ability so you can put yourself in someone else's perspective. It is also important that you are service-oriented and accommodating while at the same time being a strong person who is able to set the requirements needed to achieve good animal husbandry within the framework of the legislation. It is important that you have the ability to work quickly and efficiently with the legislation in focus. As a large part of the tasks are based on good communication skills, it is important that you can express yourself well in speech and writing. We attach great importance to your personal suitability and your ability to contribute to a good work environment. Other We can offer:- A exciting workplace with broad competence - An opportunity to contribute to important social tasks - Possibility of remote work if the business allows - Wellness with wellness hour We know that diversity enriches and are looking for you who can complement our team with your competence, experience and personality. If you are interested in the skills related to this specific professional profile, here are the essential skills and descriptions provided by the database:

*   **Develop creative ideas:** Developing new artistic concepts and creative ideas.
*   **Literature:** The body of artistic writing characterized by beauty of expression, form, and universality of intellectual and emotional appeal.
*   **Develop an artistic framework:** Develop a specific framework for research, creation and completion of artistic work.
*   **Publishing industry:** Key stakeholders in the publishing industry; acquisition, marketing, and distribution of works.
*   **Write dialogues:** Write conversations between characters.
*   **Consult information sources:** Consult relevant sources to find inspiration, educate yourself, and acquire background information.
*   **Types of literature genres:** Understanding different literary genres, their techniques, tone, content, and length.
*   **Write storylines:** Write the plot of a novel, play, film, or other narrative; create and develop characters and their relationships.
*   **Writing techniques:** The different techniques used to write a story (e.g., descriptive, persuasive, first-person).
*   **Select subject matter:** Select subject matter based on personal or public interest, or by request from a publisher or agent.
*   **Apply grammar and spelling rules:** Apply the rules of spelling and grammar and ensure consistency throughout texts.
*   **Critically reflect on artistic production processes:** Reflect upon processes and outcomes to ensure the quality of the experience or product.
*   **Spelling:** The rules concerning the way words are spelled.
*   **Use specific writing techniques:** Use writing techniques depending on the type of media, the genre, and the story.
*   **Grammar:** The set of structural rules governing the composition of clauses, phrases, and words in any given natural language.
*   **Copyright legislation:** Legislation describing the protection of the rights of original authors and how others can use their work.
*   **Publishing market:** Understanding trends and the type of works appealing to a specific audience.
*   **Perform background research on writing subject:** Run thorough background research (desk-based research, site visits, and interviews).

input: I am looking for vacancies related to writing books, novels, or other literary works.
actual_output:
Although there is no information in the database related to vacancies for writing books, novels, or other literary works, I have information regarding various agricultural and gardening-related job opportunities.

The available positions are as follows:

*   **Administrators and advisors with a focus on farm animals**: This role involves planning and implementing skills development programs for farmers (courses, counseling, and farm meetings), writing applications for project funds, and coordinating procurement efforts.
*   **Animal welfare officer**: A role focused on animal welfare cases, conducting routine farm inspections, handling complaint cases, and managing permit applications for professional animal-related activities.
*   **Application expert (Arevo)**: This role focuses on providing technical expertise in plant nutrient uptake and cultivation for customers in forestry and other sectors. Responsibilities include situation analysis, recommending improvement measures, and acting as a link between customers and product developers.
*   **Djurskyddshandläggare med fokus på lantbrukets djur**: Similar to the animal welfare officer, this position involves routine checks, inspection reporting, and managing animal welfare compliance on farms.
*   **Gardener (Crafttech)**: A role focused on the maintenance of gardens and green areas, including mowing, pruning, soil nutrition, and irrigation.
*   **Seasonal worker (Water unit)**: A field-based role involving the restoration of aquatic habitats, inventorying watercourses, and manual environmental conservation work.
*   **Stadsbonde (Urban farmer)**: This position involves planning and operating urban cultivation sites, holding workshops for new growers, and collaborating with schools and organizations to promote sustainable food production.
*   **Support Manager (Plant cultivation/Näsgård)**: This role provides support and training to plant growers using digital farm management programs. It involves creating and updating support materials like manuals and instructional videos.
*   **Gardener (Bergian garden, seasonal)**: A position focused on the maintenance of diverse plant species, including watering, weeding, and general park care in both outdoor and greenhouse settings.

title: Animal welfare officer
description: When you work at the county board, you get to use your knowledge at the country's broadest authority. The county board is the state's representative in the county and ensures that national goals are achieved. Taking regional conditions into account, we make trade-offs between different societal interests. This is through collaboration between experts in a range of different fields and in collaboration with authorities, municipalities and organisations. At the county board, we create social benefit and influence social development, every day. It is an important assignment, a great responsibility and an inspiring opportunity. Let your knowledge become a force for Östergötland. We are looking for Östergötland is a vibrant agricultural county with extensive animal husbandry. We are now looking for an animal welfare officer to strengthen our unit. The position is a permanent, full-time position that begins with a 6-month trial period. Access as soon as possible and according to agreement. You will belong to the Animal Protection Unit, which has an expert function for the county board's assignments to operate throughout the food chain for healthy food, good animal welfare and protection of property and people in accordance with the Act on the Supervision of Dogs and Cats. A large part of the unit's activities includes animal welfare control. The unit for animal protection is included together with the unit for food, veterinary and game, the unit for agricultural support and the unit for rural areas in the department for animals, rural areas and food. Your duties As an animal welfare officer, you work with animal welfare cases of various nature. You will work with both routine inspections of the farm's animals and complaint cases about lack of animal protection, permits for professional activities with horses or companion animals, as well as subsequent processing of any decisions. You may also be needed for other tasks at the unit, such as enforcement of custody orders. Depending on your skills and education, other tasks may also become relevant within the department for animals, rural areas and food such as animal control, area control, primary production control or the like. Required requirements for the position - You have at least a bachelor's degree in agronomy, ethology and animal welfare, biology, farm manager or other education that we deem relevant. - You have experience and good knowledge of several different animal species. - You have a good ability to express yourself in Swedish in speech and writing. - You have good knowledge of the agricultural industry. - You have previous experience of official work in animal welfare. - You have good knowledge of the Office package. - You have good knowledge of Platina. - You have good knowledge of the animal welfare control register. - You have a B driving licence. Meritorious for the position - Documented experience of working with farm animals. - Good knowledge of English. - Good knowledge of administration and confidentiality. As a person - Do you have high cooperation skills by working well with other people. You relate to them in a responsive and flexible way. You listen, communicate and resolve conflicts in a constructive way. - Are you service oriented in that you are calm, attentive and accommodating in your treatment. You have an interest, desire and ability to help others and make an effort to deliver solutions. - Are you structured in that you plan, organize and prioritize your work effectively. You set and keep time frames. - Are you stable in that you are calm and controlled in stressful situations or pressured situations. You maintain a realistic perspective on situations and focus on the right things. - You have a high ability for oral communication, this is because you will have a lot of contact with animal keepers and sometimes also with the media. This means that you speak clearly, articulately and engaged in individual meetings and in small and large groups. You listen and are receptive to the other party and adapt to the situation. About us as an authority, our benefits and other conditions Östergötland County Administrative Board is a state authority and our office is located in central Linköping. As employed by us, you have, among other things, wellness hours, wellness allowance, extended parental allowance and flexible working hours. For us, it is important that our workplace is characterized by consideration, respect and communication and according to the state's core values. title: Djurskyddshandläggare med fokus på lantbrukets djur
description: The county board is the government's representative in the county and coordinates the regional development work. We work with issues relating to environmental and nature conservation, rural areas, social planning, animal protection, preparedness, equality, integration and cultural environment. We work actively for the county's development and coordinate various social sectors. In our work, we protect legal certainty, openness, equal treatment and good service. The County Administrative Board in Halland County has its office in central Halmstad and we are today approx. 230 employees. For more information see our website, www.lansstyrelsen.se/halland. Halland is an expansive county with extensive animal husbandry of various kinds where the County Administrative Board is the regional expert authority in, among other things, animal protection, infection control, feed and food. We are looking for one or more animal protection officers there the position/s are located at the Veterinary Unit, where we have approximately 20 employees. A large part of the unit's activities includes animal welfare control. We are now looking for an animal welfare officer with a permanent position. Job duties We offer stimulating and varied work where you will mainly work with animal welfare control of the farm's animals. Within animal welfare control, you work with routine checks, notification checks and follow-ups of previously identified deficiencies. You carry out the checks on the farms normally as a sole administrator. You are responsible for the entire case management such as control, drawing up control reports, registration, injunctions and any other decisions. You may also carry out controls within feed and food in primary production, transport inspections, answer the public's questions and receive notifications in the unit's contact phone for animal welfare. The position may also involve other tasks that occur, such as work with food supply and drinking water. You will be part of a work group and have a close collaboration with approx. 9 people. Other work areas within the unit may also be relevant and you therefore need to have an interest and desire to develop within the unit's other operational areas as well. Qualifications You have an academic education that is relevant to the work , for example pet agronomist specializing in farm animals, farm manager specializing in animal production or other education and experience that the employer deems appropriate. We would like to see that you have experience with livestock-producing animals by having worked on a farm, been an advisor, worked as an animal welfare inspector or similar. It is positive if you have experience of having worked with preparedness issues in food and drinking water. This position requires that you have good computer skills and basic knowledge of Microsoft Office. A B driver's license is required for this position. As the work as an animal welfare officer can sometimes be psychologically stressful, it is important that you have personal maturity, are confident in yourself and can distinguish between the personal and the exercise of authority. input: Are there other occupations that require strong grammar and spelling abilities?
actual_output:
Although there is no information in the database specifically regarding the occupation of "writer" of books or novels, I have information regarding various other occupations that require strong skills in language, grammar, spelling, and editing as part of their professional duties.

According to the database, the following occupations require these competencies:

*   **Proofreader:** Examines finished products (books, newspapers, magazines) to correct grammatical, typographical, and spelling errors to ensure quality.
*   **Copy Editor:** Ensures text is agreeable to read and adheres to the conventions of grammar and spelling for books, journals, and magazines.
*   **Medical Transcriptionist:** Interprets dictated information and converts it into documents, ensuring the correct application of punctuation and grammar rules.
*   **Scopist:** Edits transcripts created by court reporters, applying punctuation and formatting to ensure the accuracy of legal documents.
*   **Translator:** Transcribes written documents between languages while ensuring the message, nuances, and linguistic quality remain intact.
*   **Language Engineer:** Works in natural language processing to improve the linguistics of machine-operated translations through parsing and mapping.
*   **Lexicographer:** Writes and compiles content for dictionaries, determining which words are in common use.
*   **Newspaper/Magazine/Broadcast News Editor:** Responsible for assigning stories, determining length/placement, and ensuring publications are finished on time and meet editorial standards.
*   **Journalist (including Sports, Crime, Business, Political, and Foreign Correspondent):** Researches, verifies, and writes news stories while adhering to editorial standards and objective information.
*   **Speechwriter:** Researches and writes speeches in a comprehensible and conversational tone.
*   **Advertising Copywriter:** Responsible for the written design of advertisements, including slogans and catchphrases.
*   **Columnist:** Researches and writes opinion pieces based on a specific area of interest and writing style.
*   **Critic:** Writes reviews of artistic, musical, and literary works, evaluating themes and expressions based on their personal knowledge.
*   **Blogger/Vlogger:** Writes online articles or video scripts regarding various subjects, often relating objective facts and personal opinions.
*   **Publications Coordinator:** Responsible for the production of print and online materials and supervising publishing teams.
*   **Typist:** Operates computers to type and revise correspondence, reports, and other materials based on instructions.

occupation_title: crime journalist

occupation_title: localiser

occupation_title: business journalist

occupation_title: political journalist
description: Political journalists research and write articles about politics and politicians for newspapers, magazines, television and other media. They conduct interviews and attend events.

occupation_title: subtitler
description: Subtitlers can work intralingually, within the same language, or interlingually, across languages. Intralingual subtitlers create the subtitles for hearing-impaired viewers, whereas interlingual subtitlers create the subtitles for movies or television programmes in a different language to the one heard in the audiovisual production. They both ensure that the captions and subtitles are synchronised with the sound, images and dialogue of the audiovisual work.

occupation_title: proofreader
description: Proofreaders examine facsimiles of the finished products such as books, newspaper and magazines. They correct grammatical, typographical and spelling errors in order to ensure the quality of the printed product.

occupation_title: critic
description: Critics write reviews of literary, musical and artistic works, restaurants, movies, television programs and other themes for newspapers, journals, magazines, radio, television and other media. They evaluate theme, expression and technique. Critics make judgements based on their personal experience and knowledge.

j.description: The county board's approximately 300 employees work as the government's representative at regional level. Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. Within the unit there is also the Interreg Sweden Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for the agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sector collaboration at the County Board. We work with experts in these fields who are happy to share their knowledge. We work with respect, professionalism and openness for the county's residents - together for a sustainable future! The county. This includes, among other things, counseling and skills-enhancing activities aimed at the county's farmers. Our current pet consultant is now retiring and we are therefore looking for her successor who wants to work with skills development for the county's farmers with a focus on the farm's animal husbandry. Job duties You will be part of a group that works with planning, implementing and leading skills development within the common agricultural policy in the form of advice, courses and information to farmers. The work entails partly independently carrying out competence-enhancing initiatives such as courses, counseling and farm meetings with exchange of experience and partly coordinating other actors that the county administrative board has procured for various activities. You write applications for project funds and, together with colleagues, carry out the procurement of competence development efforts. The work includes financial accounting and reporting of measures taken. You may be part of cross-sectoral groups where you need to be able to combine your expertise with a holistic perspective. You participate in the work of responding to referrals and contributing with the perspective of agriculture on various issues. Depending on experience and competence, other tasks at the unit may also be part of the position. Your work is independent and requires you to be self-motivated, results-oriented and good at collaborating and creating relationships. You are sensitive to the needs of different clients. In your dialogue with farmers, you need to be service-oriented and have a good understanding of the companies' conditions in the county and have the ability to see the whole. You have the ability to communicate clearly in both speech and writing and have an established network within the agricultural industry. You are structured and solution-oriented with good computer skills. The position involves travel, mainly in the county, but longer trips with overnight stays also occur. We are keen on cooperation with our union partners and can offer remote work. In case of permanent employment at the County Board, you will be placed at war with the authority. j.title: Work with plant protection - three services in our socially important business
j.description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,750 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. Read more about what it's like to work at Jordbruksverket on our website: www. the agricultural agency. se/jobbahososs As an advisor in plant protection, you will be part of the plant protection center in Skara, which is part of the environment and climate knowledge hub and works to actively influence and contribute to sustainable plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increased food production. We work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. The colleagues in the environment and climate knowledge hub are mainly located regionally at the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's three advisory units. This position is located at the plant protection advisory unit, which includes the plant protection centre. At the plant control unit, where the administrative positions are located, we are responsible for managing, among other things the rules for seed and against plant pests. This means everything from EU and international work, to national regulations and decisions, together with a lot of guidance, information and preparedness work. At the unit, we are 18 employees divided into two teams. We work both directly with industry players, industry organizations and in collaboration with the government office and other member states. JOB TASKS Do you have a good knowledge of the challenges of plant cultivation and want to work for robust and sustainable plant protection? Do you want to contribute to us being able to continue growing crops for feed and food in Sweden even in the event of social disturbances and in a changed climate? Then you can become one of our new colleagues! The Swedish Agency for Agriculture has an important task in both working with preventive plant protection and combating plant pests that are already present here, partly through regulations and partly through advice and skills development. We are now advertising three positions with the following tasks: 1. Advisor crop protection, agriculture - Skara• compile and convey Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy, • support the consultancy with increased competence through newsletters, control recommendations, courses, field trips and conferences, • follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, • increase awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems, • be an important part of various projects within preparedness to ensure that we can maintain Swedish food production2. Plant pest manager - Jönköping/Landskrona• guide and inform about our rules against quarantine pests, • strengthen our preparedness for and manage possible outbreaks, • contribute to planning and developing our inventory of quarantine pests. Together with the colleagues at the plant regulation unit, you protect Sweden against the introduction of new plant pests. The work involves a mixture of situations that requires quick responses and planned work with processes based on scouting and reflection. 3. Manager robust crop cultivation - Jönköping• what abilities are needed to run the business, • what vulnerabilities exist and • what we need to do to increase our ability. Together with colleagues, you contribute to making our socially important business more robust with rules and guidance both on seed and combating plant pests. This is to reduce our vulnerability and strengthen our preparedness to face new as well as ongoing challenges. QUALIFICATIONSWe are looking for you who have an academic education as an agronomist, hortologist, farm manager, horticultural engineer or equivalent and a good knowledge of crop cultivation in Sweden. You need a good ability to express yourself verbally and in writing, in both Swedish and English to be successful in the role of administrator or advisor. The roles have different qualifying requirements, where the personal abilities we are looking for may differ, depending on the nature of the role and task. The following paragraphs clarify which requirements are specifically aimed at a particular service. 1. For advisers in crop protection, in addition to the requirements above, you need to have experience of working as a plant cultivation adviser under Nordic conditions and good knowledge of plant pests and integrated plant protection in agricultural crops. You are structured and used to planning your work, are confident in your professional role and find solutions to get ahead even in uncertain contexts. You stay up-to-date by monitoring the world around you and find it easy to put forward your case and win respect. 2. For plant pest manager, you need to be structured, analytical and communicative. It is advantageous to have knowledge of plant pests, gardening, plant cultivation or forests in Nordic conditions, and if you have experience of government work. 3. For manager of robust crop cultivation, we are looking for you who is structured, stable and has an easy time collaborating and communicating with others, both customers and other actors. You have previous experience of government work and we would like you to have experience of work in civil defence. OTHER Location of the services is presented below:1. Plant protection advisers are primarily located in Skara, but Linköping can also be an option. 2. Pest control officers are based in Jönköping or Landskrona. 3. Handler robust crop cultivation is located in Jönköping. For all three positions, the opportunity to work part of the working time remotely is offered. Do you have questions about any of the services? 1. For plant protection advisers, contact Anna Larsson or Anders Arvidsson. 2. For plant pest managers, contact Carin Bunnvik. 3. For managers robust plant cultivation, contact Carin Bunnvik or Klara Ekengard. For us, it is important that all skills in the labor market are utilized. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We normally apply a 6-month trial period. Before the recruitment work, we have taken a position on recruitment channels and marketing. We therefore do not want to be contacted by advertising vendors or recruitment companies.

We have an existing customer group on Öland where the majority have animal production with forage farming, therefore it is important that you have good competence in crop rotation and maize. You will have your own customer responsibility for these customers but also work closely with your plant cultivation advisor colleagues at the company. Within Hushållningsällskapet Kalmar Kronoberg Blekinge, there are also advisers with expertise in construction, agricultural economics, accounting, environment, water and forestry. j.description: Department of Land and Environment Do you want to be part of the search for knowledge about how we produce food in the best sustainable way, with minimized negative environmental impact? Do you want varied work in an agricultural environment? Before 2025, we have several new exciting attempts where we need the help of interested seasonal staff. We have the greatest need during the period April-September. If you can only work part of this period, you are still welcome to apply. About the job The tasks are above all to help with tasks that occur in our plant cultivation experiments, such as weighing seed and fertilizer, measuring experimental areas, carrying out various agricultural measures, carrying out soil sampling and crop, i.a. frequent measurements of gas emissions. There is also some work with sample handling, packaging of samples and maintenance of equipment. During intensive periods in crop cultivation, some evening work may be relevant. Your background We are looking for you who are interested in experimental activities in agricultural crop cultivation and who preferably have some form of education in agriculture. Experience of driving tractors, agricultural implements, drones and various measuring equipment is advantageous. The work requires accuracy and the ability to understand both oral and written instructions in Swedish. B driving license is a requirement. In the selection, great importance was attached to the applicant's personal suitability. About usLanna research station outside Skara conducts field experiments for researchers within SLU and for other actors. The business has a strong focus on precision farming, plant nutrition and stable manure and has many long-term trials. Here there are unique facilities for measuring leaching and climate gases and several newly purchased special machines for advanced plant cultivation trials.  Within the trial operations at Lanna, two people work full-time and 1-2 seasonal employees with the field operations. There is also a part-time research leader and a couple of employees in agricultural operations. The Lanna research station is part of the Department of Soil and Environment, which is a leading soil science center, both nationally and internationally. We research the properties and basic functions of the soil, as well as study how environmental and climate changes affect the soil. Through research, environmental analysis and education, we contribute knowledge about future sustainable land use and develop new solutions as a basis for decisions in agriculture and forestry, as well as urban environments. The work environment at the department is international and we have approx. 100 employees. We form part of SLU's Land, Water and Environment Center (MVM center), with close contacts to environmental analysis and research on e.g. water, cycle and bioenergy. The business contributes to meeting national environmental and climate goals and the UN's global sustainability goals. The department is located at Campus Ultuna in Uppsala and at Skara. Read more about the department here (https://www.slu.se/mark). j.title: Responsable de pôle installation en agriculture (F/H)
j.description: Description of the entityThe Department of Agriculture and Marine Resources (DARM) is responsible for supporting, implementing, leading, monitoring and adapting regional and European policies in the agricultural sector and forestry, the equine economy, fishing and aquaculture as well as the valorization of land and sea products. It includes 103 agents and is organized into 5 services, a sectoral steering mission European funds FEADER (European Agricultural Fund for Rural Development) / FEAMPA (European Fund for Maritime Affairs, Fisheries and Aquaculture) and an internal control unit.  The challenges for management are: Supporting Norman farmers in the development of their farms and transitions; Better valorize regional forest production; Give new impetus to Normandy fishing and move towards recognized and diversified Normandy aquaculture; Promote agricultural, fishing and aquaculture products; Support professionals in the equine industry and promote this sector of excellence internationally.   Missions Since January 1, 2023, the Region has been responsible for managing aid for setting up in agriculture on its territory. In this context, the challenge for the community is therefore to support young people wishing to settle in Normandy with the aim of ensuring the maintenance of the number of agricultural and equine businesses in its territory and allowing generational renewal. As part of its new 2023-2027 program, the Region has set itself the objective of creating 450 installations per year in Normandy.  The purpose of this position is to provide local supervision to a team of managers responsible for examining installation assistance files and overseeing regional installation policy.  Currently, nearly 2,300 living files are managed by the installation assistance system center.  Local management Lead and plan the activity of the division: definition of objectives and priorities, adaptation of the team's activities with regard to workloads, in conjunction with its line manager; Monitor the overall activity of the division and monitor the individual activity of the agents of the division; Provide technical and economic expertise in installation assistance files to managers, resolution of complex files; Organize and coordinate the various processes of the division in order to ensure fluidity in the processing of files; Organize the monitoring and implementation of the supervision and control processes of managers’ files; Propose budgetary developments and monitoring (commitments, payments) linked to this policy in connection with the Regional and FEADER budgets; Ensure day-to-day HR management in conjunction with your department manager; Ensure the replacement of the department manager during absence.  Lead the regional policy in favor of the installation in agriculture and the equine sector Design, implement then monitor the regional installation policy and design of the new post-2027 programming (participation in the French Region working group, consultation with the installation professionals in Normandy, etc.) for the benefit of project leaders and the Normandy territory; Organize and lead strategic meetings (regional installation committee in Normandy, meeting of prescribers, etc.); Represent the Region in strategic and field meetings for technical intervention and promotion of regional mechanisms; Provide technical-economic expertise to external requests for installation assistance files, as well as the liveability and viability of the installation projects presented; Monitor the evolution of current programming and its regulatory developments by being proactive in developing, modernizing and simplifying aid systems and their processes; Monitor the evaluation of the devices and its control methods; Design and update internal procedural documents, external documents intended for beneficiaries and partner structures of the installation, writing notes and reports Profile Expected skills Experience and knowledge in the field of entrepreneurship, particularly agricultural and equine, and in particularly the analysis of the resulting economic data;  Managerial experience/skills desired;  Ability to anticipate, prioritize and adapt your own activities and those of your team;  Spirit of rigor and organization, ability to handle complex files;  Availability and listening, sense of negotiation;  Team spirit and mutual aid, kindness; Ability to take initiatives and be proactive;  Responsiveness and ability to decide effectively; Work independently and responsibly on your missions, while knowing how to report to your hierarchy;  Knowledge of the functioning of European EAFRD programs and funds;  Use and design of specific computer applications and use of office tools; Relational skills internally and externally, ability to popularize complex technical elements and to speak in public; Writing skills.   General conditions Internal contacts Within the management with managers, other service managers, the management secretariat, the EAFRD European funds steering mission.   External contacts Project leaders, professional agricultural partners and the paying agency (ASP).  Special constraints Work in offices and in services; Office hours but with irregular rhythm with potential peaks; Possible time constraints outside office hours on an ad hoc basis; Travel throughout Normandy.   Opportunities Joining the Normandy Region means joining a community that listens to its agents, offering in particular a social action system (CNAS membership), a restaurant voucher card (Caen), a concierge service, a prevention plan health at work as well as participation in a certified mutual insurance company and a nearby SNCF train station.  Recruitment conditions Remuneration according to statutory conditions + Compensation scheme. Vacant position to be filled as soon as possible according to the statutory recruitment procedures. The recruitment jury will be held in the second half of January 2025.

j.description: The Department of Bio Systems and Technology Som Jobs It is important to reduce the unilateral cultivation of a few crops in large fields, and instead increase the diversity of crops to benefit biodiversity and increase ecosystem services such as biological control. In addition, a greater variety of cultivated crops is promising to increase the return and/or reduce the dependence on pesticides. In this project we will assess whether strip cultivation, where two or more crops are grown next to each other in strips adapted to the width of modern sowing machines, can strengthen biological control, reduce the use of pesticides and maintain harvests compared to when each crop is grown alone on the field. In addition, we will validate the experiment with trials on farms, where farmers themselves decide the management. We are looking for a motivated person with a few years of experience as a researcher and with the ambition of an academic career, who also has a great interest in developing knowledge about the effect of the strip cultivation on biological Control of pests and the return on economically important agricultural crops. The candidate is expected to investigate what potential strip cultivation in practically applicable care has to mitigate the harvest loss of the pest. This means, among other things, planning a cultivation attempt at the university's experimental station, field work, collaboration with Swedish and international partners and to investigate agricultural acceptance of innovative cultivation systems such as strip cultivation. We attach great importance to personal fitness and are looking for you who have good cooperative ability but also be able to work independently. input: I'm interested in occupations related to agricultural sustainability. What role would fit?
actual_output:
Based on the database, there are several roles related to agricultural sustainability and resource management. Here are the occupations retrieved:

*   **Sustainability Manager (Code: 1213.8):** Responsible for ensuring the sustainability of business processes, including manufacturing, products, and supply chains. They focus on waste reduction, energy efficiency, and environmental/social impacts.
*   **Agricultural Engineer (Code: 2144.1.2):** Focuses on the efficient and sustainable exploitation of land. They advise on the use of resources such as water and soil, harvesting methods, and waste management.
*   **Soil Scientist (Code: 2133.11):** Advises on improving soil quality to support nature and food production. They utilize erosion reduction measures and focus on conserving and restoring land affected by intense farming.
*   **Agricultural Equipment Design Engineer (Code: 2144.1.2.1):** Applies biological and engineering science to solve agricultural problems, specifically focusing on soil and water conservation.
*   **Agricultural Inspector (Code: 3359.1):** Monitors agricultural operations to ensure compliance with health, safety, and production legislation and standards.
*   **Mixed Farmer (Code: 6130.2):** Manages all aspects of livestock and crop production, often operating as a small enterprise or for self-sufficiency.
*   **Agricultural Technician (Code: 3142.1):** Conducts tests and experiments on specimens and provides support to scientists and farmers regarding environmental conditions.
*   **Biotechnical Technician (Code: 3141.1):** Assists scientists in laboratory settings to research, develop, and test forms of biotechnology.
*   **Agriculture, Forestry and Fishery Vocational Teacher (Code: 2320.1.1):** Instructs students in practical skills and techniques required for professions in these fields.
*   **Livestock Advisor (Code: 2132.6):** Provides specialist advice to farmers and livestock breeders to optimize business and production.

JobTitle: Sales manager north, Väktodling
Description: Are you passionate about Swedish agriculture, are you a good leader with a strong business sense? Do you want to work in a driving role in crop cultivation and be active in the market? Then there is the chance to become our new sales manager at Swedish Agro!WHAT WILL YOU BE A PART OF?Swedish AgroSwedish Agro is undergoing strong growth and we are now looking for a driven sales manager in the field of crop cultivation with a location in one of our locations Skänninge, Skara, Enköping or Kumla . Swedish Agro is also looking for a trained Safety Advisor, which is meritorious competence for this position. At Swedish Agro, we create value for Swedish agriculture by being a comprehensive supplier for the individual farmer and offering inputs, feed and machinery of the highest quality. We represent the industry's leading machinery brands CLAAS, HORSCH, METSJÖ, RAUCH, SPEARHEAD, SCANSTONE, AVR, AGXEED and DALBO and have one of Europe's most modern feed factories that manufacture feed for several animal species. We have a common belief that we are stronger together and work for the long term, quality and profitability. YOUR AREA OF RESPONSIBILITY As a sales manager, you run the day-to-day sales, which means that you lead and support around 10 plant cultivation salespeople in their work by being a sounding board for business decisions. The role means that you will drive sales efficiency, coach both new and experienced salespeople and manage change processes within the organization. Support for the sellers includes follow-up of key figures, development of existing staff and conducting employee interviews. In the role, you will also have product manager responsibility for mineral fertilizers within Swedish Agro, and we thus see that you are to some extent active in the market with own customer responsibility and own sales targets. You thus have your own sales responsibility and work flexibly with the opportunity to both be out in the field and work from the office. As a sales manager, you report to the Sales Manager for plant cultivation Sweden. YOUR PROFILE As a person, you are driven and interested in business towards agriculture in order to create added value together with the customer and our salespeople. Experience or training in agriculture is essential to assume the role of Sales Manager in crop cultivation at Swedish Agro. Furthermore, we see that you are thorough, responsive and structured in your way of working and have a great interest in motivating and developing others. To thrive in the role, you have a coaching and supportive leadership style where you encourage your employees to take responsibility and initiative in their roles. You are also used to effectively, clearly and transparently communicating and reporting to management. We place great emphasis on your personal qualities and driving forces. Furthermore, we see that you have: At least 3-5 years of experience in the agricultural industry Experience in sales or trade (B2B) Proven leadership skills Merit with post-secondary education focusing on agronomist/farm manager/agrotechnician or similar Merit with experience in personnel responsibility Good knowledge of Swedish both verbally and writing B driving license WE OFFER Stronger together At Swedish Agro, our foundation is based on cooperation and we have a fundamental belief that we are stronger together. We thus offer a workplace where we develop together - across departments, skills and national borders. Our employees are our most important resource and we strive to create the best conditions for well-being, commitment and influence. ARE YOU INTERESTED? How to apply If you think the position sounds exciting, please send your application today or as soon as possible by clicking on "APPLY". We expect to hold interviews continuously and may stop the search when the right candidate has been found. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Patrik Persson, Sales Manager, Swedish Agro on 072-535 30 17. AN INTERNATIONAL GROUP We want to create value! For agriculture, for the farmer and for our employees. Swedish Agro is part of the Danish Agro group, with more than 5,000 colleagues spread over 100 companies in 15 countries. From the field to the screen, our employees are at the core of our ability to create value and develop the agriculture of the future and ensure that we can play a decisive role in the industry's digital and green transition - and that we help the farmer grow world-class food every day. We do this by strengthening, growing and developing the industry - and not least each other. And we need you too! Are you more curious about the Danish Agro group? Watch our group film here!

JobTitle: Försökstekniker till Sandbygård
Description: We are looking for you with a great interest in the future of agriculture and who wants to work in an engaging team with a fast pace and lots of laughs. With us, you are offered an exciting opportunity to get a developing job in Swedish horticulture with an employer with long experience and a lot of knowledge. Welcome to us at Hushållningssällskapet Skåne!Hushållningssällskapet Skåne has for 200 years been involved in the development of Sweden's agriculture, which makes us a safe and stable employer with a lot of knowledge. We are the farmers' support and conduct a very reputable field trial operation with approx. 450 trials a year, where quality and development are the guiding stars. About the service The Skåne Farming Society's focus is to carry out crop cultivation trials of high scientific quality with modern equipment in all imaginable crops for the benefit and profitability of Swedish Agriculture. As a test technician with us, you will thus get an exciting role where the starting point of your work is to strive for quality and efficiency at all levels. It is varied work where every day is unique and the challenges are many. We carry out field trials in areas such as variety testing, plant protection, weed control, plant nutrition, tillage and more. You will be part of a team of trial technicians who work closely together. We offer you stimulating and fun work with varying tasks throughout the year depending on the season. With us, you also get the opportunity to participate in developing the agriculture of the future! About you In order to succeed and thrive with us, you have an agricultural education or work experience in crop cultivation. You have good knowledge of driving agricultural machinery and you should have a sprayer certificate. B driving license is a requirement for the position, BE is desirable. It is advantageous if you have knowledge of pests and diseases in crop cultivation. If you have experience in machine service, we also see that as a plus. As a person, you have a great interest in crop cultivation/agriculture. You are meticulous, committed and quality conscious. You have the ability and enjoy working both independently and together with others. Of course you are driven and like challenges. Location: You start from our experimental station at Sandbygård. The work at our second trial station at Helgegården will occur. The position begins as a trial position for 6 months Questions about the position? Feel free to call us and we will tell you more. Ulrika Dyrlund Martinsson, head of field trials, 010 - 476 20 31, ulrika.dyrlund-martinsson@hushallningssallskapet.se or Andreas Andersson, field trial leader, 010 - 4762054, andreas.andersson@hushallningssallskapet.se Does it sound interesting? Submit your application today as selection takes place continuously. Welcome with your application!RequirementsAgricultural education or work experience in crop cultivationGood knowledge of driving agricultural machineryB driver's licenseMeriting BE driver's licenseSpray certificateKnowledge of pests and diseases in crop productionExperience in machine serviceAbout the employer - The SkåneHushållningssallskapet The Hushållningssallskapet is part of Sweden's history. The history stretches all the way back to 1791, when the country's first Household Society was established on Gotland. When we arrived over two hundred years ago, it was in a different Sweden, where agriculture formed the basis for the entire nation's prosperity. Back then, when famine was a reality in many Swedish households, new knowledge was needed for a more rational food production. Today, we continue to be an important actor that develops the green business life and to manage the earth's resources. Today, the Housekeeping Society consists of 15 independent societies that operate all over the country (the Housekeeping Society in Skåne is one of these). Just over 700 employees deal with advice, training, research and field trials and we have around 30,000 members. Our customers are in agriculture, forestry, public activities and other industries, mainly in rural areas. Together, we offer knowledge for the country's future. JobTitle: Lantbrukare med huvudansvar för jordbruk och djurhållning
Description: Tasks: We now need to supplement the workforce with you who want to contribute to the development of the cultural reserve Stensjö village. It is a unique opportunity to, together with colleagues on site and with the support of management advice and external expertise, participate in the development work and work towards the cultural-historical target image. During the changes of the seasons, you will contribute to recreating the experience of old-time small farms in the Småland forest region. The position involves primary responsibility for agriculture and animal husbandry in a landscape characterized by natural grazing, mowing fields, small fields and large forest areas. All cultivation is organic. You must be prepared to take on managerial responsibilities. The permanent staff at the farm consists of four people with different areas of responsibility (agriculture, forestry, garden, landscape), one of whom is site manager with overall responsibility for the property. During the growing season, the workforce is supplemented by one to two seasonal workers. The animal supervision on the weekends rotates between the staff so that work takes place according to schedule every third to fourth weekend. Common, ongoing work tasks consist of all tasks occurring within a farm with an ecological orientation and a focus on cultural-historical landscape care. An important task is to continuously document the work that is done. Passing on knowledge of the uniqueness of Stensjö village to visitors and groups is also part of the work. Participation in management councils and ongoing contacts with the County Administrative Board regarding issues relating to the cultural reserve are included, as well as administrative work and authority contacts related to the duties, such as EU and other applications, reporting and registration. Programs used at Stensjö include Dataväxt, Växa Sverige, CDB, Elitlamm etc. About Stensjö village Stensjö village comprises 576 hectares of which 14 hectares are arable, 81 hectares of pasture, 417 hectares of forest and 44 hectares of impediment. The large contiguous areas with natural pastures are distinctive for Stensjö village. A typical feature is the kilometre-long hedgerows that enclose holdings, pastures and cattle lanes. Small fields, mowing fields, pastures and open fields with forest grazing characterize the landscape. The village's great importance lies in the fact that houses and property form a unit that is original. Residential houses and outbuildings, a total of about 50 in number, are gathered in a cluster village, which was common in many places in Småland before legal transfer was carried out in the 19th century. In the village there are about fifteen cows and a bull of the red kulla breed as well as about 30 Helsingo sheep, some pigs and chickens. During the summer months, hired cows walk in the forest pastures. The field cultivation consists of paddy, potatoes and cultivated crops, mainly older cereals but also flax. The land has been cultivated organically since the Vitterhetsakademien took over the property in the 1960s. Since 2020, Stensjö village is a cultural reserve. The management plan aims to show Stensjö as it looked at the turn of the century in 1900. The land types that existed at that time should be well represented in the form of pastures, fodder dikes, gardens, ancient fields with cereal crops, natural hay fields and forest pastures. Long-term work is underway where the management plan is the guiding principle with the aim of recreating an older land use. Stensjö village is to be developed into a knowledge and development center for historic landscape use. The management plan can be found on the website under the Management plan and documents tab. To support the work, there is a management council that meets at Stensjö twice a year. The maintenance council consists of 5-7 people with experience in practical landscape and garden maintenance and building maintenance, as well as representatives for research in relevant areas. Administrative support such as finance, communication etc. can be found at the Vitterhetsakademien's office in Stockholm. Qualifications Requirements for the position You must have documented, solid experience in crop cultivation and animal husbandry Ability to work both independently and together with others Good verbal and written communication skills in Swedish Experience in administration and authority contacts regarding farm support, animal husbandry, EU applications etc. Driving license BMeritandEducation in agriculture and animal husbandryEducation/experience in organic farming with crop rotations Experience of work management Education/experience of: Landscape care with a cultural-historical focus, scythes Work with horses Forestry with clear cutting methods Machine maintenance Building care/property care with an antiquarian focus Experience of museum operations and outward-looking, public activities Basic interest and knowledge of small farms; nature, history and culture, and preferably more specifically about Småland's conditions Driving license BEChainsaw driving license A and BHunting licensePersonal characteristicsWe attach great importance to personal suitability. You can work independently and intensively when required, but also be a good colleague and partner with Stensjö's best interests at heart in all internal and external contexts. You have a great sense of responsibility and can flexibly change between the various tasks. Employment and other information about the work The position is a permanent, full-time position that begins with a six-month probationary period. The work involves scheduled working hours, which includes work on evenings, weekends and public holidays. The academy applies individual salary setting. The workplace is Stensjö village, 10 km north of Oskarshamn. There is an opportunity to live in Stensjö village. The Vitterhetsakademien's office is in Stockholm. Support functions such as finances, administration, communication, IT support, archives, etc. is there. The property manager, who is the immediate manager, has his main place of work in Stockholm but is on site in Stensjö village several times a year. In between, meetings and contact take place via Teams and telephone. Collaboration and meetings with colleagues at the other cultural properties take place regularly, including in connection with joint property meetings twice a year. The members of the Vitterhetsakademie have a great interest in the cultural properties and many regularly visit Stensjö village. There is guest accommodation for them at each cultural property, which enables overnight stays.

input: Are there any jobs available for a Project Manager?
actual_output:
Yes, there are several job opportunities for a Project Manager within the agricultural sector as described in the provided information:

*   **Administrators and advisors with a focus on farm animals:** This role involves planning, implementing, and leading skills development within the common agricultural policy. It requires experience in project management, writing applications for project funds, and coordinating actors for various activities. 
*   **Digital domain manager (F/M):** This role at Soufflet Agriculture involves managing the progress of digital initiatives, reporting risks to project sponsors, and leading a team of business experts. It requires experience in solution development projects.
*   **Distriktssäljare (District Salesperson) at DeLaval:** This role in Skåne involves coordinating and project managing the work for builders, authorities, and advisory bodies when planning facilities and systems for farmers. Experience in project management is listed as a meritorious qualification.
*   **Researchers in ecosystem services in strip cultivation:** This position involves planning cultivation experiments, field work, and project management. Experience in project management is a qualification.
*   **Responsable de pôle installation en agriculture (F/H):** This role involves providing local supervision to a team of managers, leading regional installation policy, and organizing/coordinating various processes. 
*   **Samordnare för stadsnära odling (Coordinator for urban cultivation):** This role includes project management and cross-sectoral collaboration for the development of urban cultivation.
*   **Senior Farm Sustainability Specialist:** This role involves acting as a project manager to develop and lead engaging and effective projects to deliver sustainability impact on farms.
*   **Substitute Cultivation coordinator/project manager:** This role involves leading projects that integrate cultivation into community planning, supporting professional horticulture and agriculture, and developing recreational and complementary cultivation. It requires experience in project management and cross-sector collaboration.

j.title: Substitute Cultivation coordinator/project manager
j.description: Do you want to help shape the sustainable society of the future? Södertälje municipality is looking for a creative and innovative person for the role of cultivation coordinator/cultivation project manager. The assignment is a temporary position starting no later than January 2025. Here you get the chance to influence how we protect our farmland and promote local food production, all in line with the municipality's goal of becoming climate neutral by 2030. The position is located at the park and landscape unit at the Community Planning Office. In the unit, we are a total of 14 people who work on issues related to park planning, ecosystem services, pollination, cultivation coordination and much more. We enjoy being together very well on the unit and have a kind climate where we care for each other, our differences and where we are happy to cooperate. Among your colleagues at the unit, you will find people with roles such as landscape architect, park engineer, administrator, coordinator and unit manager. We all work together towards the municipality's overall goals in ecological, social and financial sustainability. With us, you have the opportunity to contribute to a truly sustainable society. About the Service As part of the continuous work with sustainability, a municipality-wide cultivation strategy with accompanying action plan has been adopted, with the aim of showing how the municipality, based on its various roles and functions, should promote local cultivation and protect the arable land. As Cultivation Coordinator/Cultivation Project Manager, you will play a key role in implementing and following up on our cultivation strategy. You will lead projects that integrate cultivation into community planning, support professional horticulture and agriculture, and develop recreational and complementary cultivation. Your work will contribute to ensuring long-term sustainable production methods that benefit biodiversity and create sustainable cycles of nutrients and water. Your tasks will include: - Implementation of Strategy: Implement measures according to the cultivation strategy and action plan to achieve the municipality's overall goals. - Coordination: Work cross-sectorally with various committees and companies to ensure effective implementation of the strategy. - Advice and Support: Continue to develop systems for cultivation advice and grants and support professional horticulture and agriculture. - Communication: Inform and inspire citizens and stakeholders about the possibilities for local cultivation. Who are you? We are looking for you who have: - Education and/or experience in agronomy, environmental science, park planning, gardener or similar field in the green industry. - Experience in project management and cross-sector collaboration. - Ability to express yourself well in Swedish, both orally and in writing. - Good knowledge of digital tools. - B driver's license. Meritorious: - Previous work in the public sector or with sustainability issues. - Experience of strategic planning in agriculture or horticulture. - Interest in social sustainability and community development. - Experience of/knowledge of application processes for external funds and grants relevant to the service. Personal characteristics: You are structured, creative, results-oriented and have a strong ability to collaborate and find new innovative solutions. You can easily create contact with other people and are good at communicating both internally and externally. You are passionate about sustainable development and always have the citizens' best interests in mind when you take on projects. We attach great importance to your personal qualities. We offer you You will sit in our modern city hall a stone's throw from the center of Södertälje with good communication options such as buses and commuter trains and with a fantastic view of both the city and the canal. We sit in an open office landscape, but also offer the possibility of remote work for a certain part of your working time. We apply annual working hours, which means that you have a certain flexibility in how you allocate your working hours. The position is a temporary position until and including 15-01-2026. Each day passes approx 6,000 people to their jobs in Södertälje municipality. We have many different roles with us and want to offer you a meaningful job where you get the opportunity to contribute to society while feeling joy. As an employee with us, you get the opportunity to develop and make a real impression. As an employee of Södertälje municipality, you are offered, among other things, safe employment conditions, a generous wellness allowance and the opportunity to exchange the holiday allowance for extra days off. Within certain businesses, there is also the possibility of some flexibility regarding working hours and working methods. We have a large range of training and skills-enhancing efforts for you as an employee. For more detailed information about our benefits, please read more on our external website: https://www. soder waist. se/admanerWelcome to us! Other Selection and interviews will take place continuously during the application period. Södertälje municipality works with competence-based recruitment methodology with the aim of countering discrimination and promote diversity in the workplace. Employment with us can mean placement in a security class. A security check with a register check according to the Security Protection Act (2018:585) may therefore be carried out before a decision on employment. Swedish citizenship is required for some of our duties in security class. We are happy to receive calls from you who are interested in the job, but we refuse you who sell advertisements and recruitment services.

We call it Stronger People Stronger Planet and it is deeply anchored in our organisation and founded on our commitment to respecting human rights, increasing access to healthy dairy nutrition, inspiring good food habits, and improving the environment for future generations. In order to succeed we need to hire people with a sustainable mindset. Could this be you?BEWARE! A global cross-functional hub for innovative and digital solutions completes this system. Serving the agricultural transition, InVivo's ambition is to support the transformation of the French farm and to support European food sovereignty.  Soufflet Agriculture is the leading French private collector of cereals and oilseeds. Present in the main arable crop regions in France as well as in Europe and the CIS, the company ensures the collection, storage and marketing of agricultural production, and carries out agro-supplies distribution activity. Soufflet Agriculture supports farmers in their development through personalized agronomic expertise, technical monitoring and the provision of innovative and competitive solutions to meet the needs of the agri-food sectors and industries. j.title: Administrators and advisors with a focus on farm animals
j.description: The county board's approximately 300 employees work as the government's representative at regional level. Our mission is to develop the county and work to ensure that the national political goals have an impact in the county. We work to be an authority free from discrimination and want to take advantage of the qualities that diversity brings to the business. The rural unit is one of the county board's seven units with approximately 40 employees. The unit is responsible for project and investment support, animal and area-based support, advice and courses for agricultural companies, supervision in agriculture, register checks on animals, land acquisition permits for agricultural and forestry properties and monitoring of basic paid services. Within the unit there is also the Interreg Sweden Norway program for which the County Administrative Board of Jämtland County is the managing authority. The unit has overall responsibility for rural issues and is responsible for the agricultural and rural focus in the cross-sector collaboration at the County Board. We work with experts in these fields who are happy to share their knowledge. We work with respect, professionalism and openness for the county's residents - together for a sustainable future! The county. This includes, among other things, counseling and skills-enhancing activities aimed at the county's farmers. Our current pet consultant is now retiring and we are therefore looking for her successor who wants to work with skills development for the county's farmers with a focus on the farm's animal husbandry. Job duties You will be part of a group that works with planning, implementing and leading skills development within the common agricultural policy in the form of advice, courses and information to farmers. The work entails partly independently carrying out competence-enhancing initiatives such as courses, counseling and farm meetings with exchange of experience and partly coordinating other actors that the county administrative board has procured for various activities. You write applications for project funds and, together with colleagues, carry out the procurement of competence development efforts. The work includes financial accounting and reporting of measures taken. You collaborate with industry actors and organizations and have close cooperation with other county administrative boards as well as with various functions at our county administrative board. You may be part of cross-sectoral groups where you need to be able to combine your expertise with a holistic perspective. You participate in the work of responding to referrals and contributing with the perspective of agriculture on various issues. Depending on experience and competence, other tasks at the unit may also be part of the position. Your work is independent and requires you to be self-motivated, results-oriented and good at collaborating and creating relationships. You are sensitive to the needs of different clients. In your dialogue with farmers, you need to be service-oriented and have a good understanding of the companies' conditions in the county and have the ability to see the whole. You have a few years of work experience, experience from consultancy and government work is advantageous. You have work experience with a focus on agriculture and farm animals. If you also have experience in project management and work with skills development, as well as experience in working with small business owners, this is advantageous. You have the ability to communicate clearly in both speech and writing and have an established network within the agricultural industry. You are structured and solution-oriented with good computer skills. The position involves travel, mainly in the county, but longer trips with overnight stays also occur. A driver's license for a passenger car is required. We offer you meaningful work with varied tasks. You will make a difference to our county and society. The County Board is a broad authority, which means that you constantly have the opportunity to develop and learn new things. This applies in several policy areas. As an employer, we have a strong focus on good employment conditions, active work environment work and health-promoting wellness activities. We are keen on cooperation with our union partners and can offer remote work. In case of permanent employment at the County Board, you will be placed at war with the authority. Depending on the service, this may include serving in crisis staff and security classification. We usually start with trial employment for permanent positions. You can find information about how we process your personal data at www.lansstyrelsen.se/dataskydd

j.title: Distriktssäljare till DeLaval
j.description: Now we are looking for you who have a genuine interest in Swedish agriculture and who want to work in sales. Here you get the opportunity to work for a global company where you contribute to more sustainable food production. Does that sound interesting? Apply now! As we work with ongoing selection, the position may be filled before the application deadline, so apply today! Due to Christmas / New Year, response times may be slightly longer. About the role As District Salesman at DeLaval, you work independently and responsibly in a broad role with sales in the district of Skåne. Here you act as support for your customers when it comes to planning facilities and systems for farmers. You are solution-oriented and persistent in the sales process where you coordinate and project manage the work for builders, authorities and advisory bodies. Your profile This is the role for you who have a genuine interest in and knowledge of Swedish agriculture and who are passionate about sales and advice. You have acquired knowledge and a good understanding of agriculture through work experience, studies or perhaps from growing up on or running a farm yourself. You are communicative and fearless in customer meetings. You have a sense of order and enjoy creating long-term relationships and are persistent during the sales process. To be successful in the role, we believe that you have a few years of work experience in sales or consultancy, preferably in the agricultural sector. Your first time at DeLaval you will receive extensive basic training at Hamragård in Tumba, joint trips with experienced colleagues as well as continuous further training which includes, among other things, training in CAD. About DeLaval DeLaval is a world leader in milking equipment with 4,300 employees in over 100 markets. For almost 130 years, they have developed solutions and service for efficient milk production. Their research and development aims to give farmers access to reliable and sustainable systems that promote animal health and the production of quality milk. DeLaval is a company in the Tetra Laval group. DeLaval Sales AB is part of Region Northern Europe and takes care of sales on the Swedish market. The company has approximately 180 employees. The head office is in Tumba, south of Stockholm, next to the Hamra research and development farm. The group's headquarters and factory for milking robots are also located here. Requirements Completed high school education Good knowledge of or previous experience in Swedish agriculture Work experience in sales or other relevant experience for the position Fluent in spoken and written Swedish Good knowledge of spoken and written English Driving license B Meritorious Post-secondary education in a relevant field for the position, such as agronomist or farm manager Sales / advisory experience in agriculture, animal husbandry or similar Experience in project management Knowledge in CAD Other Start date: By agreement Form of assignment: Permanent employment where you will be employed directly by DeLaval Location: You will work from home and live and work in Skåne You apply for the position by answering a few questions and attaching your CV or linking your Linkedin profile. Candidates who meet the basic requirements will receive a link to a personality test and a logical thinking test. Read more about why we use tests in our recruitment here. We then invite those who proceed to a digital interview. We work based on competence throughout the entire recruitment process. Due to Christmas / New Year, the response times may be slightly longer. If you have questions about the position or the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact the responsible recruiter Lina Södergren via 076-020 25 14 and lina@stegra.nu. Stegra handles the entire recruitment process and all questions about the position are answered by Stegra.

input: What occupation focuses on coordinating resources and achieving business goals?
actual_output:
Based on the information provided by the database, there are two occupations that involve coordinating resources and aspects of business management:

**1. Manufacturing managers (ID: http://data.europa.eu/esco/isco/C1321)**
*   **Focus:** They plan, direct, and coordinate activities related to the production of goods, electricity, gas, water, and waste management.
*   **Business/Resource Coordination:** They are responsible for establishing and managing budgets, monitoring production output/costs, and adjusting processes and resources to minimize costs. Additionally, they identify business opportunities, determine products to be manufactured, and oversee contracts with customers and suppliers.

**2. Financial and insurance services branch managers (ID: http://data.europa.eu/esco/irc/C1346)**
*   **Focus:** They plan, direct, and coordinate the branches of institutions such as banks, credit unions, and insurance companies.
*   **Business/Resource Coordination:** Their duties include managing budgets, controlling expenditure, and ensuring the efficient use of resources. They also establish and maintain relationships with business customers and coordinate the approval or rejection of lines of credit for commercial loans.
